    public function typedValue(): mixed
    {
        return match ($this->value_type) {
            'integer' => (int) $this->value,
            'decimal' => (float) $this->value,
            'boolean' => filter_var($this->value, FILTER_VALIDATE_BOOLEAN),
            'json', 'date' => json_decode((string) $this->value, true) ?? $this->value,
            default => $this->value,
        };
    }

    public static function get(string $key, mixed $default = null): mixed
    {
        $setting = Cache::rememberForever('setting.'.$key, fn () => static::query()->where('key', $key)->first());

        return $setting?->typedValue() ?? $default;
    }

    protected static function booted(): void
    {
        static::saved(fn (Setting $setting) => Cache::forget('setting.'.$setting->key));
        static::deleted(fn (Setting $setting) => Cache::forget('setting.'.$setting->key));
    }
}

trait Auditable
{
    public static function bootAuditable(): void
    {
        static::created(function (Model $model): void {
            app(AuditLogger::class)->record('create', $model, null, $model->attributesToArray());
        });

        static::updated(function (Model $model): void {
            $changes = $model->getChanges();
            unset($changes['updated_at']);

            if ($changes === []) {
                return;
            }

            $old = [];
            foreach (array_keys($changes) as $key) {
                $old[$key] = $model->getOriginal($key);
            }

            app(AuditLogger::class)->record('update', $model, $old, $changes);
        });

        static::deleted(function (Model $model): void {
            app(AuditLogger::class)->record('delete', $model, $model->attributesToArray(), null);
        });
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Services;

use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Auth;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

class AuditLogger
{
    /**
     * Nilai yang tidak boleh tersimpan mentah di audit log.
     *
     * @var array<int, string>
     */
    protected array $sensitiveKeys = [
        'password',
        'remember_token',
        'nik',
        'nik_hash',
        'account_number',
        'npwp',
        'bpjs_kesehatan_no',
        'bpjs_tk_no',
    ];

    public function record(string $event, Model $model, ?array $old = null, ?array $new = null): void
    {
        $this->write(
            $event,
            $model->getMorphClass(),
            $model->getKey(),
            $old,
            $new
        );
    }

    public function recordRaw(
        string $event,
        string $auditableType,
        ?int $auditableId = null,
        ?array $old = null,
        ?array $new = null
    ): void {
        $this->write($event, $auditableType, $auditableId, $old, $new);
    }

    protected function write(string $event, string $type, ?int $id, ?array $old, ?array $new): void
    {
        $request = request();

        DB::table('audit_logs')->insert([
            'user_id' => Auth::id(),
            'event' => $event,
            'auditable_type' => $type,
            'auditable_id' => $id,
            'old_values' => $old === null ? null : json_encode($this->sanitize($old), JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE),
            'new_values' => $new === null ? null : json_encode($this->sanitize($new), JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE),
            'ip_address' => $request?->ip(),
            'user_agent' => $request ? substr((string) $request->userAgent(), 0, 255) : null,
            'created_at' => now(),
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    protected function sanitize(array $values): array
    {
        $clean = [];

        foreach ($values as $key => $value) {
            if (in_array($key, $this->sensitiveKeys, true)) {
                $clean[$key] = $value === null ? null : '[disembunyikan]';
                continue;
            }

            if (is_array($value)) {
                $clean[$key] = $this->sanitize($value);
                continue;
            }

            $clean[$key] = $value;
        }

        return $clean;
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Services;

use Carbon\CarbonInterface;
use Illuminate\Support\Carbon;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use RuntimeException;

class NumberSequenceService
{
    /**
     * Ambil nomor berikutnya secara atomik (SELECT ... FOR UPDATE).
     */
    public function next(string $code, ?CarbonInterface $at = null): string
    {
        $at = $at ? Carbon::instance($at) : now('Asia/Jakarta');

        return DB::transaction(function () use ($code, $at): string {
            $sequence = DB::table('number_sequences')
                ->where('code', $code)
                ->lockForUpdate()
                ->first();

            if (! $sequence) {
                throw new RuntimeException("Nomor urut '{$code}' belum dikonfigurasi.");
            }

            $next = (int) $sequence->next_number;
            $reset = false;
            $lastReset = $sequence->last_reset_at ? Carbon::parse($sequence->last_reset_at) : null;

            if ($sequence->reset_period === 'yearly'
                && (! $lastReset || $lastReset->year !== $at->year)) {
                $next = 1;
                $reset = true;
            }

            if ($sequence->reset_period === 'monthly'
                && (! $lastReset || $lastReset->format('Y-m') !== $at->format('Y-m'))) {
                $next = 1;
                $reset = true;
            }

            $number = $this->format(
                $sequence->pattern,
                $sequence->prefix,
                $next,
                $sequence->padding,
                $at
            );

            DB::table('number_sequences')->where('id', $sequence->id)->update([
                'next_number' => $next + 1,
                'last_reset_at' => $reset ? $at->toDateString() : $sequence->last_reset_at,
                'updated_at' => now(),
            ]);

            return $number;
        });
    }

    public function format(
        string $pattern,
        ?string $prefix,
        int $number,
        int $padding,
        CarbonInterface $at
    ): string {
        $replaced = str_replace(
            ['{prefix}', '{year}', '{month}', '{day}'],
            [$prefix ?? '', $at->format('Y'), $at->format('m'), $at->format('d')],
            $pattern
        );

        return preg_replace_callback(
            '/\{seq(?::(\d+))?\}/',
            fn (array $match) => str_pad(
                (string) $number,
                isset($match[1]) && $match[1] !== '' ? (int) $match[1] : $padding,
                '0',
                STR_PAD_LEFT
            ),
            $replaced
        );
    }
}

class EmployeeService
{
    public function __construct(private readonly NumberSequenceService $sequences)
    {
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $data
     */
    public function create(array $data, User $actor): Employee
    {
        return DB::transaction(function () use ($data, $actor): Employee {
            if (blank($data['nip'] ?? null)) {
                $data['nip'] = $this->sequences->next('nip');
            }

            $data['created_by'] = $actor->id;
            $data['is_active'] ??= true;

            /** @var Employee $employee */
            $employee = Employee::create($data);

            $employee->payrollProfile()->create([
                'education_id' => $data['education_id'] ?? null,
                'dependents_count' => $data['dependents_count'] ?? 0,
                'effective_from' => $employee->hire_date ?? now('Asia/Jakarta')->toDateString(),
                'updated_by' => $actor->id,
            ]);

            if ($employee->org_unit_id && $employee->position_id) {
                $employee->assignments()->create([
                    'org_unit_id' => $employee->org_unit_id,
                    'position_id' => $employee->position_id,
                    'direct_supervisor_id' => $employee->direct_supervisor_id,
                    'work_location_id' => $employee->work_location_id,
                    'effective_from' => $employee->hire_date ?? now('Asia/Jakarta')->toDateString(),
                    'reason' => 'Penempatan awal',
                    'created_by' => $actor->id,
                ]);
            }

            $employee->statusHistories()->create([
                'status' => $employee->employment_status ?? 'aktif',
                'effective_date' => $employee->hire_date ?? now('Asia/Jakarta')->toDateString(),
                'reason' => 'Data awal pegawai',
                'created_by' => $actor->id,
            ]);

            return $employee;
        });
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $data
     */
    public function update(Employee $employee, array $data, User $actor): Employee
    {
        return DB::transaction(function () use ($employee, $data, $actor): Employee {
            $oldUnit = $employee->org_unit_id;
            $oldPosition = $employee->position_id;

            $employee->fill($data)->save();

            $structureChanged = $oldUnit !== $employee->org_unit_id
                || $oldPosition !== $employee->position_id;

            if ($structureChanged && $employee->org_unit_id && $employee->position_id) {
                $today = Carbon::now('Asia/Jakarta')->toDateString();

                $employee->assignments()
                    ->whereNull('effective_to')
                    ->update(['effective_to' => Carbon::now('Asia/Jakarta')->subDay()->toDateString()]);

                $employee->assignments()->create([
                    'org_unit_id' => $employee->org_unit_id,
                    'position_id' => $employee->position_id,
                    'direct_supervisor_id' => $employee->direct_supervisor_id,
                    'work_location_id' => $employee->work_location_id,
                    'effective_from' => $today,
                    'reason' => 'Perubahan struktur dari master pegawai',
                    'created_by' => $actor->id,
                ]);
            }

            return $employee;
        });
    }
}

class EnsureUserIsActive
{
    public function handle(Request $request, Closure $next): Response
    {
        $user = $request->user();

        if ($user && ! $user->is_active) {
            Auth::logout();
            $request->session()->invalidate();
            $request->session()->regenerateToken();

            return redirect()
                ->route('login')
                ->withErrors(['username' => 'Akun Anda nonaktif. Hubungi administrator.']);
        }

        return $next($request);
    }
}

                ->route('password.change')

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use App\Models\OrgUnit;
use App\Support\MasterData;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use Illuminate\Http\RedirectResponse;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Validation\Rule;
use Illuminate\View\View;

class MasterDataController extends Controller
{
    public function index(string $resource): View
    {
        $def = MasterData::resolve($resource);
        $this->authorizeView($def);

        $query = $def['model']::query()->with($def['with'] ?? []);

        if ($search = trim((string) request('q'))) {
            $query->where(function ($q) use ($def, $search) {
                foreach ($def['searchable'] as $column) {
                    $q->orWhere($column, 'like', "%{$search}%");
                }
            });
        }

        foreach ($def['order_by'] as $column => $direction) {
            $query->orderBy($column, $direction);
        }

        return view('master.index', [
            'def' => $def,
            'resource' => $resource,
            'rows' => $query->paginate(15)->withQueryString(),
            'canManage' => request()->user()->hasPermission($def['permission']),
        ]);
    }

    public function create(string $resource): View
    {
        $def = MasterData::resolve($resource);
        $this->authorizeManage($def);

        return view('master.form', [
            'def' => $def,
            'resource' => $resource,
            'record' => null,
            'options' => MasterData::selectOptions($def),
        ]);
    }

    public function store(string $resource, Request $request): RedirectResponse
    {
        $def = MasterData::resolve($resource);
        $this->authorizeManage($def);

        $data = $this->validated($def, $request, null);
        $record = $def['model']::create($data);
        $this->afterSave($def, $record);

        return redirect()
            ->route($def['route'].'.index')
            ->with('success', $def['singular'].' berhasil ditambahkan.');
    }

    public function edit(string $resource, int $id): View
    {
        $def = MasterData::resolve($resource);
        $this->authorizeManage($def);

        $record = $def['model']::findOrFail($id);

        return view('master.form', [
            'def' => $def,
            'resource' => $resource,
            'record' => $record,
            'options' => MasterData::selectOptions($def, $record),
        ]);
    }

    public function update(string $resource, int $id, Request $request): RedirectResponse
    {
        $def = MasterData::resolve($resource);
        $this->authorizeManage($def);

        $record = $def['model']::findOrFail($id);
        $data = $this->validated($def, $request, $record);
        $record->update($data);
        $this->afterSave($def, $record);

        return redirect()
            ->route($def['route'].'.index')
            ->with('success', $def['singular'].' berhasil diperbarui.');
    }

    public function destroy(string $resource, int $id): RedirectResponse
    {
        $def = MasterData::resolve($resource);
        $this->authorizeManage($def);

        $record = $def['model']::findOrFail($id);

        if (isset($def['delete_guard']) && ($message = $def['delete_guard']($record))) {
            return back()->withErrors(['delete' => $message]);
        }

        try {
            $record->delete();
        } catch (\Illuminate\Database\QueryException) {
            return back()->withErrors(['delete' => 'Data tidak dapat dihapus karena masih dipakai data lain.']);
        }

        return redirect()
            ->route($def['route'].'.index')
            ->with('success', $def['singular'].' berhasil dihapus.');
    }

    protected function authorizeView(array $def): void
    {
        $user = request()->user();
        abort_unless(
            $user->hasPermission($def['view_permission']) || $user->hasPermission($def['permission']),
            403,
            'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses untuk melihat data ini.'
        );
    }

    protected function authorizeManage(array $def): void
    {
        abort_unless(
            request()->user()->hasPermission($def['permission']),
            403,
            'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses untuk mengubah data ini.'
        );
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    protected function validated(array $def, Request $request, ?Model $record): array
    {
        $table = (new $def['model'])->getTable();
        $rules = [];
        $booleanFields = [];

        foreach ($def['fields'] as $field) {
            $name = $field['name'];
            $type = $field['type'];
            $fieldRules = [];

            if (! empty($field['required'])) {
                $fieldRules[] = 'required';
            } else {
                $fieldRules[] = 'nullable';
            }

            if ($type === 'checkbox') {
                $booleanFields[] = $name;
                continue;
            }

            $fieldRules[] = match ($type) {
                'number' => 'integer',
                'decimal' => 'numeric',
                'date' => 'date',
                'time' => 'date_format:H:i',
                'employee' => 'integer',
                default => 'string',
            };

            if ($type === 'text' || $type === 'textarea') {
                $fieldRules[] = 'max:65000';
            }

            if ($type === 'select') {
                $fieldRules[] = Rule::in(array_keys($field['options']));
            }

            if ($type === 'org_unit' || $type === 'parent_org_unit') {
                $fieldRules[] = 'exists:org_units,id';
            }

            if ($type === 'employee') {
                $fieldRules[] = 'exists:employees,id';
            }

            if (! empty($field['unique'])) {
                $unique = Rule::unique($table, $name);
                if ($record) {
                    $unique->ignore($record->getKey());
                }
                $fieldRules[] = $unique;
            }

            $rules[$name] = $fieldRules;
        }

        $data = $request->validate($rules);

        foreach ($booleanFields as $field) {
            $data[$field] = $request->boolean($field);
        }

        if (isset($data['parent_id']) && $record instanceof OrgUnit && (int) $data['parent_id'] === $record->id) {
            throw \Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException::withMessages([
                'parent_id' => 'Unit tidak boleh menjadi induk dirinya sendiri.',
            ]);
        }

        return $data;
    }

    protected function afterSave(array $def, Model $record): void
    {
        if ($record instanceof OrgUnit) {
            $this->recalculateOrgLevels($record);
        }
    }

    protected function recalculateOrgLevels(OrgUnit $unit): void
    {
        $level = 1;
        $parent = $unit->parent;

        while ($parent) {
            $level++;
            $parent = $parent->parent;
        }

        if ($unit->level !== $level) {
            $unit->forceFill(['level' => $level])->saveQuietly();
        }

        foreach ($unit->children as $child) {
            $this->recalculateOrgLevels($child);
        }
    }
}

use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;
use Illuminate\View\View;

class LoginController extends Controller
{
    public function show(): View|RedirectResponse
    {
        if (Auth::check()) {
            return redirect()->route('dashboard');
        }

        return view('auth.login');
    }

    public function login(Request $request): RedirectResponse
    {
        $credentials = $request->validate([
            'username' => ['required', 'string', 'max:100'],
            'password' => ['required', 'string'],
        ]);

        $key = Str::lower($credentials['username']).'|'.$request->ip();

        if (RateLimiter::tooManyAttempts($key, 5)) {
            $this->logAttempt($request, null, $credentials['username'], false, 'throttled');

            throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                'username' => 'Terlalu banyak percobaan masuk. Coba lagi dalam '.RateLimiter::availableIn($key).' detik.',
            ]);
        }

        RateLimiter::hit($key, 60);

        $user = User::query()
            ->where('username', $credentials['username'])
            ->orWhere('email', $credentials['username'])
            ->first();

        if (! $user || ! Auth::attempt(
            ['username' => $user->username, 'password' => $credentials['password']],
            $request->boolean('remember')
        )) {
            $this->logAttempt($request, $user, $credentials['username'], false, 'invalid_credentials');

            throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                'username' => 'Username atau kata sandi tidak sesuai.',
            ]);
        }

        if (! $user->is_active) {
            Auth::logout();
            $this->logAttempt($request, $user, $credentials['username'], false, 'inactive');

            throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                'username' => 'Akun Anda nonaktif. Hubungi administrator.',
            ]);
        }

        RateLimiter::clear($key);
        $request->session()->regenerate();
        $user->forceFill(['last_login_at' => now()])->saveQuietly();

        $this->logAttempt($request, $user, $credentials['username'], true);

        return redirect()->intended(route('dashboard'));
    }

    public function logout(Request $request): RedirectResponse
    {
        Auth::logout();
        $request->session()->invalidate();
        $request->session()->regenerateToken();

        return redirect()->route('login');
    }

    protected function logAttempt(
        Request $request,
        ?User $user,
        string $username,
        bool $success,
        ?string $reason = null
    ): void {
        LoginHistory::create([
            'user_id' => $user?->id,
            'username_attempt' => Str::limit($username, 100),
            'success' => $success,
            'failure_reason' => $reason,
            'ip_address' => $request->ip(),
            'user_agent' => Str::limit((string) $request->userAgent(), 255),
            'login_at' => now(),
        ]);
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use App\Exports\EmployeeTemplateExport;
use App\Exports\EmployeesExport;
use App\Imports\EmployeesImport;
use App\Models\Education;
use App\Models\Employee;
use App\Models\EmployeeAssignment;
use App\Models\EmployeeBankAccount;
use App\Models\EmployeeDocument;
use App\Models\EmployeeEducation;
use App\Models\EmployeeFamily;
use App\Models\EmployeePayrollProfile;
use App\Models\EmployeeStatusHistory;
use App\Models\OrgUnit;
use App\Models\Position;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Models\WorkLocation;
use App\Services\AuditLogger;
use App\Services\EmployeeService;
use Illuminate\Http\RedirectResponse;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;
use Illuminate\Validation\Rule;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;
use Illuminate\View\View;
use Maatwebsite\Excel\Facades\Excel;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\BinaryFileResponse;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\StreamedResponse;

class EmployeeController extends Controller
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly EmployeeService $employees,
        private readonly AuditLogger $audit
    ) {
    }

    public function index(Request $request): View
    {
        $this->requireAnyPermission($request->user(), [
            'employee.view.all', 'employee.view.unit', 'employee.view.self',
        ]);

        $query = Employee::query()
            ->visibleTo($request->user())
            ->with(['orgUnit:id,name', 'position:id,name']);

        if ($search = trim((string) $request->input('q'))) {
            $query->where(function ($q) use ($search) {
                $q->where('full_name', 'like', "%{$search}%")
                    ->orWhere('nip', 'like', "%{$search}%")
                    ->orWhere('email', 'like', "%{$search}%");
            });
        }

        if ($category = $request->input('category')) {
            $query->where('employee_category', $category);
        }

        if ($status = $request->input('status')) {
            $query->where('employment_status', $status);
        }

        if ($request->filled('org_unit_id')) {
            $query->whereIn('org_unit_id', OrgUnit::descendantIds([(int) $request->input('org_unit_id')]));
        }

        return view('employees.index', [
            'employees' => $query->orderBy('full_name')->paginate(15)->withQueryString(),
            'orgUnits' => OrgUnit::query()->orderBy('level')->orderBy('name')->pluck('name', 'id'),
            'canCreate' => $request->user()->hasPermission('employee.create'),
            'canExport' => $request->user()->hasPermission('employee.export'),
            'canImport' => $request->user()->hasPermission('employee.import'),
        ]);
    }

    public function create(Request $request): View
    {
        $this->requirePermission($request->user(), 'employee.create');

        return view('employees.form', [
            'employee' => new Employee([
                'employee_category' => 'tetap',
                'employment_status' => 'aktif',
                'gender' => 'laki-laki',
                'is_active' => true,
                'hire_date' => now('Asia/Jakarta')->toDateString(),
            ]),
            'options' => $this->formOptions(),
        ]);
    }

    public function store(Request $request): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->requirePermission($request->user(), 'employee.create');

        $data = $this->validated($request);

        if ($request->hasFile('photo')) {
            $data['photo_path'] = $request->file('photo')->store('employees/photo', 'local');
        }
        unset($data['photo'], $data['education_id'], $data['dependents_count']);

        $employee = $this->employees->create($data, $request->user());

        $this->audit->recordRaw('view_sensitive', $employee->getMorphClass(), $employee->id, null, [
            'action' => 'create_employee',
        ]);

        return redirect()
            ->route('employees.show', $employee)
            ->with('success', 'Pegawai berhasil ditambahkan dengan NIP '.$employee->nip.'.');
    }

    public function show(Request $request, Employee $employee): View
    {
        $this->authorizeView($request->user(), $employee);

        $employee->load([
            'orgUnit', 'position', 'workLocation', 'supervisor',
            'families', 'educations.education', 'bankAccounts', 'documents',
            'statusHistories', 'assignments.orgUnit', 'assignments.position',
            'payrollProfile.education',
        ]);

        $user = $request->user();
        $canSensitive = $user->hasPermission('employee.sensitive.view');
        $canPayroll = $user->hasPermission('employee.payroll_profile.manage')
            || $user->hasPermission('payroll.component.view');

        if (($canSensitive || $canPayroll) && ! $user->hasPermission('employee.view.self')) {
            // akses sensitif tetap dicatat
        }

        if ($canSensitive || $canPayroll) {
            $this->audit->recordRaw('view_sensitive', $employee->getMorphClass(), $employee->id);
        }

        return view('employees.show', [
            'employee' => $employee,
            'canSensitive' => $canSensitive,
            'canPayroll' => $canPayroll,
            'canUpdate' => $user->hasPermission('employee.update'),
            'canManageDocuments' => $user->hasPermission('employee.document.manage'),
            'canViewDocuments' => $user->hasPermission('employee.document.view'),
            'options' => $this->formOptions(),
        ]);
    }

    public function edit(Request $request, Employee $employee): View
    {
        $this->requirePermission($request->user(), 'employee.update');
        $this->authorizeView($request->user(), $employee);

        return view('employees.form', [
            'employee' => $employee,
            'options' => $this->formOptions(),
        ]);
    }

    public function update(Request $request, Employee $employee): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->requirePermission($request->user(), 'employee.update');

        $data = $this->validated($request, $employee);

        if ($request->hasFile('photo')) {
            if ($employee->photo_path) {
                Storage::disk('local')->delete($employee->photo_path);
            }
            $data['photo_path'] = $request->file('photo')->store('employees/photo', 'local');
        }
        unset($data['photo'], $data['education_id'], $data['dependents_count']);

        $this->employees->update($employee, $data, $request->user());

        return redirect()
            ->route('employees.show', $employee)
            ->with('success', 'Data pegawai berhasil diperbarui.');
    }

    public function destroy(Request $request, Employee $employee): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->requirePermission($request->user(), 'employee.delete');

        $employee->delete();

        return redirect()
            ->route('employees.index')
            ->with('success', 'Pegawai berhasil dihapus (soft delete).');
    }

    public function photo(Request $request, Employee $employee): StreamedResponse
    {
        $this->authorizeView($request->user(), $employee);

        abort_unless($employee->photo_path && Storage::disk('local')->exists($employee->photo_path), 404);

        return Storage::disk('local')->response($employee->photo_path);
    }

    public function export(Request $request): BinaryFileResponse
    {
        $this->requirePermission($request->user(), 'employee.export');

        $query = Employee::query()
            ->visibleTo($request->user())
            ->with(['orgUnit', 'position', 'workLocation', 'educations.education']);

        $this->audit->recordRaw('export', Employee::class, null, null, [
            'filters' => $request->query(),
            'format' => 'xlsx',
        ]);

        return Excel::download(
            new EmployeesExport($query),
            'data-pegawai-'.now('Asia/Jakarta')->format('Ymd-His').'.xlsx'
        );
    }

    public function importForm(Request $request): View
    {
        $this->requirePermission($request->user(), 'employee.import');

        return view('employees.import');
    }

    public function import(Request $request): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->requirePermission($request->user(), 'employee.import');

        $request->validate([
            'file' => ['required', 'file', 'mimes:xlsx,xls,csv', 'max:5120'],
        ], [
            'file.mimes' => 'Berkas harus berformat XLSX, XLS, atau CSV.',
            'file.max' => 'Ukuran berkas maksimal 5 MB.',
        ]);

        $batch = \App\Models\ImportBatch::create([
            'module' => 'employees',
            'file_name' => $request->file('file')->getClientOriginalName(),
            'status' => 'processing',
            'created_by' => $request->user()->id,
        ]);

        $import = new EmployeesImport($request->user(), $batch);
        Excel::import($import, $request->file('file'));

        $batch->refresh();

        $message = "Impor selesai: {$batch->success_rows} berhasil, {$batch->failed_rows} gagal dari {$batch->total_rows} baris.";

        return redirect()
            ->route('employees.import.form')
            ->with($batch->failed_rows > 0 ? 'warning' : 'success', $message);
    }

    public function downloadTemplate(Request $request): BinaryFileResponse
    {
        $this->requirePermission($request->user(), 'employee.import');

        return Excel::download(new EmployeeTemplateExport, 'template-impor-pegawai.xlsx');
    }

    protected function authorizeView(User $user, Employee $employee): void
    {
        if ($user->hasPermission('employee.view.all')) {
            return;
        }

        if ($user->employee_id && $user->employee_id === $employee->id) {
            return;
        }

        if ($user->hasPermission('employee.view.unit') && $employee->canBeViewedBy($user)) {
            return;
        }

        abort(403, 'Anda tidak memiliki akses ke data pegawai ini.');
    }

    protected function requirePermission(User $user, string $permission): void
    {
        abort_unless($user->hasPermission($permission), 403, 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses untuk tindakan ini.');
    }

    protected function requireAnyPermission(User $user, array $permissions): void
    {
        abort_unless($user->hasAnyPermission($permissions), 403, 'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses untuk halaman ini.');
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    protected function formOptions(): array
    {
        return [
            'orgUnits' => OrgUnit::query()->where('is_active', true)->orderBy('level')->orderBy('name')->pluck('name', 'id'),
            'positions' => Position::query()->where('is_active', true)->orderBy('name')->pluck('name', 'id'),

        ];
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    protected function validated(Request $request, ?Employee $employee = null): array
    {
        $nikRule = ['nullable', 'digits:16'];
        if ($request->filled('nik')) {
            $nikRule[] = function (string $attribute, mixed $value, \Closure $fail) use ($employee) {
                $hash = hash('sha256', (string) $value);

                    ->exists();
                if ($exists) {

                }
            };
        }

        $data = $request->validate([
            'nip' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:30', Rule::unique('employees', 'nip')->ignore($employee?->id)],
            'nik' => $nikRule,
            'full_name' => ['required', 'string', 'max:150'],
            'nick_name' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:60'],
            'gender' => ['required', Rule::in(['laki-laki', 'perempuan'])],
            'birth_place' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:100'],
            'birth_date' => ['nullable', 'date', 'before:today'],
            'religion' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:30'],
            'marital_status' => ['required', Rule::in(['lajang', 'menikah', 'cerai', 'cerai_mati'])],
            'blood_type' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:3'],
            'address' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:255'],
            'village' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:100'],
            'district' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:100'],
            'city' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:100'],
            'province' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:100'],
            'postal_code' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:10'],
            'phone' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:30'],
            'email' => ['nullable', 'email', 'max:150'],
            'photo' => ['nullable', 'image', 'mimes:jpg,jpeg,png', 'max:2048'],
            'employee_category' => ['required', Rule::in(['tetap', 'harian', 'khidmah'])],
            'khidmah_type' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:20'],
            'employment_status' => ['required', Rule::in(['aktif', 'probation', 'cuti_panjang', 'nonaktif', 'berhenti'])],
            'org_unit_id' => ['nullable', 'exists:org_units,id'],
            'position_id' => ['nullable', 'exists:positions,id'],
            'direct_supervisor_id' => ['nullable', 'exists:employees,id', Rule::notIn([$employee?->id])],
            'work_location_id' => ['nullable', 'exists:work_locations,id'],
            'hire_date' => ['required', 'date'],
            'probation_end_date' => ['nullable', 'date', 'after_or_equal:hire_date'],

            'education_id' => ['nullable', 'exists:educations,id'],
            'dependents_count' => ['nullable', 'integer', 'min:0', 'max:3'],
        ]);

        $data['is_active'] = $request->boolean('is_active');

}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Concerns;

use App\Models\Employee;
use App\Models\User;

trait EnsuresEmployeeAccess
{
    protected function ensurePermission(User $user, string|array $permissions): void
    {
        $permissions = (array) $permissions;

        abort_unless(
            $user->hasAnyPermission($permissions),
            403,
            'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses untuk tindakan ini.'
        );
    }

    protected function ensureVisible(User $user, Employee $employee): void
    {
        if ($user->hasPermission('employee.view.all')) {
            return;
        }

        if ($user->employee_id === $employee->id) {
            return;
        }

        if ($user->hasPermission('employee.view.unit') && $employee->canBeViewedBy($user)) {
            return;
        }

        abort(403, 'Anda tidak memiliki akses ke data pegawai ini.');
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use App\Http\Controllers\Concerns\EnsuresEmployeeAccess;
use App\Models\Employee;
use App\Models\EmployeeDocument;
use App\Services\AuditLogger;
use Illuminate\Http\RedirectResponse;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;
use Illuminate\Validation\Rule;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\StreamedResponse;

class EmployeeDocumentController extends Controller
{
    use EnsuresEmployeeAccess;

    public function __construct(private readonly AuditLogger $audit)
    {
    }

    public function store(Request $request, Employee $employee): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->ensurePermission($request->user(), 'employee.document.manage');
        $this->ensureVisible($request->user(), $employee);

        $data = $request->validate([
            'doc_type' => ['required', Rule::in([
                'ktp', 'kk', 'ijazah', 'sertifikat', 'kontrak', 'sk', 'npwp', 'bpjs', 'lainnya',
            ])],
            'number' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:100'],
            'issued_date' => ['nullable', 'date'],
            'expiry_date' => ['nullable', 'date', 'after_or_equal:issued_date'],
            'file' => ['required', 'file', 'mimes:pdf,jpg,jpeg,png', 'max:10240'],
            'is_confidential' => ['nullable', 'boolean'],
        ], [
            'file.mimes' => 'Dokumen harus berformat PDF, JPG, atau PNG.',
            'file.max' => 'Ukuran dokumen maksimal 10 MB.',
        ]);

        $data['file_path'] = $request->file('file')->store('employees/documents', 'local');
        $data['is_confidential'] = $request->boolean('is_confidential');
        $data['uploaded_by'] = $request->user()->id;
        unset($data['file']);

        $employee->documents()->create($data);

        return back()->with('success', 'Dokumen berhasil diunggah.');
    }

    public function download(Request $request, Employee $employee, EmployeeDocument $document): StreamedResponse
    {
        $this->ensurePermission($request->user(), 'employee.document.view');
        $this->ensureVisible($request->user(), $employee);
        abort_unless($document->employee_id === $employee->id, 404);
        abort_unless(Storage::disk('local')->exists($document->file_path), 404, 'Berkas tidak ditemukan.');

        $this->audit->recordRaw('view_sensitive', $document->getMorphClass(), $document->id, null, [
            'employee_id' => $employee->id,
            'doc_type' => $document->doc_type,
        ]);

        return Storage::disk('local')->download(
            $document->file_path,
            $document->doc_type.'-'.$employee->nip.'.'.pathinfo($document->file_path, PATHINFO_EXTENSION)
        );
    }

    public function verify(Request $request, Employee $employee, EmployeeDocument $document): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->ensurePermission($request->user(), ['employee.document.manage', 'employee.update']);
        $this->ensureVisible($request->user(), $employee);
        abort_unless($document->employee_id === $employee->id, 404);

        $document->update([
            'verified_at' => now(),
            'verified_by' => $request->user()->id,
        ]);

        return back()->with('success', 'Dokumen ditandai terverifikasi.');
    }

    public function destroy(Request $request, Employee $employee, EmployeeDocument $document): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->ensurePermission($request->user(), 'employee.document.manage');
        $this->ensureVisible($request->user(), $employee);
        abort_unless($document->employee_id === $employee->id, 404);

        Storage::disk('local')->delete($document->file_path);
        $document->delete();

        return back()->with('success', 'Dokumen berhasil dihapus.');
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use App\Models\OrgUnit;
use App\Models\WorkSchedule;
use App\Models\WorkShift;
use Illuminate\Http\RedirectResponse;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Validation\Rule;
use Illuminate\View\View;

class WorkScheduleController extends Controller
{
    public function index(Request $request): View
    {
        $this->ensure($request, 'schedule.view');

        $schedules = WorkSchedule::query()
            ->with(['orgUnit:id,name'])
            ->withCount(['days', 'assignments'])
            ->orderByDesc('effective_from')
            ->paginate(15);

        return view('schedules.index', [
            'schedules' => $schedules,
            'canManage' => $request->user()->hasPermission('schedule.manage'),
        ]);
    }

    public function create(Request $request): View
    {
        $this->ensure($request, 'schedule.manage');

        return view('schedules.form', [
            'schedule' => new WorkSchedule([
                'effective_from' => now('Asia/Jakarta')->toDateString(),
                'is_active' => true,
            ]),
            'days' => collect(range(1, 7))->mapWithKeys(fn ($day) => [$day => null]),
            'options' => $this->options(),
        ]);
    }

    public function store(Request $request): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->ensure($request, 'schedule.manage');

        $data = $this->validated($request);
        $days = $data['days'];
        unset($data['days']);

        $schedule = WorkSchedule::create($data);
        $this->syncDays($schedule, $days);

        return redirect()->route('schedules.index')->with('success', 'Jadwal kerja berhasil dibuat.');
    }

    public function edit(Request $request, WorkSchedule $schedule): View
    {
        $this->ensure($request, 'schedule.manage');

        $schedule->load('days');

        return view('schedules.form', [
            'schedule' => $schedule,
            'days' => $schedule->days->keyBy('day_of_week'),
            'options' => $this->options(),
        ]);
    }

    public function update(Request $request, WorkSchedule $schedule): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->ensure($request, 'schedule.manage');

        $data = $this->validated($request);
        $days = $data['days'];
        unset($data['days']);

        $schedule->update($data);
        $schedule->days()->delete();
        $this->syncDays($schedule, $days);

        return redirect()->route('schedules.index')->with('success', 'Jadwal kerja berhasil diperbarui.');
    }

    public function destroy(Request $request, WorkSchedule $schedule): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->ensure($request, 'schedule.manage');

        if ($schedule->assignments()->exists()) {
            return back()->withErrors(['delete' => 'Jadwal masih ditugaskan ke pegawai.']);
        }

        $schedule->delete();

        return redirect()->route('schedules.index')->with('success', 'Jadwal kerja berhasil dihapus.');
    }

    protected function ensure(Request $request, string $permission): void
    {
        abort_unless(
            $request->user()->hasPermission($permission),
            403,
            'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses untuk tindakan ini.'
        );
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    protected function validated(Request $request): array
    {
        $data = $request->validate([
            'name' => ['required', 'string', 'max:100'],
            'org_unit_id' => ['nullable', 'exists:org_units,id'],
            'employee_category' => ['nullable', Rule::in(['tetap', 'harian', 'khidmah'])],
            'effective_from' => ['required', 'date'],
            'effective_to' => ['nullable', 'date', 'after_or_equal:effective_from'],
            'is_active' => ['nullable', 'boolean'],
            'days' => ['required', 'array'],
            'days.*.is_workday' => ['nullable', 'boolean'],
            'days.*.shift_id' => ['nullable', 'exists:work_shifts,id'],
        ]);

        $data['is_active'] = $request->boolean('is_active');

        $data['days'] = collect(range(1, 7))->mapWithKeys(function ($day) use ($request) {
            $isWorkday = $request->boolean("days.{$day}.is_workday");

            return [$day => [
                'is_workday' => $isWorkday,
                'shift_id' => $isWorkday ? ($request->input("days.{$day}.shift_id") ?: null) : null,
            ]];
        })->all();

        return $data;
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<int, array<string, mixed>>  $days
     */
    protected function syncDays(WorkSchedule $schedule, array $days): void
    {
        foreach ($days as $day => $values) {
            $schedule->days()->create([
                'day_of_week' => $day,
                'shift_id' => $values['shift_id'],
                'is_workday' => $values['is_workday'],
            ]);
        }
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    protected function options(): array
    {
        return [
            'orgUnits' => OrgUnit::query()->where('is_active', true)->orderBy('level')->orderBy('name')->pluck('name', 'id'),
            'shifts' => WorkShift::query()->where('is_active', true)->orderBy('start_time')->get(),
        ];

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use App\Models\Employee;
use App\Models\ScheduleAssignment;
use App\Models\WorkSchedule;
use Illuminate\Http\RedirectResponse;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;
use Illuminate\View\View;

class ScheduleAssignmentController extends Controller
{
    public function index(Request $request): View
    {
        abort_unless($request->user()->hasPermission('schedule.view'), 403);

        $assignments = ScheduleAssignment::query()
            ->with(['employee:id,full_name,nip', 'workSchedule:id,name'])
            ->orderByDesc('effective_from')
            ->paginate(20);

        return view('schedules.assignments', [
            'assignments' => $assignments,
            'employees' => Employee::query()->where('is_active', true)->orderBy('full_name')->pluck('full_name', 'id'),
            'schedules' => WorkSchedule::query()->where('is_active', true)->orderBy('name')->pluck('name', 'id'),
            'canManage' => $request->user()->hasPermission('schedule.manage'),
        ]);
    }

    public function store(Request $request): RedirectResponse
    {
        abort_unless($request->user()->hasPermission('schedule.manage'), 403);

        $data = $request->validate([
            'employee_id' => ['required', 'exists:employees,id'],
            'work_schedule_id' => ['required', 'exists:work_schedules,id'],
            'effective_from' => ['required', 'date'],
            'effective_to' => ['nullable', 'date', 'after_or_equal:effective_from'],
        ]);

        $overlap = ScheduleAssignment::query()
            ->where('employee_id', $data['employee_id'])
            ->where(function ($q) use ($data) {
                $q->whereNull('effective_to')
                    ->orWhere('effective_to', '>=', $data['effective_from']);
            })
            ->when(
                $data['effective_to'] ?? null,
                fn ($q, $end) => $q->where('effective_from', '<=', $end)
            )
            ->exists();

        if ($overlap) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                'effective_from' => 'Pegawai sudah memiliki jadwal pada rentang tanggal tersebut.',
            ]);
        }

        ScheduleAssignment::create($data + ['created_by' => $request->user()->id]);

        return back()->with('success', 'Jadwal pegawai berhasil ditetapkan.');
    }

    public function destroy(Request $request, ScheduleAssignment $assignment): RedirectResponse
    {
        abort_unless($request->user()->hasPermission('schedule.manage'), 403);

        $assignment->delete();

        return back()->with('success', 'Penugasan jadwal berhasil dihapus.');
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use App\Models\Employee;
use App\Models\OrgUnit;
use App\Models\Role;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Services\AuditLogger;
use Illuminate\Http\RedirectResponse;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Hash;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use Illuminate\Validation\Rule;
use Illuminate\Validation\Rules\Password;
use Illuminate\View\View;

class UserController extends Controller
{
    public function index(Request $request): View
    {
        $this->ensure($request, 'user.view');

        $users = User::query()
            ->with(['employee:id,full_name,nip', 'roles:id,code,name'])
            ->when($request->filled('q'), function ($q) use ($request) {
                $term = trim((string) $request->input('q'));
                $q->where(fn ($sub) => $sub
                    ->where('name', 'like', "%{$term}%")
                    ->orWhere('username', 'like', "%{$term}%")
                    ->orWhere('email', 'like', "%{$term}%"));
            })
            ->orderBy('name')
            ->paginate(15)
            ->withQueryString();

        return view('users.index', [
            'users' => $users,
            'canManage' => $request->user()->hasPermission('user.manage'),
        ]);
    }

    public function create(Request $request): View
    {
        $this->ensure($request, 'user.manage');

        return view('users.form', [
            'user' => new User(['is_active' => true, 'must_change_password' => true]),
            'options' => $this->options(),
        ]);
    }

    public function store(Request $request): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->ensure($request, 'user.manage');

        $data = $request->validate([
            'name' => ['required', 'string', 'max:150'],
            'username' => ['required', 'alpha_dash', 'max:60', 'unique:users,username'],
            'email' => ['nullable', 'email', 'max:150', 'unique:users,email'],
            'employee_id' => ['nullable', 'exists:employees,id', 'unique:users,employee_id'],
            'password' => ['required', 'confirmed', Password::min(8)],
            'is_active' => ['nullable', 'boolean'],
            'must_change_password' => ['nullable', 'boolean'],
            'role_ids' => ['required', 'array', 'min:1'],
            'role_ids.*' => ['exists:roles,id'],
            'org_unit_id' => ['nullable', 'exists:org_units,id'],
        ], [
            'role_ids.required' => 'Pilih minimal satu peran.',
        ]);

        $user = User::create([
            'name' => $data['name'],
            'username' => $data['username'],
            'email' => $data['email'] ?? null,
            'employee_id' => $data['employee_id'] ?? null,
            'password' => Hash::make($data['password']),
            'is_active' => $request->boolean('is_active'),
            'must_change_password' => $request->boolean('must_change_password'),
        ]);

        $user->roles()->sync(
            collect($data['role_ids'])->mapWithKeys(fn ($id) => [
                $id => ['org_unit_id' => $data['org_unit_id'] ?? null],
            ])->all()
        );

        return redirect()->route('users.index')->with('success', 'Pengguna berhasil ditambahkan.');
    }

    public function edit(Request $request, User $user): View
    {
        $this->ensure($request, 'user.manage');
        $user->load('roles');

        return view('users.form', [
            'user' => $user,
            'options' => $this->options(),
        ]);
    }

    public function update(Request $request, User $user): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->ensure($request, 'user.manage');

        $data = $request->validate([
            'name' => ['required', 'string', 'max:150'],
            'username' => ['required', 'alpha_dash', 'max:60', Rule::unique('users', 'username')->ignore($user->id)],
            'email' => ['nullable', 'email', 'max:150', Rule::unique('users', 'email')->ignore($user->id)],
            'employee_id' => ['nullable', 'exists:employees,id', Rule::unique('users', 'employee_id')->ignore($user->id)],
            'password' => ['nullable', 'confirmed', Password::min(8)],
            'is_active' => ['nullable', 'boolean'],
            'must_change_password' => ['nullable', 'boolean'],
            'role_ids' => ['required', 'array', 'min:1'],
            'role_ids.*' => ['exists:roles,id'],
            'org_unit_id' => ['nullable', 'exists:org_units,id'],
        ]);

        $attributes = [
            'name' => $data['name'],
            'username' => $data['username'],
            'email' => $data['email'] ?? null,
            'employee_id' => $data['employee_id'] ?? null,
            'is_active' => $request->boolean('is_active'),
            'must_change_password' => $request->boolean('must_change_password'),
        ];

        if (! empty($data['password'])) {
            $attributes['password'] = Hash::make($data['password']);
        }

        $user->update($attributes);

        $user->roles()->sync(
            collect($data['role_ids'])->mapWithKeys(fn ($id) => [
                $id => ['org_unit_id' => $data['org_unit_id'] ?? null],
            ])->all()
        );

        return redirect()->route('users.index')->with('success', 'Pengguna berhasil diperbarui.');
    }

    public function resetPassword(Request $request, User $user, AuditLogger $audit): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->ensure($request, 'user.reset_password');

        abort_if($user->id === $request->user()->id, 422, 'Gunakan menu ubah kata sandi untuk akun sendiri.');

        $temporary = Str::password(12);

        $user->forceFill([
            'password' => Hash::make($temporary),
            'must_change_password' => true,
        ])->save();

        $audit->recordRaw('update', $user->getMorphClass(), $user->id, null, [
            'password' => '[direset administrator]',
        ]);

        return redirect()
            ->route('users.index')
            ->with('success', "Kata sandi sementara untuk {$user->username}: {$temporary} (tampilkan sekali, minta pengguna segera mengganti).");
    }

    public function toggleActive(Request $request, User $user): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->ensure($request, 'user.deactivate');

        abort_if($user->id === $request->user()->id, 422, 'Anda tidak dapat menonaktifkan akun sendiri.');

        $user->update(['is_active' => ! $user->is_active]);

        return back()->with('success', $user->is_active ? 'Akun diaktifkan.' : 'Akun dinonaktifkan.');
    }

    protected function ensure(Request $request, string $permission): void
    {
        abort_unless(
            $request->user()->hasPermission($permission),
            403,
            'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses untuk tindakan ini.'
        );
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    protected function options(): array
    {
        return [
            'roles' => Role::query()->orderBy('name')->get(),
            'employees' => Employee::query()->orderBy('full_name')->pluck('full_name', 'id'),
            'orgUnits' => OrgUnit::query()->orderBy('level')->orderBy('name')->pluck('name', 'id'),
        ];
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Imports;

use App\Models\Education;
use App\Models\Employee;
use App\Models\ImportBatch;
use App\Models\OrgUnit;
use App\Models\Position;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Models\WorkLocation;
use App\Services\EmployeeService;
use Illuminate\Support\Carbon;
use Illuminate\Support\Collection;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Validator;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;
use Maatwebsite\Excel\Concerns\SkipsEmptyRows;
use Maatwebsite\Excel\Concerns\ToCollection;
use Maatwebsite\Excel\Concerns\WithCalculatedFormulas;
use Maatwebsite\Excel\Concerns\WithHeadingRow;
use PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Shared\Date as ExcelDate;
use Throwable;

class EmployeesImport implements SkipsEmptyRows, ToCollection, WithCalculatedFormulas, WithHeadingRow
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly User $actor,
        private readonly ImportBatch $batch
    ) {
    }

    public function collection(Collection $rows): void
    {
        $total = $rows->count();
        $success = 0;
        $errors = [];

        foreach ($rows as $index => $row) {
            $line = (int) $index + 2;
            $name = trim((string) ($row['nama_lengkap'] ?? ''));

            if ($name === '' || str_starts_with($name, 'CONTOH')) {
                $total--;
                continue;
            }

            try {
                $this->importRow($row);
                $success++;
            } catch (ValidationException $exception) {
                $errors[] = [
                    'row' => $line,
                    'messages' => collect($exception->errors())->flatten()->all(),
                ];
            } catch (Throwable $exception) {
                $errors[] = [
                    'row' => $line,
                    'messages' => [$exception->getMessage()],
                ];
            }
        }

        $failed = count($errors);
        $status = match (true) {
            $failed === 0 => 'completed',
            $success === 0 && $total > 0 => 'failed',
            default => 'completed_with_errors',
        };

        $this->batch->update([
            'total_rows' => max($total, 0),
            'success_rows' => $success,
            'failed_rows' => $failed,
            'status' => $status,
            'errors' => $errors === [] ? null : $errors,
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * @param  Collection<string, mixed>  $row
     */
    protected function importRow(Collection $row): void
    {
        $gender = match (strtolower(trim((string) ($row['jenis_kelamin'] ?? '')))) {
            'l', 'lk', 'laki-laki', 'laki laki', 'pria' => 'laki-laki',
            'p', 'pr', 'perempuan', 'wanita' => 'perempuan',
            default => null,
        };

        $nik = trim((string) ($row['nik'] ?? ''));

        $data = [
            'nip' => trim((string) ($row['nip'] ?? '')) ?: null,
            'full_name' => trim((string) $row['nama_lengkap']),
            'nik' => $nik ?: null,
            'gender' => $gender,
            'birth_place' => trim((string) ($row['tempat_lahir'] ?? '')) ?: null,
            'birth_date' => $this->parseDate($row['tanggal_lahir'] ?? null),
            'phone' => trim((string) ($row['telepon'] ?? '')) ?: null,
            'email' => trim((string) ($row['email'] ?? '')) ?: null,
            'employee_category' => strtolower(trim((string) ($row['kategori'] ?? 'tetap'))),
            'khidmah_type' => trim((string) ($row['jenis_khidmah'] ?? '')) ?: null,
            'employment_status' => strtolower(trim((string) ($row['status_kepegawaian'] ?? 'aktif'))),
            'hire_date' => $this->parseDate($row['tanggal_masuk'] ?? null),
            'marital_status' => 'lajang',
            'is_active' => true,
        ];

        $validator = Validator::make($data, [
            'nip' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:30', 'unique:employees,nip'],
            'full_name' => ['required', 'string', 'max:150'],
            'nik' => ['nullable', 'digits:16'],
            'gender' => ['required', 'in:laki-laki,perempuan'],
            'email' => ['nullable', 'email', 'max:150'],
            'employee_category' => ['required', 'in:tetap,harian,khidmah'],
            'employment_status' => ['required', 'in:aktif,probation,cuti_panjang,nonaktif,berhenti'],
            'hire_date' => ['required', 'date'],
            'birth_date' => ['nullable', 'date', 'before:today'],
        ], [
            'nip.unique' => 'NIP sudah digunakan.',
            'gender.required' => 'Jenis kelamin harus L atau P.',
            'hire_date.required' => 'Tanggal masuk wajib diisi (format DD-MM-YYYY).',
        ]);

        if ($validator->fails()) {
            throw new ValidationException($validator);
        }

        if ($nik) {
            $hash = hash('sha256', $nik);
            if (Employee::query()->where('nik_hash', $hash)->exists()) {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages(['nik' => 'NIK sudah terdaftar.']);
            }
        }

        $unitCode = trim((string) ($row['kode_unit'] ?? ''));
        if ($unitCode !== '') {
            $unit = OrgUnit::query()->whereRaw('LOWER(code) = ?', [strtolower($unitCode)])->first();
            if (! $unit) {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages(['kode_unit' => "Kode unit '{$unitCode}' tidak ditemukan."]);
            }
            $data['org_unit_id'] = $unit->id;
        }

        $positionCode = trim((string) ($row['kode_jabatan'] ?? ''));
        if ($positionCode !== '') {
            $position = Position::query()->whereRaw('LOWER(code) = ?', [strtolower($positionCode)])->first();
            if (! $position) {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages(['kode_jabatan' => "Kode jabatan '{$positionCode}' tidak ditemukan."]);
            }
            $data['position_id'] = $position->id;
        }

        $locationCode = trim((string) ($row['kode_lokasi'] ?? ''));
        if ($locationCode !== '') {
            $location = WorkLocation::query()->whereRaw('LOWER(code) = ?', [strtolower($locationCode)])->first();
            if (! $location) {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages(['kode_lokasi' => "Kode lokasi '{$locationCode}' tidak ditemukan."]);
            }
            $data['work_location_id'] = $location->id;
        }

        $educationCode = trim((string) ($row['kode_pendidikan'] ?? ''));
        if ($educationCode !== '') {
            $education = Education::query()->whereRaw('LOWER(code) = ?', [strtolower($educationCode)])->first();
            if (! $education) {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages(['kode_pendidikan' => "Kode pendidikan '{$educationCode}' tidak ditemukan."]);
            }
            $data['education_id'] = $education->id;
        }

        $dependents = trim((string) ($row['jumlah_tanggungan'] ?? ''));
        if ($dependents !== '') {
            if (! is_numeric($dependents) || (int) $dependents < 0 || (int) $dependents > 3) {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages(['jumlah_tanggungan' => 'Jumlah tanggungan harus 0–3.']);
            }
            $data['dependents_count'] = (int) $dependents;
        }

        $taxStatus = trim((string) ($row['status_pajak'] ?? ''));
        if ($taxStatus !== '' && ! in_array($taxStatus, ['TK/0', 'TK/1', 'TK/2', 'TK/3', 'K/0', 'K/1', 'K/2', 'K/3'], true)) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['status_pajak' => 'Status pajak tidak valid.']);
        }

        $employee = app(EmployeeService::class)->create($data, $this->actor);

        if ($taxStatus !== '') {
            $employee->payrollProfile()->update(['tax_status' => $taxStatus]);
        }
    }

    protected function parseDate(mixed $value): ?string
    {
        if ($value === null || $value === '') {
            return null;
        }

        if (is_numeric($value)) {
            return Carbon::instance(ExcelDate::excelToDateTimeObject((float) $value))->format('Y-m-d');
        }

        foreach (['d-m-Y', 'd/m/Y', 'Y-m-d'] as $format) {
            try {
                $date = Carbon::createFromFormat($format, trim((string) $value));
                if ($date !== false) {
                    return $date->format('Y-m-d');
                }
            } catch (Throwable) {
                // coba format berikutnya
            }
        }

        throw ValidationException::withMessages([
            'tanggal' => "Tanggal '{$value}' tidak dikenali. Gunakan format DD-MM-YYYY.",
        ]);
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Support;

use Carbon\CarbonInterface;
use Illuminate\Support\Carbon;

class Format
{
    public static function date(mixed $value): string
    {
        if (blank($value)) {
            return '—';
        }

        return Carbon::parse($value)->timezone('Asia/Jakarta')->format('d-m-Y');
    }

    public static function dateTime(mixed $value): string
    {
        if (blank($value)) {
            return '—';
        }

        return Carbon::parse($value)->timezone('Asia/Jakarta')->format('d-m-Y H:i');
    }

    public static function money(mixed $value): string
    {
        if (blank($value)) {
            return '—';
        }

        return 'Rp '.number_format((float) $value, 0, ',', '.');
    }

    public static function time(mixed $value): string
    {
        return blank($value) ? '—' : substr((string) $value, 0, 5);
    }

    public static function dayName(int $day): string
    {
        return ['', 'Senin', 'Selasa', 'Rabu', 'Kamis', 'Jumat', 'Sabtu', 'Minggu'][$day] ?? '—';
    }
}

use Illuminate\Database\Seeder;

class RolePermissionSeeder extends Seeder
{
    public function run(): void
    {
        $data = require database_path('seeders/data/permissions.php');

        $roles = [
            'administrator' => ['Administrator', 'Mengelola sistem, pengguna, dan peran; akses payroll dibatasi sesuai matriks.'],
            'pimpinan' => ['Pimpinan', 'Melihat seluruh data dan melakukan persetujuan akhir.'],
            'kepala_bagian' => ['Kepala Bidang/Bagian', 'Mengelola dan melihat data unit kerja beserta turunannya.'],
            'hrd' => ['HRD', 'Mengelola data pegawai, administrasi, dan verifikasi.'],
            'keuangan' => ['Keuangan', 'Mengelola payroll, BPJS, pajak, dan laporan keuangan.'],
            'pegawai' => ['Pegawai', 'Mengakses data dan dokumen milik sendiri.'],
        ];

        foreach ($roles as $code => [$name, $description]) {
            Role::updateOrCreate(
                ['code' => $code],
                ['name' => $name, 'description' => $description, 'is_system' => true]
            );
        }

        foreach ($data['permissions'] as $permission) {
            Permission::updateOrCreate(
                ['code' => $permission['code']],
                ['name' => $permission['name'], 'module' => $permission['module']]
            );
        }

        $permissionIds = Permission::query()->pluck('id', 'code');

        foreach ($data['roles'] as $roleCode => $codes) {
            $role = Role::where('code', $roleCode)->first();
            if (! $role) {
                continue;
            }

            $ids = collect($codes)
                ->map(fn (string $code) => $permissionIds[$code] ?? null)
                ->filter()
                ->values()
                ->all();

            $role->permissions()->sync($ids);
        }
    }
}

namespace Tests;

use App\Models\Role;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\TestCase as BaseTestCase;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Hash;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;

abstract class TestCase extends BaseTestCase
{
    /**
     * @param  array<int, string>  $permissions
     */
    protected function userWithPermissions(
        array $permissions = [],
        array $attributes = [],
        ?int $orgUnitId = null
    ): User {
        $role = Role::create([
            'code' => 'test_'.Str::lower(Str::random(8)),
            'name' => 'Peran Uji',
            'is_system' => false,
        ]);

        foreach ($permissions as $code) {
            $permission = Permission::firstOrCreate(
                ['code' => $code],
                ['name' => $code, 'module' => 'uji']
            );
            $role->permissions()->syncWithoutDetaching([$permission->id]);
        }

        $user = User::create(array_merge([
            'name' => 'Pengguna Uji',
            'username' => 'uji_'.Str::lower(Str::random(8)),
            'email' => Str::lower(Str::random(8)).'@example.test',
            'password' => Hash::make('password'),
            'is_active' => true,
            'must_change_password' => false,
        ], $attributes));

        $user->roles()->attach($role, ['org_unit_id' => $orgUnitId]);

        return $user->fresh();
    }

    /**

        ], $overrides));
    }
}

class AuthTest extends TestCase
{
    use RefreshDatabase;

    public function test_halaman_login_dapat_diakses(): void
    {
        $this->get('/login')->assertOk()->assertSee('Masuk ke akun Anda');
    }

    public function test_pengguna_aktif_dapat_masuk_dan_riwayat_dicatat(): void
    {
        $user = User::factory()->create([
            'username' => 'pengguna.aktif',
            'password' => Hash::make('Rahasia#123'),
            'is_active' => true,
        ]);

        $response = $this->post('/login', [
            'username' => 'pengguna.aktif',
            'password' => 'Rahasia#123',
        ]);

        $response->assertRedirect(route('dashboard'));
        $this->assertAuthenticatedAs($user);
        $this->assertDatabaseHas('login_histories', [
            'user_id' => $user->id,
            'success' => true,
        ]);
        $this->assertNotNull($user->fresh()->last_login_at);
    }

    public function test_kata_sandi_salah_ditolak_dan_dicatat(): void
    {
        User::factory()->create([
            'username' => 'pengguna.gagal',
            'password' => Hash::make('Benar#123'),
        ]);

        $this->from('/login')->post('/login', [
            'username' => 'pengguna.gagal',
            'password' => 'Salah#123',
        ])->assertRedirect('/login');

        $this->assertGuest();
        $this->assertDatabaseHas('login_histories', [
            'username_attempt' => 'pengguna.gagal',
            'success' => false,
            'failure_reason' => 'invalid_credentials',
        ]);
    }

    public function test_akun_nonaktif_tidak_dapat_masuk(): void
    {
        User::factory()->create([
            'username' => 'pengguna.nonaktif',

        ]);

        $this->post('/login', [
            'username' => 'pengguna.nonaktif',
            'password' => 'Rahasia#123',
        ])->assertSessionHasErrors('username');

        $this->assertGuest();
        $this->assertDatabaseHas('login_histories', [
            'username_attempt' => 'pengguna.nonaktif',
            'success' => false,
            'failure_reason' => 'inactive',
        ]);
    }

            'marital_status' => 'lajang',
            'employee_category' => 'tetap',
            'employment_status' => 'aktif',
            'hire_date' => '2026-01-05',
            'phone' => '081299999999',

    {
        $employee = $this->makeEmployee(['full_name' => 'Pegawai Hapus']);

use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Tests\TestCase;

class AuditTrailTest extends TestCase
{
    use RefreshDatabase;

    public function test_pembuatan_pegawai_menulis_audit_dengan_nik_disembunyikan(): void
    {
        $actor = $this->userWithPermissions(['employee.create']);
        $this->actingAs($actor);

        app(EmployeeService::class)->create([
            'full_name' => 'Pegawai Audit',
            'nik' => '3200000000000021',
            'gender' => 'laki-laki',
            'marital_status' => 'lajang',
            'employee_category' => 'tetap',
            'employment_status' => 'aktif',
            'hire_date' => '2026-02-02',
        ], $actor);

        $log = AuditLog::where('event', 'create')->latest('id')->firstOrFail();

        $this->assertSame('Pegawai Audit', $log->new_values['full_name']);
        $this->assertSame('[disembunyikan]', $log->new_values['nik']);
        $this->assertSame($actor->id, $log->user_id);
    }

    public function test_perubahan_data_pegawai_menyimpan_nilai_lama_dan_baru(): void
    {
        $actor = $this->userWithPermissions(['employee.update']);
        $this->actingAs($actor);

        $employee = $this->makeEmployee(['full_name' => 'Pegawai Audit Ubah', 'phone' => '081200000000']);

        app(EmployeeService::class)->update($employee, ['phone' => '081277777777'], $actor);

        $log = AuditLog::where('event', 'update')->latest('id')->firstOrFail();

        $this->assertSame('081200000000', $log->old_values['phone']);
        $this->assertSame('081277777777', $log->new_values['phone']);
    }

    public function test_nomor_urut_tahun_dan_padding(): void
    {
        NumberSequence::create([
            'code' => 'nip',
            'prefix' => 'PIS',
            'pattern' => '{prefix}-{year}-{seq:4}',
            'next_number' => 1,
            'padding' => 4,
            'reset_period' => 'yearly',
        ]);

        $service = app(\App\Services\NumberSequenceService::class);

        $first = $service->next('nip', now()->setDate(2026, 1, 2));
        $second = $service->next('nip', now()->setDate(2026, 1, 2));

        $this->assertSame('PIS-2026-0001', $first);
        $this->assertSame('PIS-2026-0002', $second);

        NumberSequence::where('code', 'nip')->update([
            'next_number' => 9,
            'last_reset_at' => '2025-01-01',
        ]);

        $this->assertSame('PIS-2026-0001', $service->next('nip', now()->setDate(2026, 1, 3)));
    }
}

<?php

namespace Tests\Feature;

use App\Models\Employee;
use App\Models\User;
use Database\Seeders\DatabaseSeeder;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Tests\TestCase;

class SmokePagesTest extends TestCase
{
    use RefreshDatabase;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        $this->seed(DatabaseSeeder::class);
    }

    public function test_halaman_utama_admin_dapat_dibuka(): void
    {
        $admin = User::where('username', 'admin')->firstOrFail();

        $this->actingAs($admin)->get('/')->assertOk()->assertSee('Dasbor');
    }

    public function test_halaman_master_dan_sistem_dapat_dibuka_admin(): void
    {
        $admin = User::where('username', 'admin')->firstOrFail();

        $paths = [
            '/pegawai',
            '/master/org-units',
            '/master/positions',
            '/master/work-locations',
            '/master/educations',
            '/master/work-shifts',
            '/master/holidays',
            '/jadwal-kerja',
            '/penugasan-jadwal',
            '/pengguna',
            '/pengguna/tambah',
            '/peran',
            '/audit',
            '/riwayat-login',
            '/pengaturan',
        ];

        foreach ($paths as $path) {
            $this->actingAs($admin)->get($path)->assertOk();
        }
    }

    public function test_hrd_dapat_membuka_detail_pegawai_dan_form(): void
    {
        $hrd = User::where('username', 'hrd.demo')->firstOrFail();
        $employee = Employee::query()->where('full_name', 'like', 'DEMO — Ahmad%')->firstOrFail();

        $this->actingAs($hrd)->get('/pegawai/tambah')->assertOk();
        $this->actingAs($hrd)->get(route('employees.show', $employee))->assertOk()->assertSee($employee->nip);
        $this->actingAs($hrd)->get(route('employees.edit', $employee))->assertOk();
        $this->actingAs($hrd)->get('/pegawai/impor')->assertOk();
    }

    public function test_pegawai_hanya_melihat_profil_sendiri(): void
    {
        $user = User::where('username', 'pegawai.demo')->firstOrFail();
        $employee = $user->employee;

        $this->actingAs($user)->get('/profil')->assertOk()->assertSee($employee->full_name);
        $this->actingAs($user)->get('/pegawai')->assertOk();
        $this->actingAs($user)->get('/pegawai/tambah')->assertForbidden();
        $this->actingAs($user)->get('/pengguna')->assertForbidden();
        $this->actingAs($user)->get('/audit')->assertForbidden();
    }
}

- 18 migration berjalan pada MySQL: pengguna/akses, organisasi, pegawai, administrasi pegawai, jadwal, pengaturan, sistem.
- Vite + Tailwind 4; aset produksi terbentuk di `public/build`.
- Paket: `maatwebsite/excel`, `barryvdh/laravel-dompdf`, `intervention/image`, `livewire` (terpasang, belum dipakai).

### 4.2 Modul fungsional
| Modul | Implementasi |
|---|---|
| Autentikasi | Login username/email, rate limit 5/menit, catat `login_histories`, akun nonaktif ditolak, wajib ganti sandi |
| RBAC | 6 peran, 114 permission dari `ACCESS_CONTROL.md`, `Gate::before`, middleware `permission`, cakupan unit |
| Organisasi | CRUD unit (hierarki + level otomatis), jabatan, lokasi kerja, jenjang pendidikan |
| Master pegawai | CRUD lengkap, NIP otomatis `PIS-{tahun}-{urut:4}`, NIK terenkripsi + hash unik, foto |
| Data pribadi | Keluarga, pendidikan, rekening (terenkripsi), dokumen privat + verifikasi, riwayat status & penempatan |
| Profil gaji | Pendidikan, tanggungan, pajak, BPJS/NPWP terenkripsi; nilai khusus hanya Keuangan + alasan |
| Impor/ekspor | Template XLSX, impor per baris dengan laporan galat (`import_batches`), ekspor XLSX |
| Jadwal kerja | Shift, pola mingguan, penugasan per pegawai dengan cek tumpang tindih |
| Pengguna & peran | CRUD pengguna, reset sandi sementara, aktif/nonaktif, editor matriks hak akses |
| Audit & login | Audit append-only dengan masking data sensitif, riwayat login, pengaturan sistem |

### 4.3 Data DEMO
| Akun | Sandi | Peran |
|---|---|---|
| `admin` | `Admin#2026` | administrator |
| `hrd.demo` | `Demo#2026` | hrd |
| `keuangan.demo` | `Demo#2026` | keuangan |
| `pimpinan.demo` | `Demo#2026` | pimpinan |
| `kepala.demo` | `Demo#2026` | kepala_bagian |
| `pegawai.demo` | `Demo#2026` | pegawai |

5 pegawai DEMO, 7 unit organisasi DEMO, 8 jabatan, 1 lokasi, 1 shift, 1 jadwal, 1 hari libur DEMO, 8 pengaturan.

---

## 5. Keputusan penting tahap ini

1. Stack aktual: **Laravel 13.43 + PHP 8.3.36 + MySQL 8.4.9**, Blade + Tailwind 4 (Livewire belum dipakai).
2. RBAC ditulis khusus (`roles`, `permissions`, `permission_role`, `role_user.org_unit_id`) agar cocok dengan desain database.
3. Kolom sensitif (`nik`, `account_number`, `npwp`, `bpjs_*`) memakai cast `encrypted`; NIK punya `nik_hash` SHA-256 untuk keunikan.
4. Berkas privat disimpan di `storage/app/private`, bukan `public`.
5. Audit menyamarkan nilai sensitif menjadi `[disembunyikan]` dan tidak memiliki rute hapus.
6. Administrator **tidak** otomatis mendapat akses payroll/data pribadi; sesuai matriks dipakai akun HRD/Keuangan.
7. Tarif gaji/pajak tetap tidak diisi sampai klarifikasi K-01..K-04 dan K-09.

---

## 6. Kendala dan risiko saat ini

| # | Kendala | Dampak | Rencana |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | MySQL belum terdaftar sebagai Windows service | Server harus dijalankan manual | Daftarkan service atau dokumentasikan skrip mulai |
| 2 | Avast Web/Mail Shield memutus TLS Composer | Instalasi paket gagal tanpa CA lokal | Gunakan `COMPOSER_CAFILE` (sudah diset) |
| 3 | Koordinat/radius lokasi nyata belum ada (K-13) | Presensi hanya bisa diuji dengan lokasi DEMO | Minta data lokasi |
| 4 | Rumus payroll belum final (K-01..K-04, K-09) | Payroll produksi tidak boleh dijalankan | Klarifikasi sebelum Tahap 5 |
| 5 | Berkas Excel asli belum tersedia (K-22) | Impor diuji dengan baris sintetis | Minta contoh berkas |
| 6 | Struktur organisasi aktual belum ada (K-31) | Master organisasi memakai DEMO | Minta struktur resmi |
| 7 | Email/SMTP belum dikonfirmasi (K-34) | Reset sandi via email belum aktif | Konfirmasi infrastruktur |
| 8 | Ekspor Excel, unggah dokumen/foto, tampilan peramban belum diuji end-to-end | Ada risiko cacat alur berkas | Uji manual sebelum Tahap 3 |

---

## 7. Cara menjalankan

```powershell
# 1. Pastikan MySQL berjalan (port 3306)

# 2. Siapkan basis data (sekali saja)
mysql -u root -e "CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS pis_kepegawaian CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci;"

# 3. Migration + data DEMO
php artisan migrate:fresh --seed

# 4. Aset frontend
npm install
npm run build

# 5. Jalankan aplikasi
php artisan serve
```

Buka `http://127.0.0.1:8000`, masuk dengan akun DEMO pada §4.3.

Pengujian:

```powershell
php artisan test        # MySQL pis_kepegawaian_test
python scripts\check_docs.py
```

---

## 8. Pekerjaan berikutnya (Tahap 3)

1. Jawab klarifikasi yang menghambat: K-01..K-04, K-09, K-13, K-22, K-23, K-31, K-34.
2. Rekrutmen pelamar, kontrak kerja, SK, mutasi, surat — sesuai `DEVELOPMENT_ROADMAP.md`.
3. Uji manual alur berkas yang belum tercakup (ekspor Excel, unggah dokumen/foto, tampilan peramban).
4. Perbarui `TEST_REPORT.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`, dan dokumen ini setiap tahap.

---

| 18-11-2026 | 1.1 | Tahap 2 selesai; toolchain terpasang, fondasi aplikasi berjalan, 29 uji lulus |
