# Aplikasi Kepegawaian PIS

Sistem Informasi Manajemen Kepegawaian (HRIS) untuk **Pesantren Imam Syafi'i**, Sukamakmur, Aceh Besar.

> **Status: Tahap 2 selesai — fondasi sistem berjalan.**
> Login, RBAC, organisasi, master pegawai, data pribadi/administrasi, impor–ekspor Excel, dan audit trail sudah tersedia. Modul Tahap 3–8 belum dikerjakan.

---

## Ringkasan proyek

| Atribut | Nilai |
|---|---|
| Platform | Web application responsif (komputer, tablet, HP) |
| Stack | Laravel 13.43.0 · PHP 8.3.36 · MySQL 8.4.9 · Blade · Tailwind CSS 4 · Vite 7 |
| Metode absensi | Presensi mandiri dengan GPS radius + foto selfie (Tahap 4) |
| Database | Satu database terpusat (`pis_kepegawaian`) |
| Bahasa | Indonesia · Rupiah · DD-MM-YYYY · Asia/Jakarta |
| Tahap | 2 dari 8 |

## Dokumentasi

| Dokumen | Isi |
|---|---|
| [`docs/MASTER_SPECIFICATION.md`](docs/MASTER_SPECIFICATION.md) | Keputusan induk yang mengikat |
| [`docs/SRS.md`](docs/SRS.md) | Kebutuhan fungsional & non-fungsional |
| [`docs/DATABASE_DESIGN.md`](docs/DATABASE_DESIGN.md) | ERD & spesifikasi 78 tabel |
| [`docs/BUSINESS_PROCESS.md`](docs/BUSINESS_PROCESS.md) | Alur proses bisnis & persetujuan |
| [`docs/UI_UX_SPECIFICATION.md`](docs/UI_UX_SPECIFICATION.md) | Desain antarmuka & pengalaman pengguna |
| [`docs/ACCESS_CONTROL.md`](docs/ACCESS_CONTROL.md) | Peran, permission, scope data |
| [`docs/TECHNICAL_ARCHITECTURE.md`](docs/TECHNICAL_ARCHITECTURE.md) | Arsitektur, keamanan, deployment |
| [`docs/DEVELOPMENT_ROADMAP.md`](docs/DEVELOPMENT_ROADMAP.md) | Rencana 8 tahap |
| [`docs/CLARIFICATIONS.md`](docs/CLARIFICATIONS.md) | Pertanyaan yang harus dijawab pesantren |
| [`docs/DEVELOPMENT_PROGRESS.md`](docs/DEVELOPMENT_PROGRESS.md) | Progres & kendala |
| [`docs/TEST_REPORT.md`](docs/TEST_REPORT.md) | Hasil pengujian yang benar-benar dijalankan |
| [`docs/CHANGELOG.md`](docs/CHANGELOG.md) | Riwayat perubahan |

Dokumen sumber: [`Prompt_Induk_Aplikasi_Kepegawaian_PIS.md`](Prompt_Induk_Aplikasi_Kepegawaian_PIS.md).

## Modul

Sudah tersedia (Tahap 2): autentikasi · RBAC · struktur organisasi · master pegawai · data keluarga/pendidikan/rekening/dokumen · riwayat status & penempatan · profil penggajian · jadwal kerja · pengguna & peran · audit trail · riwayat login · pengaturan.

Belum tersedia: rekrutmen · kontrak/SK/mutasi/surat (Tahap 3) · absensi GPS & izin (Tahap 4) · payroll/BPJS/PPh 21 (Tahap 5) · KPI & pembinaan (Tahap 6) · laporan & notifikasi (Tahap 7) · deployment/UAT (Tahap 8).

## Struktur folder

```
D:\APLIKASI KEPEGAWAIAN
├── Prompt_Induk_Aplikasi_Kepegawaian_PIS.md   # dokumen sumber (jangan diubah)
├── README.md
├── app/                                       # controller, model, service, middleware
├── bootstrap/                                 # alias middleware & konfigurasi aplikasi
├── config/
├── database/
│   ├── migrations/                            # 18 migration MySQL
│   ├── seeders/                               # permission, master DEMO, akun DEMO
│   └── factories/
├── docs/                                      # blueprint + laporan
├── resources/
│   ├── css/ · js/                             # Tailwind 4 + Vite
│   └── views/                                 # Blade (layout, master, pegawai, dll.)
├── routes/web.php
├── scripts/check_docs.py                      # pemeriksaan konsistensi dokumen
├── storage/app/private/                       # foto & dokumen pegawai (privat)
└── tests/                                     # pengujian otomatis
```

## Menjalankan aplikasi

Prasyarat: PHP ≥ 8.3 dengan ekstensi `openssl`, `pdo_mysql`, `mbstring`, `fileinfo`, `gd`, `intl`, `zip`, `bcmath`, `curl`; Composer; MySQL 8.4; Node.js + npm.

```powershell
# 1. Pastikan server MySQL berjalan pada port 3306

# 2. Siapkan basis data (sekali saja)
mysql -u root -e "CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS pis_kepegawaian CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci;"

# 3. Migration + data DEMO
php artisan migrate:fresh --seed

# 4. Aset frontend
npm install
npm run build

# 5. Jalankan
php artisan serve
```

Buka `http://127.0.0.1:8000`.

### Akun DEMO

| Username | Sandi | Peran |
|---|---|---|
| `admin` | `Admin#2026` | Administrator |
| `hrd.demo` | `Demo#2026` | HRD |
| `keuangan.demo` | `Demo#2026` | Keuangan |
| `pimpinan.demo` | `Demo#2026` | Pimpinan |
| `kepala.demo` | `Demo#2026` | Kepala Bidang/Bagian |
| `pegawai.demo` | `Demo#2026` | Pegawai |

Administrator sengaja **tidak** memiliki akses payroll/data pribadi; gunakan akun HRD atau Keuangan untuk menguji area tersebut.

## Pengujian

```powershell
php artisan test              # MySQL pis_kepegawaian_test
python scripts\check_docs.py  # konsistensi dokumen
```

Hasil terakhir: **29 lulus, 0 gagal, 106 assertion** (lihat `docs/TEST_REPORT.md`).

## Status lingkungan pengembangan

| Komponen | Status |
|---|---|
| PHP 8.3.36 | ✅ terpasang, ekstensi lengkap |
| Composer 2.11.2 | ✅ terpasang (CA lokal untuk Avast Web/Mail Shield) |
| MySQL 8.4.9 | ✅ berjalan manual, port 3306 |
| Node.js 26.13.0 / npm 11.20.0 | ✅ tersedia |
| Git 2.56.0 | ✅ terpasang |

Catatan: MySQL belum terdaftar sebagai Windows service; jalankan server manual dengan datadir `C:\Users\USER\AppData\Local\mysql-data` bila perlu.

## Aturan penting bagi pengembang berikutnya

1. Jangan membuat proyek atau database baru; lanjutkan yang sama.
2. Jangan mengubah keputusan bisnis tanpa persetujuan (lihat `CLARIFICATIONS.md`).
3. Jangan menanam angka gaji/pajak/BPJS di kode — gunakan konfigurasi bertanggal.
4. Jangan mengklaim fitur yang belum diimplementasikan atau diuji.
5. Data demonstrasi wajib berlabel `DEMO`.
6. Kolom sensitif wajib memakai cast `encrypted`; berkas privat disimpan di `storage/app/private`.
7. Perbarui `DEVELOPMENT_PROGRESS.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`, dan `TEST_REPORT.md` setiap tahap.

## Objective
- Build the "Aplikasi Kepegawaian PIS" (Pesantren Imam Syafi'i HRIS) in the 8 stages defined by `Prompt_Induk_Aplikasi_Kepegawaian_PIS.md`.
- Stage 2 (auth, RBAC, organization, employee master, Excel, audit) is complete and verified; the user has now asked to proceed to Stage 3 (recruitment and HR administration).

## Requirements
- Follow the Indonesian master prompt: 8 sequential stages, one project/one MySQL database, no fabricated policies/features, no claimed untested completion, no hardcoded salary/tax rates.
- UI language Indonesian; currency IDR; dates DD-MM-YYYY; timezone Asia/Jakarta; DEMO data must be labeled.
- User confirmed "semua berjalan lancar" for Stage 2 and said "oke lanjut ke tahap berikutnya".
- Stage 3 scope (from roadmap): recruitment (vacancies, applicants, documents, interviews, weighted scores), applicant→employee conversion, contracts + renewal + H-30/H-14/H-7 reminders, decrees (SK), mutations/position changes, document templates + numbering + PDF, letters, approval workflow per document type, end-to-end tests, module docs.
- Latest answered user question was "bagaimana cara masuknya" — login instructions and DEMO credentials were provided, and the app server was started.

## Decisions
- Stack: Laravel 13.43.0 + PHP 8.3.36 + MySQL 8.4.9, Blade + Tailwind 4 + Vite; Livewire 4.4 installed but unused (controllers/Blade).
- Custom RBAC (`roles`, `permissions`, `permission_role`, `role_user.org_unit_id`) matching the designed schema; `Gate::before` delegates to `User::hasPermission()`.
- Private files under `storage/app/private`; sensitive fields (`nik`, `account_number`, `npwp`, `bpjs_*`) use encrypted casts; `nik_hash` SHA-256 for uniqueness; audit masks sensitive values as `[disembunyikan]`.
- NIP format `PIS-{year}-{seq:4}` via `NumberSequenceService`; sequences for `contract`, `decree`, `letter` already seeded with patterns `KTR/{year}/{seq:4}`, `SK/{year}/{seq:4}`, `SRT/{year}/{seq:4}` (still assumptions pending K-18).
- Master data CRUD is generic (`MasterData` definitions + `MasterDataController` + shared views).
- Stage 2 demo data: 6 users, 5 employees, 7 org units, 8 positions, 1 location, 1 shift, 1 schedule, 1 holiday, 8 settings, 114 permissions, 6 roles.
- Stage 3 approval design: generic four-table approval engine (`approval_flows`, `approval_flow_steps`, `approval_instances`, `approval_actions`) with rule `actor_id != requested_by`.
- Stage 3 numbering/templates: use existing `DocumentTemplate` model/table and `NumberSequenceService`; no invented legal numbering format.

## Work State
### Completed
- Stage 1 blueprint complete (17 doc checks pass via `python scripts/check_docs.py`).
- Stage 2 fully implemented and verified: 18 migrations, models, services, middleware, controllers, routes (98), Blade views, seeders, Excel import/export, audit trail, schedules, users/roles, settings.
- All failing tests fixed; final result **29 passed, 106 assertions, 0 failed** (`php artisan test`, MySQL `pis_kepegawaian_test`).
- Added `tests/Feature/SmokePagesTest.php` (4 tests) exercising real seeded DEMO pages for admin/HRD/employee.
- Docs updated: `docs/TEST_REPORT.md` (Stage 2 sections), `docs/DEVELOPMENT_PROGRESS.md` v1.1, `docs/CHANGELOG.md` 0.2.0, `README.md` rewrite, `docs/TECHNICAL_ARCHITECTURE.md` §1.1/§14, `.gitignore` (`/.tools`, `/storage/app/private/employees`).
- Verified login flow and started the app: `http://127.0.0.1:8000` (background `php artisan serve`, PID 14148); MySQL listening on 3306 (PID 11684).
- Login instructions and DEMO credentials provided to the user; user confirmed everything runs smoothly.
- Stage 3 documentation research completed: roadmap §Tahap 3, SRS §3.5/§3.6, DB design §6–§8, business processes §2–§5/§12–§14, access-control permissions, clarifications K-08/K-16/K-18/K-26, and current `employees`/`employee_assignments` migrations.

### Active
- Stage 3 implementation not yet started (no new migrations/models/controllers written yet).
- Planned work queue: migrations for recruitment/HR-admin/approvals/notifications → models → services (approval engine, contract reminders, PDF render) → controllers/routes/views → seeders for approval flows/doc templates → tests → docs.

### Blocked
- K-18 unanswered: official NIP/contract/SK/letter numbering formats; current patterns are temporary assumptions.
- K-26 unanswered: which SK/decisions require Yayasan approval and who the authorized officials are.

Create Stage 3 migrations: `job_vacancies`, `applicants`, `applicant_documents`, `interviews`, `applicant_scores`, `employment_contracts`, `decrees`, `mutations`, `employee_letters`, `approval_flows`, `approval_flow_steps`, `approval_instances`, `approval_actions`, `notifications` (follow `docs/DATABASE_DESIGN.md` §6–§8/§12.1).

<?php

namespace App\Services;

use App\Models\Notification;
use App\Models\Role;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Support\Collection;

class NotificationService
{
    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $data
     */
    public function send(
        User $user,
        string $type,
        string $title,
        string $message,
        array $data = []
    ): ?Notification {
        if (! $user->is_active) {
            return null;
        }

        if (isset($data['dedupe_key'])) {
            $exists = Notification::query()
                ->where('user_id', $user->id)
                ->where('type', $type)
                ->where('data->dedupe_key', $data['dedupe_key'])
                ->exists();

            if ($exists) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        return Notification::create([
            'user_id' => $user->id,
            'type' => $type,
            'title' => $title,
            'message' => $message,
            'data' => $data ?: null,
        ]);

            ->get();

<?php

namespace App\Services;

use App\Contracts\Approvable;
use App\Models\ApprovalFlow;
use App\Models\ApprovalFlowStep;
use App\Models\ApprovalInstance;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use Illuminate\Support\Collection;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;

class ApprovalService
{
    public function __construct(private readonly NotificationService $notifications)
    {
    }

    public function submit(Approvable $subject, User $requester): ApprovalInstance
    {
        if (! $subject instanceof Model) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['approval' => 'Objek persetujuan tidak valid.']);
        }

        return DB::transaction(function () use ($subject, $requester): ApprovalInstance {
            $existing = ApprovalInstance::query()
                ->where('subject_type', $subject->getMorphClass())
                ->where('subject_id', $subject->getKey())
                ->where('status', 'menunggu')
                ->lockForUpdate()
                ->first();

            if ($existing) {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                    'approval' => 'Dokumen ini sudah memiliki pengajuan persetujuan yang masih berjalan.',
                ]);
            }

            $flow = ApprovalFlow::query()
                ->where('code', $subject->approvalFlowCode())
                ->where('is_active', true)
                ->with('steps')
                ->first();

            if (! $flow || $flow->steps->isEmpty()) {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                    'approval' => 'Alur persetujuan belum dikonfigurasi untuk jenis dokumen ini.',
                ]);
            }

            foreach ($flow->steps->where('is_optional', false) as $step) {
                if ($this->candidates($step, $subject)->isEmpty()) {
                    throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                        'approval' => 'Tidak ada pejabat aktif yang memenuhi syarat pada langkah '.$step->sequence.'.',
                    ]);
                }
            }

            $instance = ApprovalInstance::create([
                'approval_flow_id' => $flow->id,
                'subject_type' => $subject->getMorphClass(),
                'subject_id' => $subject->getKey(),
                'status' => 'menunggu',
                'current_step' => $flow->steps->first()->sequence,
                'requested_by' => $requester->id,
                'requested_at' => now(),
            ]);

            $subject->markApprovalPending();
            $this->notifyStep($instance->fresh('flow.steps'), $subject);

            return $instance;
        });
    }

    public function approve(ApprovalInstance $instance, User $actor, ?string $note = null): void
    {
        DB::transaction(function () use ($instance, $actor, $note): void {
            $instance = ApprovalInstance::query()->lockForUpdate()->findOrFail($instance->id);
            $this->assertActionable($instance, $actor);

            $step = $instance->currentStep();
            if (! $step) {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages(['approval' => 'Langkah persetujuan tidak ditemukan.']);
            }

            $this->assertActorAllowed($instance, $step, $actor);

            $instance->actions()->create([
                'sequence' => $step->sequence,
                'actor_id' => $actor->id,
                'action' => 'setuju',
                'note' => $note,
                'acted_at' => now(),
            ]);

            $next = $this->nextStep($instance, $step->sequence);

            if ($next) {
                $instance->update(['current_step' => $next->sequence]);
                $subject = $instance->subject;
                if ($subject instanceof Approvable) {
                    $this->notifyStep($instance->fresh('flow.steps'), $subject);
                }

                return;
            }

            $instance->update([
                'status' => 'disetujui',
                'completed_at' => now(),
            ]);

            $subject = $instance->subject;
            if ($subject instanceof Approvable) {
                $subject->markApprovalApproved($actor);
                $this->notifications->send(
                    $instance->requester,
                    'approval',
                    'Pengajuan disetujui',
                    $subject->approvalLabel().' telah disetujui.',
                    ['approval_instance_id' => $instance->id]
                );
            }
        });
    }

    public function reject(ApprovalInstance $instance, User $actor, string $note): void
    {
        if (trim($note) === '') {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['note' => 'Alasan penolakan wajib diisi.']);
        }

        DB::transaction(function () use ($instance, $actor, $note): void {
            $instance = ApprovalInstance::query()->lockForUpdate()->findOrFail($instance->id);
            $this->assertActionable($instance, $actor);

            $step = $instance->currentStep();
            if (! $step) {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages(['approval' => 'Langkah persetujuan tidak ditemukan.']);
            }

            $this->assertActorAllowed($instance, $step, $actor);

            $instance->actions()->create([
                'sequence' => $step->sequence,
                'actor_id' => $actor->id,
                'action' => 'tolak',
                'note' => $note,
                'acted_at' => now(),
            ]);

            $instance->update([
                'status' => 'ditolak',
                'completed_at' => now(),
            ]);

            $subject = $instance->subject;
            if ($subject instanceof Approvable) {
                $subject->markApprovalRejected($actor, $note);
                $this->notifications->send(
                    $instance->requester,
                    'approval',
                    'Pengajuan ditolak',
                    $subject->approvalLabel().' ditolak: '.$note,
                    ['approval_instance_id' => $instance->id]
                );
            }
        });
    }

    public function cancel(ApprovalInstance $instance, User $actor): void
    {
        DB::transaction(function () use ($instance, $actor): void {
            $instance = ApprovalInstance::query()->lockForUpdate()->findOrFail($instance->id);

            if (! $instance->isPending()) {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages(['approval' => 'Pengajuan tidak berada pada status menunggu.']);
            }

            if ($instance->requested_by !== $actor->id && ! $actor->hasRole('administrator')) {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages(['approval' => 'Hanya pengaju yang dapat membatalkan pengajuan.']);
            }

            $instance->actions()->create([
                'sequence' => $instance->current_step,
                'actor_id' => $actor->id,
                'action' => 'kembalikan',
                'note' => 'Dibatalkan oleh pengaju.',
                'acted_at' => now(),
            ]);

            $instance->update(['status' => 'dibatalkan', 'completed_at' => now()]);
        });
    }

    /**
     * Daftar pengajuan yang menunggu keputusan pengguna.
     *
     * @return Collection<int, ApprovalInstance>
     */
    public function pendingForUser(User $user): Collection
    {
        return ApprovalInstance::query()
            ->pending()
            ->with(['flow.steps', 'requester', 'subject'])
            ->orderBy('requested_at')
            ->get()
            ->filter(function (ApprovalInstance $instance) use ($user): bool {
                $step = $instance->currentStep();
                if (! $step) {
                    return false;
                }

                $subject = $instance->subject;

                return $subject instanceof Approvable
                    && $this->scopeAllows($user, $step, $subject)
                    && $this->hasStepRole($user, $step);
            })
            ->values();
    }

    protected function assertActionable(ApprovalInstance $instance, User $actor): void
    {
        if (! $instance->isPending()) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['approval' => 'Pengajuan sudah selesai diproses.']);
        }

        if ($instance->requested_by === $actor->id) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                'approval' => 'Pengaju tidak boleh menyetujui atau menolak pengajuannya sendiri.',
            ]);
        }
    }

    protected function assertActorAllowed(ApprovalInstance $instance, ApprovalFlowStep $step, User $actor): void
    {
        $subject = $instance->subject;

        if (! $subject instanceof Approvable) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['approval' => 'Objek pengajuan tidak valid.']);
        }

        if (! $this->hasStepRole($actor, $step) || ! $this->scopeAllows($actor, $step, $subject)) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                'approval' => 'Anda bukan pejabat yang berwenang pada langkah persetujuan ini.',
            ]);
        }
    }

    protected function hasStepRole(User $user, ApprovalFlowStep $step): bool
    {
        return $user->roles()->where('roles.id', $step->role_id)->exists();
    }

    protected function scopeAllows(User $user, ApprovalFlowStep $step, Approvable $subject): bool
    {
        return match ($step->scope) {
            'all' => true,
            'unit' => $subject->approvalOrgUnitId() !== null
                && in_array($subject->approvalOrgUnitId(), $user->scopedOrgUnitIds(), true),
            'self' => method_exists($subject, 'employee')
                && $subject->employee?->direct_supervisor_id === $user->employee_id,
            default => false,
        };
    }

    /**
     * @return Collection<int, User>
     */
    protected function candidates(ApprovalFlowStep $step, Approvable $subject): Collection
    {
        return User::query()
            ->where('is_active', true)
            ->whereHas('roles', fn ($query) => $query->where('roles.id', $step->role_id))
            ->get()
            ->filter(fn (User $user) => $this->scopeAllows($user, $step, $subject))
            ->values();
    }

    protected function nextStep(ApprovalInstance $instance, int $current): ?ApprovalFlowStep
    {
        $subject = $instance->subject;
        $steps = $instance->flow->steps->where('sequence', '>', $current)->sortBy('sequence');

        foreach ($steps as $step) {
            if ($step->is_optional && $subject instanceof Approvable && $this->candidates($step, $subject)->isEmpty()) {
                continue;
            }

            return $step;
        }

        return null;
    }

    protected function notifyStep(ApprovalInstance $instance, Approvable $subject): void
    {
        $step = $instance->currentStep();

        if (! $step) {
            return;
        }

        $this->notifications->sendToUsers(
            $this->candidates($step, $subject),
            'approval',
            'Persetujuan diperlukan',
            $subject->approvalLabel().' menunggu keputusan Anda.',
            [
                'approval_instance_id' => $instance->id,
                'subject_type' => $instance->subject_type,
                'subject_id' => $instance->subject_id,
            ]
        );
    }
}

namespace App\Services;

use App\Models\DocumentTemplate;
use Barryvdh\DomPDF\Facade\Pdf;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;

class DocumentPdfService
{
    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $variables
     */
    public function render(string $templateCode, array $variables): string
    {
        $template = DocumentTemplate::query()
            ->where('code', $templateCode)
            ->where('is_active', true)
            ->first();

        if (! $template) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                'template' => "Template dokumen '{$templateCode}' belum tersedia atau tidak aktif.",
            ]);
        }

        $replacements = [];
        foreach ($variables as $key => $value) {
            $replacements['{'.$key.'}'] = nl2br(e((string) ($value ?? '—')));
        }

        $html = strtr($template->body, $replacements);

        return (string) preg_replace('/\{[a-z0-9_]+\}/i', '—', $html);
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $variables
     */
    public function generate(string $templateCode, array $variables, string $folder, string $filename): string
    {
        $html = $this->render($templateCode, $variables);
        $output = Pdf::loadHTML($html)->setPaper('a4')->output();

        $path = 'documents/'.trim($folder, '/').'/'.Str::slug($filename).'.pdf';
        Storage::disk('local')->put($path, $output);

        return $path;
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Services;

use App\Models\Employee;
use App\Models\EmploymentContract;
use App\Models\User;
use Carbon\CarbonInterface;
use Illuminate\Support\Carbon;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

class ContractService
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly NumberSequenceService $sequences,
        private readonly DocumentPdfService $documents,
        private readonly NotificationService $notifications
    ) {
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $data
     */
    public function create(array $data, User $actor): EmploymentContract
    {
        return DB::transaction(function () use ($data, $actor): EmploymentContract {
            $data['contract_number'] = filled($data['contract_number'] ?? null)
                ? $data['contract_number']
                : $this->sequences->next('contract');
            $data['status'] = $data['status'] ?? 'draf';
            $data['created_by'] = $actor->id;

            return EmploymentContract::create($data);
        });
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $data
     */
    public function renew(EmploymentContract $previous, array $data, User $actor): EmploymentContract
    {
        $data['employee_id'] = $previous->employee_id;
        $data['previous_contract_id'] = $previous->id;
        $data['start_date'] = $data['start_date']
            ?? ($previous->end_date?->copy()->addDay()->toDateString() ?? now('Asia/Jakarta')->toDateString());
        $data['status'] = 'draf';

        return $this->create($data, $actor);
    }

    public function generateDocument(EmploymentContract $contract, User $actor): string
    {
        $contract->loadMissing('employee.orgUnit', 'employee.position');

        $path = $this->documents->generate(
            'KONTRAK-UMUM',
            [
                'nomor' => $contract->contract_number,
                'nama_pegawai' => $contract->employee?->full_name,
                'nip' => $contract->employee?->nip,
                'jabatan' => $contract->employee?->position?->name,
                'unit' => $contract->employee?->orgUnit?->name,
                'jenis_kontrak' => strtoupper($contract->contract_type),
                'tanggal_mulai' => $contract->start_date?->format('d-m-Y'),
                'tanggal_selesai' => $contract->end_date?->format('d-m-Y') ?? 'tidak berbatas waktu',
                'tanggal_probation' => $contract->probation_end_date?->format('d-m-Y') ?? '—',
                'tanggal_ttd' => $contract->signed_date?->format('d-m-Y') ?? '—',
                'kota' => 'Sidoarjo',
                'tanggal_cetak' => now('Asia/Jakarta')->format('d-m-Y'),
            ],
            'kontrak',
            $contract->contract_number.'-'.$contract->employee?->nip
        );

        $contract->update(['document_path' => $path]);

        return $path;
    }

    /**
     * Kirim pengingat H-30/H-14/H-7 dan perbarui status kontrak.
     *
     * @return array{reminded:int,expiring:int,ended:int}
     */
    public function sendReminders(?CarbonInterface $at = null): array
    {
        $today = Carbon::instance($at ?? now('Asia/Jakarta'))->timezone('Asia/Jakarta')->startOfDay();
        $stats = ['reminded' => 0, 'expiring' => 0, 'ended' => 0];

        $contracts = EmploymentContract::query()
            ->whereIn('status', ['aktif', 'akan_berakhir'])
            ->whereNotNull('end_date')
            ->with('employee.orgUnit')
            ->get();

        foreach ($contracts as $contract) {
            $end = $contract->end_date->copy()->startOfDay();
            $days = (int) $today->diffInDays($end, false);

            if ($days < 0) {
                $contract->update(['status' => 'berakhir']);
                $stats['ended']++;

                continue;
            }

            if ($days <= 30 && $contract->status !== 'akan_berakhir') {
                $contract->update(['status' => 'akan_berakhir']);
                $stats['expiring']++;
            }

            if (! in_array($days, [30, 14, 7], true)) {
                continue;
            }

            $recipients = $this->notifications->usersWithRole('hrd');
            $unitId = $contract->employee?->org_unit_id;

            $recipients = $recipients->merge(
                $this->notifications->usersWithRole('kepala_bagian')
                    ->filter(fn (User $user) => $unitId !== null
                        && in_array($unitId, $user->scopedOrgUnitIds(), true))
            );

            $sent = $this->notifications->sendToUsers(
                $recipients,
                'contract_reminder',
                'Kontrak akan berakhir',
                "Kontrak {$contract->contract_number} ({$contract->employee?->full_name}) berakhir dalam {$days} hari.",
                [
                    'contract_id' => $contract->id,
                    'employee_id' => $contract->employee_id,
                    'end_date' => $contract->end_date->toDateString(),
                    'days_left' => $days,
                    'dedupe_key' => "contract:{$contract->id}:h{$days}",
                ]
            );

            $stats['reminded'] += $sent;
        }

        return $stats;
    }
}

namespace App\Services;

use App\Models\Employee;

use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;

class MutationService
{
    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $data
     */
    public function create(array $data, User $actor): Mutation
    {
        return DB::transaction(function () use ($data, $actor): Mutation {
            $employee = Employee::query()->findOrFail($data['employee_id']);

            $data += [
                'from_org_unit_id' => $employee->org_unit_id,
                'from_position_id' => $employee->position_id,
                'from_supervisor_id' => $employee->direct_supervisor_id,
                'status' => 'draf',
                'requested_by' => $actor->id,
            ];

            return Mutation::create($data);
        });
    }

    public function apply(Mutation $mutation, User $actor): Mutation
    {
        return DB::transaction(function () use ($mutation, $actor): Mutation {
            $mutation = Mutation::query()->lockForUpdate()->findOrFail($mutation->id);

            if ($mutation->status !== 'disetujui') {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                    'mutation' => 'Mutasi hanya dapat diterapkan setelah disetujui.',
                ]);
            }

            $employee = Employee::query()->lockForUpdate()->findOrFail($mutation->employee_id);
            $effectiveDate = $mutation->effective_date->copy()->startOfDay();

            $active = $employee->assignments()->whereNull('effective_to')->get();

            foreach ($active as $assignment) {
                if ($assignment->effective_from->gte($effectiveDate)) {
                    throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                        'mutation' => 'Tanggal efektif harus setelah tanggal mulai penempatan aktif.',
                    ]);
                }
            }

            foreach ($active as $assignment) {
                $assignment->update([
                    'effective_to' => $effectiveDate->copy()->subDay()->toDateString(),
                ]);
            }

            $newUnit = $mutation->to_org_unit_id ?? $employee->org_unit_id;
            $newPosition = $mutation->to_position_id ?? $employee->position_id;
            $newSupervisor = $mutation->to_supervisor_id ?? $employee->direct_supervisor_id;

            if (! $newUnit || ! $newPosition) {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                    'mutation' => 'Unit dan jabatan tujuan wajib diketahui.',
                ]);
            }

            $employee->assignments()->create([
                'org_unit_id' => $newUnit,
                'position_id' => $newPosition,
                'direct_supervisor_id' => $newSupervisor,
                'work_location_id' => $employee->work_location_id,
                'effective_from' => $effectiveDate->toDateString(),
                'decision_number' => $mutation->decree?->number,
                'reason' => $mutation->reason,
                'created_by' => $actor->id,
            ]);

            $employee->update([
                'org_unit_id' => $newUnit,
                'position_id' => $newPosition,
                'direct_supervisor_id' => $newSupervisor,
            ]);

            $mutation->update([
                'status' => 'diterapkan',
                'approved_by' => $mutation->approved_by ?? $actor->id,
            ]);

            return $mutation->fresh();
        });
    }

    public function defaultEffectiveDate(): string
    {
        return Carbon::now('Asia/Jakarta')->addMonth()->startOfMonth()->toDateString();
    }
}

    public function __construct(private readonly EmployeeService $employees)
    {
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<int, array<string, mixed>>  $scores
     */
    public function saveScores(Applicant $applicant, array $scores, User $actor): void
    {
        $total = collect($scores)->sum(fn (array $row) => (float) ($row['weight'] ?? 0));

        if ($scores !== [] && abs($total - 100) > 0.01) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                'scores' => 'Total bobot penilaian harus 100 (saat ini '.number_format($total, 2, ',', '.').').',
            ]);
        }

        DB::transaction(function () use ($applicant, $scores, $actor): void {
            $applicant->scores()->delete();

            foreach ($scores as $row) {
                if (blank($row['criterion'] ?? null)) {
                    continue;
                }

                $applicant->scores()->create([
                    'criterion' => $row['criterion'],
                    'weight' => $row['weight'],
                    'score' => $row['score'],
                    'notes' => $row['notes'] ?? null,
                    'scored_by' => $actor->id,
                ]);
            }

            $applicant->load('scores');
            $applicant->update([
                'final_score' => $applicant->scores->isEmpty() ? null : $applicant->calculateFinalScore(),
            ]);
        });
    }

    public function transition(Applicant $applicant, string $status, ?string $note, User $actor): Applicant
    {
        $allowed = [
            'baru' => ['seleksi_administrasi', 'ditolak'],
            'seleksi_administrasi' => ['wawancara', 'ditolak'],
            'wawancara' => ['dipertimbangkan', 'ditolak'],
            'dipertimbangkan' => ['ditolak'],
        ];

        if (! in_array($status, $allowed[$applicant->status] ?? [], true)) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                'status' => 'Perubahan status dari '.$applicant->status.' ke '.$status.' tidak diizinkan.',
            ]);
        }

        if ($status === 'ditolak' && trim((string) $note) === '') {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['note' => 'Alasan penolakan wajib diisi.']);
        }

        $applicant->update([
            'status' => $status,
            'notes' => $this->appendNote($applicant->notes, $note, $actor),
        ]);

        return $applicant->fresh();
    }

    public function decide(Applicant $applicant, string $decision, string $reason, User $actor): Applicant
    {
        if (! in_array($decision, ['diterima', 'ditolak'], true)) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['decision' => 'Keputusan tidak valid.']);
        }

        if (trim($reason) === '') {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['reason' => 'Alasan keputusan wajib diisi.']);
        }

        $applicant->update([
            'status' => $decision,
            'notes' => $this->appendNote($applicant->notes, $reason, $actor),
        ]);

        return $applicant->fresh();
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $data
     */
    public function convert(Applicant $applicant, array $data, User $actor): Employee
    {
        return DB::transaction(function () use ($applicant, $data, $actor): Employee {
            $applicant = Applicant::query()->lockForUpdate()->findOrFail($applicant->id);

            if (! $applicant->canBeConverted()) {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                    'applicant' => 'Hanya pelamar berstatus diterima dan belum dikonversi yang dapat diproses.',
                ]);
            }

            if ($applicant->nik) {
                $hash = hash('sha256', $applicant->nik);
                if (Employee::query()->where('nik_hash', $hash)->exists()) {
                    throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                        'applicant' => 'NIK pelamar sudah terdaftar sebagai pegawai.',
                    ]);
                }
            }

            $employee = $this->employees->create([
                'nip' => $data['nip'] ?? null,
                'full_name' => $applicant->full_name,
                'nick_name' => $data['nick_name'] ?? null,
                'nik' => $applicant->nik,
                'birth_place' => $applicant->birth_place,
                'birth_date' => $applicant->birth_date?->toDateString(),
                'gender' => $applicant->gender ?? $data['gender'] ?? 'laki-laki',
                'religion' => $data['religion'] ?? null,
                'marital_status' => $data['marital_status'] ?? 'lajang',
                'address' => $applicant->address,
                'phone' => $applicant->phone,
                'email' => $applicant->email,
                'education_id' => $applicant->education_id,
                'dependents_count' => $data['dependents_count'] ?? 0,
                'org_unit_id' => $data['org_unit_id'],
                'position_id' => $data['position_id'],
                'work_location_id' => $data['work_location_id'] ?? null,
                'direct_supervisor_id' => $data['direct_supervisor_id'] ?? null,
                'employee_category' => $data['employee_category'],
                'employment_status' => $data['employment_status'] ?? 'aktif',
                'hire_date' => $data['hire_date'],
                'probation_end_date' => $data['probation_end_date'] ?? null,
                'is_active' => true,
            ], $actor);

            $applicant->update(['converted_employee_id' => $employee->id]);

            return $employee;
        });
    }

    protected function appendNote(?string $existing, ?string $note, User $actor): ?string
    {
        if (trim((string) $note) === '') {
            return $existing;
        }

        $line = '['.Carbon::now('Asia/Jakarta')->format('d-m-Y H:i').' — '.$actor->name.'] '.trim($note);

        return trim(($existing ? $existing."\n" : '').$line);
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Concerns;

use App\Models\Employee;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;

trait GuardsHrAccess
{
    protected function ensurePermission(Request $request, string $permission): void
    {
        abort_unless(
            $request->user()->hasPermission($permission),
            403,
            'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses untuk tindakan ini.'
        );
    }

    /**
     * Batasi data berdasarkan cakupan pegawai pengguna.
     */
    protected function scopeEmployeeRecords(Builder $query, User $user, string $column = 'employee_id'): Builder
    {
        if ($user->hasPermission('employee.view.all')) {
            return $query;
        }

        if ($user->hasPermission('employee.view.unit')) {
            return $query->whereIn($column, Employee::query()->visibleTo($user)->select('id'));
        }

        return $query->where($column, $user->employee_id ?? 0);
    }

    protected function ensureRecordVisible(Request $request, int $employeeId): void
    {
        $visible = Employee::query()
            ->visibleTo($request->user())
            ->whereKey($employeeId)
            ->exists();

        abort_unless($visible, 403, 'Anda tidak memiliki akses ke data pegawai ini.');
    }
}

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use App\Http\Controllers\Concerns\GuardsHrAccess;
use App\Models\JobVacancy;
use App\Models\OrgUnit;
use App\Models\Position;
use App\Services\NumberSequenceService;
use Illuminate\Http\RedirectResponse;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Validation\Rule;
use Illuminate\View\View;

class VacancyController extends Controller
{
    use GuardsHrAccess;

    public function __construct(private readonly NumberSequenceService $sequences)
    {
    }

    public function index(Request $request): View
    {
        $this->ensurePermission($request, 'vacancy.view');

        $query = JobVacancy::query()
            ->with(['orgUnit:id,name', 'position:id,name'])
            ->withCount('applicants');

        if ($search = trim((string) $request->input('q'))) {
            $query->where(fn ($q) => $q->where('title', 'like', "%{$search}%")
                ->orWhere('code', 'like', "%{$search}%"));
        }

        if ($status = $request->input('status')) {
            $query->where('status', $status);
        }

        return view('recruitment.vacancies.index', [
            'vacancies' => $query->orderByDesc('open_date')->paginate(15)->withQueryString(),
            'canManage' => $request->user()->hasPermission('vacancy.manage'),
        ]);
    }

    public function create(Request $request): View
    {
        $this->ensurePermission($request, 'vacancy.manage');

        return view('recruitment.vacancies.form', [
            'vacancy' => new JobVacancy([
                'employee_category' => 'tetap',
                'quota' => 1,
                'open_date' => now('Asia/Jakarta')->toDateString(),
                'close_date' => now('Asia/Jakarta')->addMonth()->toDateString(),
                'status' => 'draft',
            ]),
            'options' => $this->options(),
        ]);
    }

    public function store(Request $request): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->ensurePermission($request, 'vacancy.manage');

        $data = $this->validated($request);
        $data['code'] = filled($data['code'] ?? null) ? $data['code'] : $this->sequences->next('vacancy');
        $data['created_by'] = $request->user()->id;

        $vacancy = JobVacancy::create($data);

        return redirect()->route('vacancies.show', $vacancy)->with('success', 'Lowongan berhasil dibuat.');
    }

    public function show(Request $request, JobVacancy $vacancy): View
    {
        $this->ensurePermission($request, 'vacancy.view');

        $vacancy->load(['orgUnit:id,name', 'position:id,name', 'applicants' => fn ($q) => $q->orderBy('full_name')]);

        return view('recruitment.vacancies.show', [
            'vacancy' => $vacancy,
            'canManage' => $request->user()->hasPermission('vacancy.manage'),
            'canManageApplicants' => $request->user()->hasPermission('applicant.manage'),
        ]);
    }

    public function edit(Request $request, JobVacancy $vacancy): View
    {
        $this->ensurePermission($request, 'vacancy.manage');

        return view('recruitment.vacancies.form', [
            'vacancy' => $vacancy,
            'options' => $this->options(),
        ]);
    }

    public function update(Request $request, JobVacancy $vacancy): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->ensurePermission($request, 'vacancy.manage');

        $data = $this->validated($request, $vacancy);
        $data['code'] = filled($data['code'] ?? null) ? $data['code'] : $vacancy->code;
        $vacancy->update($data);

        return redirect()->route('vacancies.show', $vacancy)->with('success', 'Lowongan berhasil diperbarui.');
    }

    public function destroy(Request $request, JobVacancy $vacancy): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->ensurePermission($request, 'vacancy.manage');

        if ($vacancy->applicants()->exists()) {
            return back()->withErrors(['delete' => 'Lowongan sudah memiliki pelamar dan tidak boleh dihapus.']);
        }

        $vacancy->delete();

        return redirect()->route('vacancies.index')->with('success', 'Lowongan berhasil dihapus.');
    }

    public function updateStatus(Request $request, JobVacancy $vacancy): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->ensurePermission($request, 'vacancy.manage');

        $data = $request->validate([
            'status' => ['required', Rule::in(['draft', 'dibuka', 'ditutup', 'dibatalkan'])],
        ]);

        $vacancy->update($data);

        return back()->with('success', 'Status lowongan diperbarui menjadi '.$data['status'].'.');
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    protected function validated(Request $request, ?JobVacancy $vacancy = null): array
    {
        return $request->validate([
            'code' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:30', Rule::unique('job_vacancies', 'code')->ignore($vacancy?->id)],
            'title' => ['required', 'string', 'max:150'],
            'org_unit_id' => ['required', 'exists:org_units,id'],
            'position_id' => ['nullable', 'exists:positions,id'],
            'employee_category' => ['required', Rule::in(['tetap', 'harian', 'khidmah'])],
            'quota' => ['required', 'integer', 'min:1', 'max:1000'],
            'description' => ['nullable', 'string'],
            'requirements' => ['nullable', 'string'],
            'open_date' => ['required', 'date'],
            'close_date' => ['required', 'date', 'after_or_equal:open_date'],
            'status' => ['required', Rule::in(['draft', 'dibuka', 'ditutup', 'dibatalkan'])],
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    protected function options(): array
    {
        return [
            'orgUnits' => OrgUnit::query()->where('is_active', true)->orderBy('level')->orderBy('name')->pluck('name', 'id'),
            'positions' => Position::query()->where('is_active', true)->orderBy('name')->pluck('name', 'id'),
        ];
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use App\Http\Controllers\Concerns\GuardsHrAccess;
use App\Models\Applicant;
use App\Models\ApplicantDocument;
use App\Models\Education;
use App\Models\Employee;
use App\Models\Interview;
use App\Models\JobVacancy;
use App\Models\OrgUnit;
use App\Models\Position;
use App\Models\WorkLocation;
use App\Services\ApplicantService;
use App\Services\NumberSequenceService;
use Illuminate\Http\RedirectResponse;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;
use Illuminate\Validation\Rule;
use Illuminate\View\View;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\StreamedResponse;

class ApplicantController extends Controller
{
    use GuardsHrAccess;

    public function __construct(
        private readonly ApplicantService $applicants,
        private readonly NumberSequenceService $sequences
    ) {
    }

    public function index(Request $request): View
    {
        $this->ensurePermission($request, 'applicant.view');

        $query = Applicant::query()
            ->with(['vacancy:id,code,title,org_unit_id', 'vacancy.orgUnit:id,name', 'education:id,name'])
            ->withCount('interviews');

        if ($search = trim((string) $request->input('q'))) {
            $query->where(fn ($q) => $q->where('full_name', 'like', "%{$search}%")
                ->orWhere('code', 'like', "%{$search}%")
                ->orWhere('phone', 'like', "%{$search}%"));
        }

        if ($request->filled('vacancy_id')) {
            $query->where('vacancy_id', (int) $request->input('vacancy_id'));
        }

        if ($status = $request->input('status')) {
            $query->where('status', $status);
        }

        return view('recruitment.applicants.index', [
            'applicants' => $query->orderByDesc('created_at')->paginate(15)->withQueryString(),
            'vacancies' => JobVacancy::query()->orderByDesc('open_date')->pluck('title', 'id'),
            'canManage' => $request->user()->hasPermission('applicant.manage'),
        ]);
    }

    public function create(Request $request): View
    {
        $this->ensurePermission($request, 'applicant.manage');

        return view('recruitment.applicants.form', [
            'applicant' => new Applicant([
                'status' => 'baru',
                'vacancy_id' => $request->integer('vacancy_id') ?: null,
            ]),
            'options' => $this->options(),
        ]);
    }

    public function store(Request $request): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->ensurePermission($request, 'applicant.manage');

        $data = $this->validated($request);
        $vacancy = JobVacancy::findOrFail($data['vacancy_id']);

        if (! $vacancy->isOpen()) {
            return back()->withInput()->withErrors([
                'vacancy_id' => 'Lowongan tidak sedang dibuka untuk penerimaan pelamar.',
            ]);
        }

        $data['code'] = filled($data['code'] ?? null) ? $data['code'] : $this->sequences->next('applicant');
        $data['status'] = 'baru';

        $applicant = Applicant::create($data);

        return redirect()->route('applicants.show', $applicant)
            ->with('success', 'Data pelamar berhasil disimpan.');
    }

    public function show(Request $request, Applicant $applicant): View
    {
        $this->ensurePermission($request, 'applicant.view');

        $applicant->load([
            'vacancy.orgUnit:id,name', 'vacancy.position:id,name', 'education:id,name',
            'documents', 'interviews.interviewer:id,full_name', 'scores.scorer:id,name',
            'convertedEmployee:id,nip,full_name',
        ]);

        return view('recruitment.applicants.show', [
            'applicant' => $applicant,
            'canManage' => $request->user()->hasPermission('applicant.manage'),
            'canAssess' => $request->user()->hasPermission('interview.assess'),
            'canDecide' => $request->user()->hasPermission('applicant.decide'),
            'canConvert' => $request->user()->hasPermission('applicant.convert'),
            'interviewers' => Employee::query()->where('is_active', true)->orderBy('full_name')->pluck('full_name', 'id'),
            'convertOptions' => $this->convertOptions(),
        ]);
    }

    public function edit(Request $request, Applicant $applicant): View
    {
        $this->ensurePermission($request, 'applicant.manage');

        if ($applicant->converted_employee_id) {
            return redirect()->route('applicants.show', $applicant)
                ->withErrors(['applicant' => 'Data pelamar yang sudah dikonversi tidak dapat diubah.']);
        }

        return view('recruitment.applicants.form', [
            'applicant' => $applicant,
            'options' => $this->options(),
        ]);
    }

    public function update(Request $request, Applicant $applicant): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->ensurePermission($request, 'applicant.manage');

        if ($applicant->converted_employee_id) {
            return back()->withErrors(['applicant' => 'Data pelamar yang sudah dikonversi tidak dapat diubah.']);
        }

        $data = $this->validated($request);
        $data['code'] = filled($data['code'] ?? null) ? $data['code'] : $applicant->code;
        $applicant->update($data);

        return redirect()->route('applicants.show', $applicant)->with('success', 'Data pelamar berhasil diperbarui.');
    }

    public function destroy(Request $request, Applicant $applicant): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->ensurePermission($request, 'applicant.manage');

        if ($applicant->converted_employee_id) {
            return back()->withErrors(['applicant' => 'Pelamar sudah dikonversi menjadi pegawai.']);
        }

        foreach ($applicant->documents as $document) {
            Storage::disk('local')->delete($document->file_path);
        }

        $applicant->delete();

        return redirect()->route('applicants.index')->with('success', 'Data pelamar berhasil dihapus.');
    }

    public function storeDocument(Request $request, Applicant $applicant): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->ensurePermission($request, 'applicant.manage');

        $data = $request->validate([
            'doc_type' => ['required', Rule::in(['ktp', 'kk', 'ijazah', 'transkrip', 'cv', 'sertifikat', 'foto', 'lainnya'])],
            'file' => ['required', 'file', 'mimes:pdf,jpg,jpeg,png', 'max:10240'],
        ], [
            'file.mimes' => 'Dokumen harus berformat PDF, JPG, atau PNG.',
            'file.max' => 'Ukuran dokumen maksimal 10 MB.',
        ]);

        $applicant->documents()->create([
            'doc_type' => $data['doc_type'],
            'file_path' => $request->file('file')->store('applicants/documents/'.$applicant->id, 'local'),
            'uploaded_at' => now(),
        ]);

        return back()->with('success', 'Dokumen pelamar berhasil diunggah.');
    }

    public function downloadDocument(Request $request, Applicant $applicant, ApplicantDocument $document): StreamedResponse
    {
        $this->ensurePermission($request, 'applicant.view');
        abort_unless($document->applicant_id === $applicant->id, 404);
        abort_unless(Storage::disk('local')->exists($document->file_path), 404, 'Berkas tidak ditemukan.');

        return Storage::disk('local')->download(
            $document->file_path,
            $document->doc_type.'-'.$applicant->code.'.'.pathinfo($document->file_path, PATHINFO_EXTENSION)
        );
    }

    public function destroyDocument(Request $request, Applicant $applicant, ApplicantDocument $document): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->ensurePermission($request, 'applicant.manage');
        abort_unless($document->applicant_id === $applicant->id, 404);

        Storage::disk('local')->delete($document->file_path);
        $document->delete();

        return back()->with('success', 'Dokumen pelamar dihapus.');
    }

    public function transition(Request $request, Applicant $applicant): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->ensurePermission($request, 'applicant.manage');

        $data = $request->validate([
            'status' => ['required', Rule::in(['seleksi_administrasi', 'wawancara', 'dipertimbangkan', 'ditolak'])],
            'note' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:1000'],
        ]);

        $this->applicants->transition($applicant, $data['status'], $data['note'] ?? null, $request->user());

        return back()->with('success', 'Status pelamar diperbarui.');
    }

    public function storeInterview(Request $request, Applicant $applicant): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->ensurePermission($request, 'interview.assess');

        $data = $request->validate([
            'stage' => ['required', Rule::in(['hrd', 'kepala_bagian', 'pimpinan'])],
            'scheduled_at' => ['required', 'date'],
            'interviewer_id' => ['nullable', 'exists:employees,id'],
            'mode' => ['required', Rule::in(['tatap_muka', 'online'])],
            'location' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:255'],
            'notes' => ['nullable', 'string'],
        ]);

        $applicant->interviews()->create($data + ['status' => 'dijadwalkan']);

        if ($applicant->status === 'seleksi_administrasi') {
            $applicant->update(['status' => 'wawancara']);
        }

        return back()->with('success', 'Jadwal wawancara disimpan.');
    }

    public function updateInterview(Request $request, Applicant $applicant, Interview $interview): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->ensurePermission($request, 'interview.assess');
        abort_unless($interview->applicant_id === $applicant->id, 404);

        $data = $request->validate([
            'score' => ['nullable', 'numeric', 'min:0', 'max:100'],
            'result' => ['nullable', Rule::in(['lulus', 'tidak_lulus', 'ditunda'])],
            'notes' => ['nullable', 'string'],
            'status' => ['required', Rule::in(['dijadwalkan', 'selesai', 'dibatalkan'])],
        ]);

        $interview->update($data);

        return back()->with('success', 'Hasil wawancara diperbarui.');
    }

    public function storeScores(Request $request, Applicant $applicant): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->ensurePermission($request, 'interview.assess');

        $data = $request->validate([
            'scores' => ['nullable', 'array'],
            'scores.*.criterion' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:100'],
            'scores.*.weight' => ['nullable', 'numeric', 'min:0', 'max:100'],
            'scores.*.score' => ['nullable', 'numeric', 'min:0', 'max:100'],
            'scores.*.notes' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:255'],
        ]);

        $rows = collect($data['scores'] ?? [])
            ->filter(fn (array $row) => filled($row['criterion'] ?? null))
            ->map(fn (array $row) => [
                'criterion' => $row['criterion'],
                'weight' => $row['weight'] ?? 0,
                'score' => $row['score'] ?? 0,
                'notes' => $row['notes'] ?? null,
            ])
            ->values()
            ->all();

        $this->applicants->saveScores($applicant, $rows, $request->user());

        return back()->with('success', 'Penilaian berbobot disimpan.');
    }

    public function decide(Request $request, Applicant $applicant): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->ensurePermission($request, 'applicant.decide');

        $data = $request->validate([
            'decision' => ['required', Rule::in(['diterima', 'ditolak'])],
            'reason' => ['required', 'string', 'max:1000'],
        ]);

        $this->applicants->decide($applicant, $data['decision'], $data['reason'], $request->user());

        return back()->with('success', 'Keputusan penerimaan disimpan.');
    }

    public function convertForm(Request $request, Applicant $applicant): View|RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->ensurePermission($request, 'applicant.convert');

        if (! $applicant->canBeConverted()) {
            return redirect()->route('applicants.show', $applicant)
                ->withErrors(['applicant' => 'Hanya pelamar berstatus diterima dan belum dikonversi yang dapat diproses.']);
        }

        return view('recruitment.applicants.convert', [
            'applicant' => $applicant->load('vacancy', 'education'),
            'options' => $this->convertOptions(),
        ]);
    }

    public function convert(Request $request, Applicant $applicant): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->ensurePermission($request, 'applicant.convert');

        $data = $request->validate([
            'nip' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:30', 'unique:employees,nip'],
            'nick_name' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:60'],
            'religion' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:30'],
            'marital_status' => ['required', Rule::in(['lajang', 'menikah', 'cerai', 'cerai_mati'])],
            'dependents_count' => ['nullable', 'integer', 'min:0', 'max:20'],
            'org_unit_id' => ['required', 'exists:org_units,id'],
            'position_id' => ['required', 'exists:positions,id'],
            'work_location_id' => ['nullable', 'exists:work_locations,id'],
            'direct_supervisor_id' => ['nullable', 'exists:employees,id'],
            'employee_category' => ['required', Rule::in(['tetap', 'harian', 'khidmah'])],
            'employment_status' => ['required', Rule::in(['aktif', 'probation', 'cuti_panjang', 'nonaktif', 'berhenti'])],
            'hire_date' => ['required', 'date'],
            'probation_end_date' => ['nullable', 'date', 'after_or_equal:hire_date'],
        ]);

        $employee = $this->applicants->convert($applicant, $data, $request->user());

        return redirect()->route('employees.show', $employee)
            ->with('success', 'Pelamar berhasil dikonversi menjadi pegawai.');
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    protected function validated(Request $request): array
    {
        return $request->validate([
            'vacancy_id' => ['required', 'exists:job_vacancies,id'],
            'code' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:30', 'unique:applicants,code'],
            'full_name' => ['required', 'string', 'max:150'],
            'nik' => ['nullable', 'digits:16'],
            'birth_place' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:100'],
            'birth_date' => ['nullable', 'date', 'before:today'],
            'gender' => ['nullable', Rule::in(['laki-laki', 'perempuan'])],
            'phone' => ['required', 'string', 'max:30'],
            'email' => ['nullable', 'email', 'max:150'],
            'address' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:255'],
            'education_id' => ['nullable', 'exists:educations,id'],
            'experience_years' => ['nullable', 'integer', 'min:0', 'max:60'],
            'expected_salary' => ['nullable', 'numeric', 'min:0'],
            'source' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:50'],
            'notes' => ['nullable', 'string'],
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    protected function options(): array
    {
        return [
            'vacancies' => JobVacancy::query()->orderByDesc('open_date')->get(['id', 'code', 'title', 'status', 'open_date', 'close_date']),
            'educations' => Education::query()->where('is_active', true)->orderBy('level_order')->pluck('name', 'id'),
        ];
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    protected function convertOptions(): array
    {
        return [
            'orgUnits' => OrgUnit::query()->where('is_active', true)->orderBy('level')->orderBy('name')->pluck('name', 'id'),
            'positions' => Position::query()->where('is_active', true)->orderBy('name')->pluck('name', 'id'),
            'workLocations' => WorkLocation::query()->where('is_active', true)->orderBy('name')->pluck('name', 'id'),
            'supervisors' => Employee::query()->where('is_active', true)->orderBy('full_name')->pluck('full_name', 'id'),
        ];
    }
}

    {

        $this->ensureRecordVisible($request, $contract->employee_id);

        return redirect()->route('contracts.show', $new)->with('success', 'Draf perpanjangan kontrak dibuat.');

    public function pdf(Request $request, EmploymentContract $contract): StreamedResponse
    {

        $this->ensureRecordVisible($request, $contract->employee_id);

    {
        $this->ensurePermission($request, 'contract.view');
        $this->ensureRecordVisible($request, $contract->employee_id);
        abort_unless($contract->document_path && Storage::disk('local')->exists($contract->document_path), 404, 'Berkas tidak ditemukan.');

        return Storage::disk('local')->download($contract->document_path, 'kontrak-'.$contract->contract_number.'.pdf');
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    protected function validated(Request $request, ?EmploymentContract $contract = null): array
    {
        $data = $request->validate([
            'employee_id' => ['required', 'exists:employees,id'],
            'contract_number' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:100', Rule::unique('employment_contracts', 'contract_number')->ignore($contract?->id)],

            'notes' => ['nullable', 'string'],
        ]);

        if ($contract?->exists) {
            unset($data['employee_id']);
        }

        return $data;
    }

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use App\Http\Controllers\Concerns\GuardsHrAccess;
use App\Models\ApprovalInstance;
use App\Models\Employee;
use App\Models\EmployeeLetter;
use App\Services\ApprovalService;
use App\Services\DocumentPdfService;
use App\Services\NumberSequenceService;
use Illuminate\Http\RedirectResponse;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;
use Illuminate\Validation\Rule;
use Illuminate\View\View;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\StreamedResponse;

class LetterController extends Controller
{
    use GuardsHrAccess;

    public function __construct(
        private readonly NumberSequenceService $sequences,
        private readonly ApprovalService $approvals,
        private readonly DocumentPdfService $documents
    ) {
    }

    public function index(Request $request): View
    {
        $this->ensurePermission($request, 'letter.view');

        $query = EmployeeLetter::query()->with(['employee:id,nip,full_name,org_unit_id', 'employee.orgUnit:id,name']);
        $this->scopeEmployeeRecords($query, $request->user());

        if ($search = trim((string) $request->input('q'))) {
            $query->where(fn ($q) => $q->where('number', 'like', "%{$search}%")
                ->orWhere('subject', 'like', "%{$search}%")
                ->orWhereHas('employee', fn ($e) => $e->where('full_name', 'like', "%{$search}%")));
        }

        if ($type = $request->input('letter_type')) {
            $query->where('letter_type', $type);
        }

        if ($status = $request->input('status')) {
            $query->where('status', $status);
        }

        return view('hr.letters.index', [
            'letters' => $query->orderByDesc('letter_date')->paginate(15)->withQueryString(),
            'canManage' => $request->user()->hasPermission('letter.manage'),
        ]);
    }

    public function create(Request $request): View
    {
        $this->ensurePermission($request, 'letter.manage');

        return view('hr.letters.form', [
            'letter' => new EmployeeLetter([
                'letter_type' => 'keterangan',
                'letter_date' => now('Asia/Jakarta')->toDateString(),
                'status' => 'draf',
                'employee_id' => $request->integer('employee_id') ?: null,
            ]),
            'employees' => Employee::query()->where('is_active', true)->orderBy('full_name')->pluck('full_name', 'id'),
        ]);
    }

    public function store(Request $request): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->ensurePermission($request, 'letter.manage');

        $data = $this->validated($request);
        $data['number'] = filled($data['number'] ?? null) ? $data['number'] : $this->sequences->next('letter');
        $data['status'] = 'draf';
        $data['created_by'] = $request->user()->id;

        $letter = EmployeeLetter::create($data);

        return redirect()->route('letters.show', $letter)->with('success', 'Surat berhasil dibuat.');
    }

    public function show(Request $request, EmployeeLetter $letter): View
    {
        $this->ensurePermission($request, 'letter.view');
        $this->ensureRecordVisible($request, $letter->employee_id);

        $letter->load(['employee.orgUnit:id,name', 'employee.position:id,name', 'creator:id,name', 'approver:id,name']);

        $approval = ApprovalInstance::query()
            ->where('subject_type', $letter->getMorphClass())
            ->where('subject_id', $letter->id)
            ->with(['flow.steps.role', 'actions.actor', 'requester'])
            ->latest()
            ->first();

        return view('hr.letters.show', [
            'letter' => $letter,
            'approval' => $approval,
            'canManage' => $request->user()->hasPermission('letter.manage'),
        ]);
    }

    public function edit(Request $request, EmployeeLetter $letter): View
    {
        $this->ensurePermission($request, 'letter.manage');
        $this->ensureRecordVisible($request, $letter->employee_id);

        abort_unless(in_array($letter->status, ['draf', 'dibatalkan'], true), 403, 'Surat yang sudah diajukan tidak dapat diubah.');

        return view('hr.letters.form', [
            'letter' => $letter,
            'employees' => Employee::query()->where('is_active', true)->orderBy('full_name')->pluck('full_name', 'id'),
        ]);
    }

    public function update(Request $request, EmployeeLetter $letter): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->ensurePermission($request, 'letter.manage');
        $this->ensureRecordVisible($request, $letter->employee_id);

        abort_unless(in_array($letter->status, ['draf', 'dibatalkan'], true), 403, 'Surat yang sudah diajukan tidak dapat diubah.');

        $data = $this->validated($request, $letter);
        $data['number'] = filled($data['number'] ?? null) ? $data['number'] : $letter->number;
        $letter->update($data);

        return redirect()->route('letters.show', $letter)->with('success', 'Surat diperbarui.');
    }

    public function destroy(Request $request, EmployeeLetter $letter): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->ensurePermission($request, 'letter.manage');
        $this->ensureRecordVisible($request, $letter->employee_id);

        if ($letter->status !== 'draf') {
            return back()->withErrors(['delete' => 'Hanya surat draf yang dapat dihapus.']);
        }

        if ($letter->document_path) {
            Storage::disk('local')->delete($letter->document_path);
        }

        $letter->delete();

        return redirect()->route('letters.index')->with('success', 'Surat dihapus.');
    }

    public function submit(Request $request, EmployeeLetter $letter): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->ensurePermission($request, 'letter.manage');
        $this->ensureRecordVisible($request, $letter->employee_id);

        abort_unless($letter->status === 'draf', 403, 'Hanya surat draf yang dapat diajukan.');

        $this->approvals->submit($letter, $request->user());

        return back()->with('success', 'Surat diajukan untuk persetujuan.');
    }

    public function send(Request $request, EmployeeLetter $letter): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->ensurePermission($request, 'letter.manage');
        $this->ensureRecordVisible($request, $letter->employee_id);

        abort_unless($letter->status === 'disetujui', 403, 'Surat harus disetujui sebelum ditandai terkirim.');

        $letter->update(['status' => 'terkirim']);

        return back()->with('success', 'Surat ditandai terkirim.');
    }

    public function pdf(Request $request, EmployeeLetter $letter): StreamedResponse
    {
        $this->ensurePermission($request, 'letter.view');
        $this->ensureRecordVisible($request, $letter->employee_id);

        $letter->loadMissing('employee.orgUnit', 'employee.position');

        $path = $this->documents->generate(
            'SURAT-UMUM',
            [
                'nomor' => $letter->number,
                'perihal' => $letter->subject,
                'nama_pegawai' => $letter->employee?->full_name,
                'nip' => $letter->employee?->nip,
                'jabatan' => $letter->employee?->position?->name,
                'unit' => $letter->employee?->orgUnit?->name,
                'tanggal_surat' => $letter->letter_date?->format('d-m-Y'),
                'isi' => $letter->body ?: $letter->subject,
                'kota' => 'Sidoarjo',
                'tanggal_cetak' => now('Asia/Jakarta')->format('d-m-Y'),
            ],
            'surat',
            $letter->number.'-'.$letter->employee?->nip
        );

        $letter->update(['document_path' => $path]);

        return Storage::disk('local')->download($path, 'surat-'.$letter->number.'.pdf');
    }

    public function download(Request $request, EmployeeLetter $letter): StreamedResponse
    {
        $this->ensurePermission($request, 'letter.view');
        $this->ensureRecordVisible($request, $letter->employee_id);
        abort_unless($letter->document_path && Storage::disk('local')->exists($letter->document_path), 404, 'Berkas tidak ditemukan.');

        return Storage::disk('local')->download($letter->document_path, 'surat-'.$letter->number.'.pdf');
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    protected function validated(Request $request, ?EmployeeLetter $letter = null): array
    {
        return $request->validate([
            'employee_id' => ['required', 'exists:employees,id'],
            'letter_type' => ['required', Rule::in(['teguran', 'pembinaan', 'pemberhentian', 'keterangan', 'lain'])],
            'number' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:100', Rule::unique('employee_letters', 'number')->ignore($letter?->id)],
            'letter_date' => ['required', 'date'],
            'subject' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255'],
            'body' => ['nullable', 'string'],
        ]);
    }
}

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use App\Models\ApprovalInstance;
use App\Services\ApprovalService;
use Illuminate\Http\RedirectResponse;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\View\View;

class ApprovalController extends Controller
{
    public function __construct(private readonly ApprovalService $approvals)
    {
    }

    public function index(Request $request): View
    {
        $user = $request->user();

        return view('approvals.index', [
            'pending' => $this->approvals->pendingForUser($user),
            'submitted' => ApprovalInstance::query()
                ->where('requested_by', $user->id)
                ->with(['flow', 'subject', 'actions.actor'])
                ->latest()
                ->paginate(15, ['*'], 'pengajuan'),
        ]);
    }

    public function show(Request $request, ApprovalInstance $approval): View
    {
        $approval->load(['flow.steps.role', 'actions.actor', 'requester', 'subject']);

        $this->authorizeView($request, $approval);

        return view('approvals.show', [
            'approval' => $approval,
            'canAct' => $approval->isPending()
                && $this->approvals->pendingForUser($request->user())->contains('id', $approval->id),
        ]);
    }

    public function approve(Request $request, ApprovalInstance $approval): RedirectResponse
    {
        $data = $request->validate(['note' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:1000']]);

        $this->approvals->approve($approval, $request->user(), $data['note'] ?? null);

        return back()->with('success', 'Pengajuan disetujui.');
    }

    public function reject(Request $request, ApprovalInstance $approval): RedirectResponse
    {
        $data = $request->validate(['note' => ['required', 'string', 'max:1000']]);

        $this->approvals->reject($approval, $request->user(), $data['note']);

        return back()->with('success', 'Pengajuan ditolak.');
    }

    public function cancel(Request $request, ApprovalInstance $approval): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->approvals->cancel($approval, $request->user());

        return back()->with('success', 'Pengajuan dibatalkan.');
    }

    protected function authorizeView(Request $request, ApprovalInstance $approval): void
    {
        $user = $request->user();

        $allowed = $approval->requested_by === $user->id
            || $user->hasRole('administrator')
            || $this->approvals->pendingForUser($user)->contains('id', $approval->id);

        abort_unless($allowed, 403, 'Anda tidak memiliki akses ke pengajuan ini.');
    }
}

use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\View\View;

class NotificationController extends Controller
{
    public function index(Request $request): View
    {
        $notifications = Notification::query()
            ->where('user_id', $request->user()->id)
            ->latest('created_at')
            ->paginate(20);

        return view('notifications.index', [
            'notifications' => $notifications,
        ]);
    }

    public function markRead(Request $request, Notification $notification): RedirectResponse
    {
        abort_unless($notification->user_id === $request->user()->id, 403);

        $notification->markAsRead();

        return back()->with('success', 'Notifikasi ditandai sudah dibaca.');
    }

    public function markAllRead(Request $request): RedirectResponse
    {
        Notification::query()
            ->where('user_id', $request->user()->id)
            ->whereNull('read_at')
            ->update(['read_at' => now()]);

        return back()->with('success', 'Semua notifikasi ditandai sudah dibaca.');
    }
}
