<?php

namespace Tests\Feature;

use App\Models\Applicant;
use App\Models\Employee;
use App\Models\JobVacancy;
use App\Models\OrgUnit;
use App\Models\Position;
use App\Models\User;
use Database\Seeders\DatabaseSeeder;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Tests\TestCase;

class RecruitmentTest extends TestCase
{
    use RefreshDatabase;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();
        $this->seed(DatabaseSeeder::class);
    }

    public function test_pelamar_diproses_hingga_menjadi_pegawai_tanpa_input_ulang_identitas(): void
    {
        $hrd = User::where('username', 'hrd.demo')->firstOrFail();
        $unit = OrgUnit::where('code', 'PIS-SMP')->firstOrFail();
        $position = Position::where('code', 'GURU')->firstOrFail();

        $this->actingAs($hrd)->post(route('vacancies.store'), [
            'title' => 'Guru Bahasa Arab (DEMO)',
            'org_unit_id' => $unit->id,
            'position_id' => $position->id,
            'employee_category' => 'tetap',
            'quota' => 1,
            'open_date' => now('Asia/Jakarta')->toDateString(),
            'close_date' => now('Asia/Jakarta')->addMonth()->toDateString(),
            'status' => 'dibuka',
        ])->assertRedirect();

        $vacancy = JobVacancy::where('title', 'Guru Bahasa Arab (DEMO)')->firstOrFail();
        $this->assertMatchesRegularExpression('/^LOW\/\d{4}\/\d{4}$/', $vacancy->code);

        $this->actingAs($hrd)->post(route('applicants.store'), [
            'vacancy_id' => $vacancy->id,
            'full_name' => 'DEMO — Pelamar Uji',
            'nik' => '3512345678901234',
            'birth_place' => 'Sidoarjo',
            'birth_date' => '1998-02-03',
            'gender' => 'laki-laki',
            'phone' => '081299998888',
            'email' => 'pelamar.uji@example.test',
            'address' => 'Jl. Uji Nomor 1',
            'education_id' => \App\Models\Education::where('code', 'S1')->value('id'),
            'experience_years' => 2,
            'source' => 'DEMO',
        ])->assertRedirect();

        $applicant = Applicant::where('full_name', 'DEMO — Pelamar Uji')->firstOrFail();
        $this->assertSame('baru', $applicant->status);
        $this->assertSame('3512345678901234', $applicant->fresh()->nik);

        $this->actingAs($hrd)->post(route('applicants.status', $applicant), [
            'status' => 'seleksi_administrasi',
            'note' => 'Berkas lengkap',
        ])->assertRedirect();

        $this->actingAs($hrd)->post(route('applicants.status', $applicant), [
            'status' => 'wawancara',
            'note' => 'Jadwal wawancara dibuat',
        ])->assertRedirect();

        $this->actingAs($hrd)->post(route('applicants.status', $applicant), [
            'status' => 'dipertimbangkan',
            'note' => 'Lanjut keputusan',
        ])->assertRedirect();

        $this->actingAs($hrd)->post(route('applicants.scores.store', $applicant), [
            'scores' => [
                ['criterion' => 'Kompetensi', 'weight' => 60, 'score' => 80],
                ['criterion' => 'Wawancara', 'weight' => 40, 'score' => 90],
            ],
        ])->assertRedirect();

        $applicant->refresh();
        $this->assertSame('84.00', $applicant->final_score);

        $this->actingAs($hrd)->post(route('applicants.decide', $applicant), [
            'decision' => 'diterima',
            'reason' => 'Lolos seluruh tahapan',
        ])->assertRedirect();

        $this->assertSame('diterima', $applicant->fresh()->status);

        $this->actingAs($hrd)->post(route('applicants.convert', $applicant), [
            'marital_status' => 'lajang',
            'org_unit_id' => $unit->id,
            'position_id' => $position->id,
            'employee_category' => 'tetap',
            'employment_status' => 'aktif',
            'hire_date' => now('Asia/Jakarta')->toDateString(),
        ])->assertRedirect();

        $applicant->refresh();
        $this->assertNotNull($applicant->converted_employee_id);

        $employee = Employee::findOrFail($applicant->converted_employee_id);
        $this->assertSame('DEMO — Pelamar Uji', $employee->full_name);
        $this->assertSame('3512345678901234', $employee->nik);
        $this->assertSame('081299998888', $employee->phone);
        $this->assertSame($unit->id, $employee->org_unit_id);

        // Konversi kedua harus ditolak dan tidak membuat pegawai baru.
        $count = Employee::count();
        $this->actingAs($hrd)->post(route('applicants.convert', $applicant), [
            'marital_status' => 'lajang',
            'org_unit_id' => $unit->id,
            'position_id' => $position->id,
            'employee_category' => 'tetap',
            'employment_status' => 'aktif',
            'hire_date' => now('Asia/Jakarta')->toDateString(),
        ])->assertSessionHasErrors('applicant');

        $this->assertSame($count, Employee::count());
    }

    public function test_total_bobot_penilaian_harus_100(): void
    {
        $hrd = User::where('username', 'hrd.demo')->firstOrFail();
        $applicant = $this->applicantFor($hrd);

        $this->actingAs($hrd)->post(route('applicants.scores.store', $applicant), [
            'scores' => [
                ['criterion' => 'Kompetensi', 'weight' => 60, 'score' => 80],
                ['criterion' => 'Wawancara', 'weight' => 30, 'score' => 90],
            ],
        ])->assertSessionHasErrors('scores');

        $this->assertSame(0, $applicant->scores()->count());
    }

    public function test_penerimaan_hanya_setelah_tahap_dipertimbangkan(): void
    {
        $hrd = User::where('username', 'hrd.demo')->firstOrFail();
        $applicant = $this->applicantFor($hrd);

        $this->actingAs($hrd)->post(route('applicants.decide', $applicant), [
            'decision' => 'diterima',
            'reason' => 'Terlalu cepat',
        ])->assertSessionHasErrors('decision');

        $this->assertSame('baru', $applicant->fresh()->status);
    }

    protected function applicantFor(User $hrd): Applicant
    {
        $unit = OrgUnit::where('code', 'PIS-SMP')->firstOrFail();

        $vacancy = JobVacancy::create([
            'code' => 'LOW/UJI/0001',
            'title' => 'Lowongan Uji',
            'org_unit_id' => $unit->id,
            'employee_category' => 'tetap',
            'quota' => 1,
            'open_date' => now('Asia/Jakarta')->subDay()->toDateString(),
            'close_date' => now('Asia/Jakarta')->addMonth()->toDateString(),
            'status' => 'dibuka',
            'created_by' => $hrd->id,
        ]);

        return Applicant::create([
            'vacancy_id' => $vacancy->id,
            'code' => 'PLM/UJI/0001',
            'full_name' => 'DEMO — Pelamar Skor',
            'phone' => '081200001111',
            'status' => 'baru',
        ]);
    }
}

## Objective
- Build the "Aplikasi Kepegawaian PIS" (Pesantren Imam Syafi'i HRIS) in the 8 stages defined by `Prompt_Induk_Aplikasi_Kepegawaian_PIS.md`.
- Stage 2 is complete and verified; the user asked to proceed to Stage 3 (recruitment and HR administration), which is now substantially implemented and being tested.

## Requirements
- Follow the Indonesian master prompt: 8 sequential stages, one project/one MySQL database, no fabricated policies/features, no claimed untested completion, no hardcoded salary/tax rates.
- UI language Indonesian; currency IDR; dates DD-MM-YYYY; timezone Asia/Jakarta; DEMO data labeled.
- User confirmed Stage 2 “semua berjalan lancar” and said “oke lanjut ke tahap berikutnya”.
- Stage 3 scope: recruitment (vacancies, applicants, documents, interviews, weighted scores), conversion applicant→employee, contracts + renewal + H-30/H-14/H-7 reminders, decrees (SK), mutations/position changes, document templates + numbering + PDF, letters, approval workflow per document type, end-to-end tests, module docs.

## Decisions
- Stack: Laravel 13.43.0 + PHP 8.3.36 + MySQL 8.4.9, Blade + Tailwind 4 + Vite; controllers/Blade (no Livewire usage).
- Custom RBAC preserved; existing `vacancy.*`, `applicant.*`, `interview.assess`, `contract.*`, `decree.*`, `mutation.*`, `letter.*`, `approval_flow.manage` permissions reused.
- Generic four-table approval engine implemented with rule `actor_id != requested_by`; role + scope (`all`, `unit`, `self`) authorization.
- Stage 3 approval flows seeded: `contract`→pimpinan; `decree`→pimpinan; `mutation`→kepala_bagian (unit) then pimpinan; `letter`→pimpinan. Yayasan step intentionally omitted pending K-26.
- Contract status follows DB design exactly (`draf`,`aktif`,`akan_berakhir`,`berakhir`,`diperpanjang`,`dibatalkan`); pending approval keeps `draf`, rejection sets `dibatalkan`.
- Mutation apply closes active assignment with `effective_to = effective_date - 1`, creates new `employee_assignments`, updates employee placement, sets status `diterapkan`.
- Applicant conversion allowed only status `diterima`, unique `converted_employee_id`, reuses applicant identity, rejects duplicate NIK.
- Decree/letter statuses follow DB design; letter rejection maps to `dibatalkan` because design lacks `ditolak`.
- Numbering remains temporary per K-18: `KTR/{year}/{seq:4}`, `SK/{year}/{seq:4}`, `SRT/{year}/{seq:4}`; added internal `vacancy` (`LOW/...`) and `applicant` (`PLM/...`) sequences.

## Work State
### Completed
- Stage 1 blueprint (17 doc checks) and Stage 2 fully implemented/verified: 29 passed, 106 assertions before Stage 3 changes.
- Created Stage 3 migrations:
  - `2026_11_18_002000_create_recruitment_tables.php` (`job_vacancies`, `applicants`, `applicant_documents`, `interviews`, `applicant_scores`).
  - `2026_11_18_002100_create_hr_administration_tables.php` (`employment_contracts`, `decrees`, `mutations`, `employee_letters`).
  - `2026_11_18_002200_create_approval_and_notification_tables.php` (`approval_flows`, `approval_flow_steps`, `approval_instances`, `approval_actions`, `notifications`).
- Migrations ran successfully on dev DB `pis_kepegawaian`; `php artisan route:list` shows 171 routes; `php artisan view:cache` succeeds.
- Created models: `JobVacancy`, `Applicant`, `ApplicantDocument`, `Interview`, `ApplicantScore`, `EmploymentContract`, `Decree`, `Mutation`, `EmployeeLetter`, `ApprovalFlow`, `ApprovalFlowStep`, `ApprovalInstance`, `ApprovalAction`, `Notification`; contract `App\Contracts\Approvable`.

<?php

namespace Tests\Feature;

use App\Models\ApprovalInstance;
use App\Models\Decree;
use App\Models\Employee;
use App\Models\EmploymentContract;
use App\Models\Mutation;
use App\Models\Notification;
use App\Models\OrgUnit;
use App\Models\Position;
use App\Models\User;
use Database\Seeders\DatabaseSeeder;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;
use Tests\TestCase;

class ApprovalWorkflowTest extends TestCase
{
    use RefreshDatabase;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();
        $this->seed(DatabaseSeeder::class);
    }

    public function test_pengaju_tidak_boleh_menyetujui_dokumennya_sendiri_dan_pimpinan_dapat_menyetujui(): void
    {
        $hrd = $this->user('hrd.demo');
        $pimpinan = $this->user('pimpinan.demo');
        $employee = $this->employee('DEMO — Bagus Setiawan');

        $contract = $this->contract($employee, $hrd, [
            'contract_number' => 'KTR/UJI/0001',
            'end_date' => now('Asia/Jakarta')->addYear()->toDateString(),
        ]);

        $this->actingAs($hrd)->post(route('contracts.submit', $contract))->assertSessionHasNoErrors();

        $instance = ApprovalInstance::query()->firstOrFail();
        $this->assertSame('menunggu', $instance->status);
        $this->assertSame('draf', $contract->fresh()->status);

        $this->actingAs($hrd)
            ->post(route('approvals.approve', $instance))
            ->assertSessionHasErrors('approval');

        $this->assertSame('draf', $contract->fresh()->status);
        $this->assertSame(0, $instance->actions()->count());

        $this->actingAs($pimpinan)
            ->post(route('approvals.approve', $instance), ['note' => 'Disetujui pimpinan'])
            ->assertSessionHasNoErrors();

        $instance->refresh();
        $contract->refresh();

        $this->assertSame('disetujui', $instance->status);
        $this->assertNotNull($instance->completed_at);
        $this->assertSame('aktif', $contract->status);
        $this->assertSame(1, $instance->actions()->count());
        $this->assertSame($pimpinan->id, $instance->actions()->first()->actor_id);
    }

    public function test_mutasi_melewati_dua_tingkat_lalu_diterapkan_dan_riwayat_penempatan_tercatat(): void
    {
        $hrd = $this->user('hrd.demo');
        $kepala = $this->user('kepala.demo');
        $pimpinan = $this->user('pimpinan.demo');
        $employee = $this->employee('DEMO — Bagus Setiawan');

        $targetUnit = OrgUnit::where('code', 'PIS-PENDIDIKAN')->firstOrFail();
        $targetPosition = Position::where('code', 'GURU')->firstOrFail();
        $effective = now('Asia/Jakarta')->addDays(10)->toDateString();

        $mutation = Mutation::create([
            'employee_id' => $employee->id,
            'mutation_type' => 'mutasi',
            'from_org_unit_id' => $employee->org_unit_id,
            'from_position_id' => $employee->position_id,
            'to_org_unit_id' => $targetUnit->id,
            'to_position_id' => $targetPosition->id,
            'effective_date' => $effective,
            'reason' => 'Kebutuhan penugasan (DEMO)',
            'status' => 'draf',
            'requested_by' => $hrd->id,
        ]);

        $this->actingAs($hrd)->post(route('mutations.submit', $mutation))->assertSessionHasNoErrors();

        $instance = ApprovalInstance::query()->firstOrFail();
        $this->assertSame(1, $instance->current_step);

        // Pimpinan bukan pejabat pada langkah 1, sehingga ditolak.
        $this->actingAs($pimpinan)
            ->post(route('approvals.approve', $instance))
            ->assertSessionHasErrors('approval');

        $this->actingAs($kepala)
            ->post(route('approvals.approve', $instance), ['note' => 'Disetujui atasan'])
            ->assertSessionHasNoErrors();

        $instance->refresh();
        $this->assertSame('menunggu', $instance->status);
        $this->assertSame(2, $instance->current_step);

        $this->actingAs($pimpinan)
            ->post(route('approvals.approve', $instance), ['note' => 'Disetujui pimpinan'])
            ->assertSessionHasNoErrors();

        $instance->refresh();
        $mutation->refresh();

        $this->assertSame('disetujui', $instance->status);
        $this->assertSame('disetujui', $mutation->status);
        $this->assertSame(2, $instance->actions()->count());

        $this->actingAs($hrd)->post(route('mutations.apply', $mutation))->assertSessionHasNoErrors();

        $mutation->refresh();
        $employee->refresh();

        $this->assertSame('diterapkan', $mutation->status);
        $this->assertSame($targetUnit->id, $employee->org_unit_id);
        $this->assertSame($targetPosition->id, $employee->position_id);

        $assignments = $employee->assignments()->orderBy('effective_from')->get();
        $this->assertCount(2, $assignments);

        $old = $assignments->first();
        $new = $assignments->last();

        $this->assertSame(
            \Illuminate\Support\Carbon::parse($effective, 'Asia/Jakarta')->subDay()->toDateString(),
            $old->effective_to->toDateString()
        );
        $this->assertSame($effective, $new->effective_from->toDateString());
        $this->assertSame($targetUnit->id, $new->org_unit_id);

        // Menerapkan ulang harus ditolak.
        $this->actingAs($hrd)
            ->post(route('mutations.apply', $mutation))
            ->assertSessionHasErrors('mutation');
    }

    public function test_perpanjangan_kontrak_dan_pengingat_h30_tidak_duplikat(): void
    {
        $hrd = $this->user('hrd.demo');
        $pimpinan = $this->user('pimpinan.demo');
        $employee = $this->employee('DEMO — Bagus Setiawan');

        $endDate = now('Asia/Jakarta')->addDays(30)->toDateString();

        $contract = $this->contract($employee, $hrd, [
            'contract_number' => 'KTR/UJI/0100',
            'status' => 'aktif',
            'start_date' => now('Asia/Jakarta')->subYear()->toDateString(),
            'end_date' => $endDate,
        ]);

        $this->artisan('contracts:remind', ['--date' => now('Asia/Jakarta')->toDateString()])
            ->assertSuccessful();

        $contract->refresh();
        $this->assertSame('akan_berakhir', $contract->status);

        $reminders = Notification::query()
            ->where('type', 'contract_reminder')
            ->where('user_id', $hrd->id)
            ->get();

        $this->assertCount(1, $reminders);
        $this->assertSame(30, $reminders->first()->data['days_left']);
        $this->assertSame($contract->id, $reminders->first()->data['contract_id']);

        // Menjalankan ulang pada hari yang sama tidak boleh menggandakan notifikasi.
        $this->artisan('contracts:remind', ['--date' => now('Asia/Jakarta')->toDateString()])
            ->assertSuccessful();

        $this->assertSame(
            1,
            Notification::query()
                ->where('type', 'contract_reminder')
                ->where('user_id', $hrd->id)
                ->count()
        );

        // Perpanjangan dibuat sebagai draf dan tertaut ke kontrak lama.
        $this->actingAs($hrd)->post(route('contracts.renew', $contract), [
            'employee_id' => $employee->id,
            'contract_type' => 'pkwt',
            'start_date' => now('Asia/Jakarta')->addDays(31)->toDateString(),
            'end_date' => now('Asia/Jakarta')->addDays(30)->addYear()->toDateString(),
            'notes' => 'Perpanjangan DEMO',
        ])->assertSessionHasNoErrors();

        $renewal = EmploymentContract::query()
            ->where('previous_contract_id', $contract->id)
            ->firstOrFail();

        $this->assertSame('draf', $renewal->status);
        $this->assertSame($employee->id, $renewal->employee_id);
        $this->assertMatchesRegularExpression('/^KTR\/\d{4}\/\d{4}$/', $renewal->contract_number);

        // Kontrak lama baru ditandai diperpanjang setelah kontrak baru disetujui.
        $this->assertSame('akan_berakhir', $contract->fresh()->status);

        $this->actingAs($hrd)->post(route('contracts.submit', $renewal))->assertSessionHasNoErrors();

        $instance = ApprovalInstance::query()
            ->where('subject_type', $renewal->getMorphClass())
            ->where('subject_id', $renewal->id)
            ->firstOrFail();

        $this->actingAs($pimpinan)
            ->post(route('approvals.approve', $instance))
            ->assertSessionHasNoErrors();

        $this->assertSame('aktif', $renewal->fresh()->status);
        $this->assertSame('diperpanjang', $contract->fresh()->status);
    }

    public function test_kontrak_dan_sk_dapat_dibuatkan_pdf_privat(): void
    {
        Storage::fake('local');

        $hrd = $this->user('hrd.demo');
        $employee = $this->employee('DEMO — Bagus Setiawan');

        $contract = $this->contract($employee, $hrd, [
            'contract_number' => 'KTR/UJI/0200',
            'status' => 'aktif',
            'end_date' => now('Asia/Jakarta')->addYear()->toDateString(),
        ]);

        $this->actingAs($hrd)->get(route('contracts.pdf', $contract))->assertOk();

        $contract->refresh();
        $this->assertNotNull($contract->document_path);
        Storage::disk('local')->assertExists($contract->document_path);

        $decree = Decree::create([
            'employee_id' => $employee->id,
            'decree_type' => 'penempatan',
            'number' => 'SK/UJI/0200',
            'decree_date' => now('Asia/Jakarta')->toDateString(),
            'effective_date' => now('Asia/Jakarta')->toDateString(),
            'title' => 'Penempatan DEMO',
            'description' => 'Penetapan penempatan untuk pengujian.',
            'status' => 'draf',
            'created_by' => $hrd->id,
        ]);

        $this->actingAs($hrd)->get(route('decrees.pdf', $decree))->assertOk();

        $decree->refresh();
        $this->assertNotNull($decree->document_path);
        Storage::disk('local')->assertExists($decree->document_path);
    }

    public function test_otorisasi_akses_dokumen_hrd_dan_halaman_persetujuan(): void
    {
        $hrd = $this->user('hrd.demo');
        $pegawai = $this->user('pegawai.demo');
        $keuangan = $this->user('keuangan.demo');
        $admin = $this->user('admin');
        $other = $this->employee('DEMO — Ahmad Fauzan');
        $own = $pegawai->employee;

        $contract = $this->contract($other, $hrd, [
            'contract_number' => 'KTR/UJI/0300',
            'status' => 'aktif',
            'end_date' => now('Asia/Jakarta')->addYear()->toDateString(),
        ]);

        $this->actingAs($pegawai)->get(route('contracts.show', $contract))->assertForbidden();
        $this->actingAs($pegawai)->get('/kontrak/tambah')->assertForbidden();
        $this->actingAs($pegawai)->get('/rekrutmen/pelamar')->assertForbidden();

        $this->actingAs($keuangan)->get('/sk')->assertForbidden();
        $this->actingAs($keuangan)->get('/persetujuan')->assertOk();

        // Pegawai tetap dapat melihat dokumen miliknya sendiri.
        $ownContract = $this->contract($own, $hrd, [
            'contract_number' => 'KTR/UJI/0301',
            'status' => 'aktif',
            'end_date' => now('Asia/Jakarta')->addYear()->toDateString(),
        ]);

        $this->actingAs($pegawai)->get(route('contracts.show', $ownContract))->assertOk();

        $this->actingAs($admin)->get('/persetujuan')->assertOk();
        $this->actingAs($admin)->get('/notifikasi')->assertOk();
    }

    protected function user(string $username): User
    {
        return User::where('username', $username)->firstOrFail();
    }

    protected function employee(string $fullName): Employee
    {
        return Employee::where('full_name', $fullName)->firstOrFail();
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $overrides
     */
    protected function contract(Employee $employee, User $actor, array $overrides = []): EmploymentContract
    {
        return EmploymentContract::create(array_merge([
            'employee_id' => $employee->id,
            'contract_type' => 'pkwt',
            'start_date' => now('Asia/Jakarta')->subMonth()->toDateString(),
            'end_date' => now('Asia/Jakarta')->addMonths(6)->toDateString(),
            'status' => 'draf',
            'created_by' => $actor->id,
        ], $overrides));
    }
}

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build the "Aplikasi Kepegawaian PIS" (Pesantren Imam Syafi'i HRIS) in the 8 stages defined by `Prompt_Induk_Aplikasi_Kepegawaian_PIS.md`.
- Stage 2 was complete and verified; Stage 3 (recruitment and HR administration) is now fully implemented, tested (38 tests passing), and documentation is being updated.

## Requirements
- Follow the Indonesian master prompt: 8 sequential stages, one project/one MySQL database, no fabricated policies/features, no claimed untested completion, no hardcoded salary/tax rates.
- UI language Indonesian; currency IDR; dates DD-MM-YYYY; timezone Asia/Jakarta; DEMO data labeled.
- User confirmed Stage 2 "semua berjalan lancar" and said "oke lanjut ke tahap berikutnya".
- Stage 3 scope: recruitment (vacancies, applicants, documents, interviews, weighted scores), conversion applicant→employee, contracts + renewal + H-30/H-14/H-7 reminders, decrees (SK), mutations/position changes, document templates + numbering + PDF, letters, approval workflow per document type, end-to-end tests, module docs.

## Decisions
- Stack: Laravel 13.43.0 + PHP 8.3.36 + MySQL 8.4.9, Blade + Tailwind 4 + Vite; controllers/Blade (no Livewire usage).
- Custom RBAC preserved; existing `vacancy.*`, `applicant.*`, `interview.assess`, `contract.*`, `decree.*`, `mutation.*`, `letter.*`, `approval_flow.manage` permissions reused.
- Generic four-table approval engine implemented with rule `actor_id != requested_by`; role + scope (`all`, `unit`, `self`) authorization.
- Stage 3 approval flows seeded: `contract`→pimpinan; `decree`→pimpinan; `mutation`→kepala_bagian (unit) then pimpinan; `letter`→pimpinan. Yayasan step intentionally omitted pending K-26.
- Contract status follows DB design (`draf`,`aktif`,`akan_berakhir`,`berakhir`,`diperpanjang`,`dibatalkan`); pending approval keeps `draf`, rejection sets `dibatalkan`.
- Mutation apply closes active assignment with `effective_to = effective_date - 1`, creates new `employee_assignments`, updates employee placement, sets status `diterapkan`.
- Applicant conversion allowed only status `diterima`, unique `converted_employee_id`, reuses applicant identity, rejects duplicate NIK; acceptance only from `dipertimbangkan`.
- Decree/letter statuses follow DB design; letter rejection maps to `dibatalkan` because design lacks `ditolak`.
- Numbering remains temporary per K-18: `KTR/{year}/{seq:4}`, `SK/{year}/{seq:4}`, `SRT/{year}/{seq:4}`, plus internal `vacancy` (`LOW/...`) and `applicant` (`PLM/...`).
- Fixed timezone bugs by comparing calendar date strings (`JobVacancy::isOpen`, `ContractService::sendReminders` use Asia/Jakarta normalization).
- Download filenames sanitized via new `Format::filename()` to avoid `/` in HTTP headers.

## Work State
### Completed
- Stage 1 blueprint (17 doc checks) and Stage 2 verified: 29 passed, 106 assertions before Stage 3.
- Stage 3 migrations created and run on dev DB `pis_kepegawaian`:

<?php

namespace App\Services;

use App\Models\Attendance;
use App\Models\AttendanceCorrection;
use App\Models\AttendanceException;
use App\Models\Employee;
use App\Models\Holiday;
use App\Models\ScheduleAssignment;
use App\Models\Setting;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Models\WorkSchedule;
use App\Models\WorkShift;
use Illuminate\Http\UploadedFile;
use Illuminate\Support\Carbon;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;

class AttendanceService
{
    public function __construct(private readonly NotificationService $notifications)
    {
    }

    /**
     * Jadwal dan shift yang berlaku untuk pegawai pada tanggal tertentu.
     *
     * @return array{assignment: ?ScheduleAssignment, schedule: ?WorkSchedule, day: mixed, shift: ?WorkShift, is_workday: bool}
     */
    public function resolveSchedule(Employee $employee, string $date): array
    {
        $dayOfWeek = Carbon::parse($date, 'Asia/Jakarta')->dayOfWeekIso;

        $assignment = ScheduleAssignment::query()
            ->with('workSchedule.days.shift')
            ->where('employee_id', $employee->id)
            ->whereDate('effective_from', '<=', $date)
            ->where(fn ($query) => $query->whereNull('effective_to')
                ->orWhereDate('effective_to', '>=', $date))
            ->orderByDesc('effective_from')
            ->first();

        $schedule = $assignment?->workSchedule;

        if (! $schedule) {
            $schedule = WorkSchedule::query()
                ->with('days.shift')
                ->where('is_active', true)
                ->whereDate('effective_from', '<=', $date)
                ->where(fn ($query) => $query->whereNull('effective_to')
                    ->orWhereDate('effective_to', '>=', $date))
                ->where(fn ($query) => $query->where('org_unit_id', $employee->org_unit_id)
                    ->orWhereNull('org_unit_id'))
                ->orderByRaw('org_unit_id IS NULL')
                ->first();
        }

        $day = $schedule?->days->firstWhere('day_of_week', $dayOfWeek);
        $shift = $day?->shift;

        $holiday = Holiday::query()->whereDate('date', $date)->exists();
        $isWorkday = ! $holiday && $day?->is_workday && $shift;

        return [
            'assignment' => $assignment,
            'schedule' => $schedule,
            'day' => $day,
            'shift' => $shift,
            'is_workday' => (bool) $isWorkday,
        ];
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $data
     */
    public function checkIn(Employee $employee, array $data, User $actor): Attendance
    {
        $date = now('Asia/Jakarta')->toDateString();
        $resolved = $this->resolveSchedule($employee, $date);

        if (! $resolved['is_workday'] || ! $resolved['shift'] instanceof WorkShift) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                'attendance' => 'Hari ini bukan hari kerja sesuai jadwal Anda.',
            ]);
        }

        $shift = $resolved['shift'];
        $location = $employee->workLocation;
        $this->assertLocation($employee);

        $accuracy = (float) ($data['accuracy_m'] ?? 0);

        if ($accuracy <= 0) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                'attendance' => 'Akurasi GPS tidak terbaca. Gunakan dispensasi bila GPS bermasalah.',
            ]);
        }

        $threshold = $location->accuracy_threshold_m
            ?: (int) Setting::get('attendance.accuracy_threshold_m', 100);

        if ($accuracy > $threshold) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                'attendance' => 'Akurasi GPS '.round($accuracy).' m melebihi batas '.$threshold.' m. Ulangi di tempat terbuka atau ajukan dispensasi.',
            ]);
        }

        $distance = $this->haversine(
            (float) $data['lat'],
            (float) $data['lng'],
            (float) $location->latitude,
            (float) $location->longitude
        );

        if ($distance > (float) $location->radius_m) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                'attendance' => 'Anda berada '.round($distance).' m dari '.$location->name
                    .' (radius '.$location->radius_m.' m). Presensi ditolak; ajukan dispensasi bila ada penugasan luar.',
            ]);
        }

        $key = $this->idempotencyKey($data['idempotency_key'] ?? null);

        return DB::transaction(function () use ($employee, $date, $shift, $resolved, $data, $distance, $key): Attendance {
            $attendance = Attendance::query()
                ->where('employee_id', $employee->id)
                ->whereDate('work_date', $date)
                ->where('shift_id', $shift->id)
                ->lockForUpdate()
                ->first();

            if ($attendance?->is_locked) {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                    'attendance' => 'Data absensi hari ini sudah dikunci payroll dan tidak dapat diubah.',
                ]);
            }

            if ($attendance && $attendance->check_in_at) {
                if ($attendance->check_in_idempotency_key === $key) {
                    return $attendance;
                }

                throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                    'attendance' => 'Anda sudah melakukan presensi masuk hari ini pada '
                        .$attendance->checkInLocal()?->format('H:i').'.',
                ]);
            }

            if (! $attendance) {
                $attendance = new Attendance([
                    'employee_id' => $employee->id,
                    'work_date' => $date,
                    'shift_id' => $shift->id,
                    'schedule_assignment_id' => $resolved['assignment']?->id,
                ]);
            }

            $at = now();

            $attendance->fill([
                'check_in_at' => $at,
                'check_in_lat' => $data['lat'],
                'check_in_lng' => $data['lng'],
                'check_in_accuracy_m' => $data['accuracy_m'],
                'check_in_distance_m' => round($distance, 2),
                'check_in_photo_path' => $data['photo_path'],
                'check_in_ip' => $data['ip'] ?? null,
                'check_in_user_agent' => isset($data['user_agent']) ? substr((string) $data['user_agent'], 0, 255) : null,
                'check_in_idempotency_key' => $key,
                'source' => 'self',
            ]);

            $attendance->late_minutes = $this->lateMinutes($attendance, $shift);
            $attendance->status = $attendance->late_minutes > 0 ? 'terlambat' : 'hadir';
            $attendance->save();

            return $attendance;
        });
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $data
     */
    public function checkOut(Employee $employee, array $data, User $actor): Attendance
    {
        $date = now('Asia/Jakarta')->toDateString();
        $resolved = $this->resolveSchedule($employee, $date);

        if (! $resolved['shift'] instanceof WorkShift) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                'attendance' => 'Shift kerja hari ini tidak ditemukan.',
            ]);
        }

        $shift = $resolved['shift'];
        $location = $employee->workLocation;
        $this->assertLocation($employee);

        $accuracy = (float) ($data['accuracy_m'] ?? 0);

        if ($accuracy <= 0) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                'attendance' => 'Akurasi GPS tidak terbaca. Gunakan dispensasi bila GPS bermasalah.',
            ]);
        }

        $threshold = $location->accuracy_threshold_m
            ?: (int) Setting::get('attendance.accuracy_threshold_m', 100);

        if ($accuracy > $threshold) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                'attendance' => 'Akurasi GPS '.round($accuracy).' m melebihi batas '.$threshold.' m.',
            ]);
        }

        $distance = $this->haversine(
            (float) $data['lat'],
            (float) $data['lng'],
            (float) $location->latitude,
            (float) $location->longitude
        );

        if ($distance > (float) $location->radius_m) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                'attendance' => 'Anda berada '.round($distance).' m dari '.$location->name
                    .' (radius '.$location->radius_m.' m). Presensi pulang ditolak; ajukan dispensasi bila perlu.',
            ]);
        }

        $key = $this->idempotencyKey($data['idempotency_key'] ?? null);

        return DB::transaction(function () use ($employee, $date, $shift, $data, $distance, $key): Attendance {
            $attendance = Attendance::query()
                ->where('employee_id', $employee->id)
                ->whereDate('work_date', $date)
                ->where('shift_id', $shift->id)
                ->lockForUpdate()
                ->first();

            if (! $attendance || ! $attendance->check_in_at) {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                    'attendance' => 'Presensi masuk belum tercatat hari ini.',
                ]);
            }

            if ($attendance->is_locked) {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                    'attendance' => 'Data absensi hari ini sudah dikunci payroll dan tidak dapat diubah.',
                ]);
            }

            if ($attendance->check_out_at) {
                if ($attendance->check_out_idempotency_key === $key) {
                    return $attendance;
                }

                throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                    'attendance' => 'Anda sudah melakukan presensi pulang hari ini pada '
                        .$attendance->checkOutLocal()?->format('H:i').'.',
                ]);
            }

            $attendance->fill([
                'check_out_at' => now(),
                'check_out_lat' => $data['lat'],
                'check_out_lng' => $data['lng'],
                'check_out_accuracy_m' => $data['accuracy_m'],
                'check_out_distance_m' => round($distance, 2),
                'check_out_photo_path' => $data['photo_path'],
                'check_out_ip' => $data['ip'] ?? null,
                'check_out_user_agent' => isset($data['user_agent']) ? substr((string) $data['user_agent'], 0, 255) : null,
                'check_out_idempotency_key' => $key,
            ]);

            $this->recalculate($attendance, $shift);
            $attendance->save();

            return $attendance;
        });
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $data
     */
    public function submitCorrection(Employee $employee, array $data, User $actor): AttendanceCorrection
    {
        $date = (string) $data['work_date'];

        $supervisorId = $employee->direct_supervisor_id;
        $supervisorUser = $supervisorId
            ? User::query()->where('employee_id', $supervisorId)->where('is_active', true)->first()
            : null;

        $status = $supervisorUser ? 'menunggu_atasan' : 'menunggu_hrd';

        if (isset($data['requested_check_in_at'])) {
            $data['requested_check_in_at'] = $this->localToUtc($date, $data['requested_check_in_at']);
        }

        if (isset($data['requested_check_out_at'])) {
            $data['requested_check_out_at'] = $this->localToUtc($date, $data['requested_check_out_at']);
        }

        $attendance = Attendance::query()
            ->where('employee_id', $employee->id)
            ->whereDate('work_date', $date)
            ->latest('id')
            ->first();

        $correction = AttendanceCorrection::create([
            'employee_id' => $employee->id,
            'attendance_id' => $data['attendance_id'] ?? $attendance?->id,
            'work_date' => $date,
            'correction_type' => $data['correction_type'],
            'requested_check_in_at' => $data['requested_check_in_at'] ?? null,
            'requested_check_out_at' => $data['requested_check_out_at'] ?? null,
            'reason' => $data['reason'],
            'evidence_path' => $data['evidence_path'] ?? null,
            'status' => $status,
            'supervisor_id' => $supervisorId,
        ]);

        if ($supervisorUser) {
            $this->notifications->send(
                $supervisorUser,
                'attendance_correction',
                'Koreksi absensi menunggu',
                $employee->full_name.' mengajukan koreksi absensi tanggal '.$date.'.',
                ['correction_id' => $correction->id, 'dedupe_key' => 'correction-'.$correction->id.'-supervisor']
            );
        } else {
            $this->notifyCorrectionHrd($correction);
        }

        return $correction;
    }

    public function approveCorrectionBySupervisor(AttendanceCorrection $correction, User $actor, ?string $note = null): void
    {
        DB::transaction(function () use ($correction, $actor, $note): void {
            $correction = AttendanceCorrection::query()->lockForUpdate()->findOrFail($correction->id);

            if ($correction->status !== 'menunggu_atasan') {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                    'correction' => 'Koreksi tidak berada pada tahap persetujuan atasan.',
                ]);
            }

            if ($actor->employee_id !== $correction->supervisor_id) {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                    'correction' => 'Hanya atasan langsung pegawai yang dapat menyetujui tahap ini.',
                ]);
            }

            $correction->update([
                'status' => 'menunggu_hrd',
                'supervisor_decision_at' => now(),
                'supervisor_note' => $note,
            ]);

            $this->notifyCorrectionHrd($correction);
        });
    }

    public function approveCorrectionByHrd(AttendanceCorrection $correction, User $actor, ?string $note = null): void
    {
        DB::transaction(function () use ($correction, $actor, $note): void {
            $correction = AttendanceCorrection::query()->lockForUpdate()->findOrFail($correction->id);

            if ($correction->status !== 'menunggu_hrd') {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                    'correction' => 'Koreksi tidak berada pada tahap verifikasi HRD.',
                ]);
            }

            $this->applyCorrection($correction);

            $correction->update([
                'status' => 'disetujui',
                'hrd_id' => $actor->id,
                'hrd_decision_at' => now(),
                'hrd_note' => $note,
                'applied_at' => now(),
            ]);

            $this->notifyEmployee($correction->employee, 'Koreksi absensi disetujui', 'Koreksi absensi tanggal '
                .$correction->work_date->toDateString().' telah disetujui dan diterapkan.');
        });
    }

    public function rejectCorrection(AttendanceCorrection $correction, User $actor, string $reason): void
    {
        if (trim($reason) === '') {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['reason' => 'Alasan penolakan wajib diisi.']);
        }

        DB::transaction(function () use ($correction, $actor, $reason): void {
            $correction = AttendanceCorrection::query()->lockForUpdate()->findOrFail($correction->id);

            if (! in_array($correction->status, ['menunggu_atasan', 'menunggu_hrd'], true)) {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                    'correction' => 'Koreksi sudah selesai diproses.',
                ]);
            }

            if ($correction->status === 'menunggu_atasan') {
                if ($actor->employee_id !== $correction->supervisor_id) {
                    throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                        'correction' => 'Hanya atasan langsung yang dapat menolak pada tahap ini.',
                    ]);
                }

                $correction->update([
                    'status' => 'ditolak',
                    'supervisor_decision_at' => now(),
                    'supervisor_note' => $reason,
                ]);
            } else {
                if (! $actor->hasPermission('attendance.correction.approve.hrd')) {
                    throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                        'correction' => 'Anda tidak berwenang menolak pada tahap HRD.',
                    ]);
                }

                $correction->update([
                    'status' => 'ditolak',
                    'hrd_id' => $actor->id,
                    'hrd_decision_at' => now(),
                    'hrd_note' => $reason,
                ]);
            }

            $this->notifyEmployee(
                $correction->employee,
                'Koreksi absensi ditolak',
                'Koreksi absensi tanggal '.$correction->work_date->toDateString().' ditolak: '.$reason
            );
        });
    }

    public function cancelCorrection(AttendanceCorrection $correction, User $actor): void
    {
        if (! in_array($correction->status, ['menunggu_atasan', 'menunggu_hrd'], true)) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['correction' => 'Koreksi sudah selesai diproses.']);
        }

        if ($actor->employee_id !== $correction->employee_id && ! $actor->hasRole('administrator')) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['correction' => 'Hanya pengaju yang dapat membatalkan koreksi.']);
        }

        $correction->update(['status' => 'dibatalkan']);
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $data
     */
    public function submitException(Employee $employee, array $data, User $actor): AttendanceException
    {
        $date = (string) $data['work_date'];

        if (isset($data['check_in_at'])) {
            $data['check_in_at'] = $this->localToUtc($date, $data['check_in_at']);
        }

        if (isset($data['check_out_at'])) {
            $data['check_out_at'] = $this->localToUtc($date, $data['check_out_at']);
        }

        $exception = AttendanceException::create([
            'employee_id' => $employee->id,
            'work_date' => $date,
            'type' => $data['type'],
            'check_in_at' => $data['check_in_at'] ?? null,
            'check_out_at' => $data['check_out_at'] ?? null,
            'reason' => $data['reason'],
            'evidence_path' => $data['evidence_path'] ?? null,
            'status' => 'menunggu',
        ]);

        $this->notifications->sendToPermission(
            'attendance.exception.manage',
            'attendance_exception',
            'Dispensasi absensi menunggu',
            $employee->full_name.' mengajukan dispensasi absensi tanggal '.$date.'.',
            ['exception_id' => $exception->id, 'dedupe_key' => 'exception-'.$exception->id]
        );

        return $exception;
    }

    public function approveException(AttendanceException $exception, User $actor): void
    {
        DB::transaction(function () use ($exception, $actor): void {
            $exception = AttendanceException::query()->lockForUpdate()->findOrFail($exception->id);

            if ($exception->status !== 'menunggu') {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages(['exception' => 'Dispensasi sudah diproses.']);
            }

            $employee = $exception->employee;
            $resolved = $this->resolveSchedule($employee, $exception->work_date->toDateString());

            if (! $resolved['shift'] instanceof WorkShift) {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                    'exception' => 'Shift kerja pada tanggal tersebut tidak ditemukan.',
                ]);
            }

            $shift = $resolved['shift'];

            $attendance = Attendance::query()
                ->where('employee_id', $employee->id)
                ->whereDate('work_date', $exception->work_date)
                ->where('shift_id', $shift->id)
                ->lockForUpdate()
                ->first();

            if ($attendance?->is_locked) {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                    'exception' => 'Data absensi tanggal tersebut sudah dikunci payroll.',
                ]);
            }

            if (! $attendance) {
                $attendance = new Attendance([
                    'employee_id' => $employee->id,
                    'work_date' => $exception->work_date,
                    'shift_id' => $shift->id,
                    'schedule_assignment_id' => $resolved['assignment']?->id,
                ]);
            }

            $attendance->fill([
                'check_in_at' => $exception->check_in_at ?? $attendance->check_in_at,
                'check_out_at' => $exception->check_out_at ?? $attendance->check_out_at,
                'status' => 'dispensasi',
                'source' => 'system',
                'notes' => 'Dispensasi #'.$exception->id.' ('.$exception->type.')',
            ]);

            $this->recalculate($attendance, $shift, keepStatus: true);
            $attendance->save();

            $exception->update([
                'status' => 'disetujui',
                'approved_by' => $actor->id,
                'approved_at' => now(),
            ]);

            $this->notifyEmployee(
                $employee,
                'Dispensasi absensi disetujui',
                'Dispensasi absensi tanggal '.$exception->work_date->toDateString().' telah disetujui.'
            );
        });
    }

    public function rejectException(AttendanceException $exception, User $actor, string $reason): void
    {
        if (trim($reason) === '') {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['reason' => 'Alasan penolakan wajib diisi.']);
        }

        if ($exception->status !== 'menunggu') {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['exception' => 'Dispensasi sudah diproses.']);
        }

        $exception->update([
            'status' => 'ditolak',
            'approved_by' => $actor->id,
            'approved_at' => now(),
            'reason' => $exception->reason."\n\nPenolakan: ".$reason,
        ]);

        $this->notifyEmployee(
            $exception->employee,
            'Dispensasi absensi ditolak',
            'Dispensasi absensi tanggal '.$exception->work_date->toDateString().' ditolak: '.$reason
        );
    }

    public function storePhoto(UploadedFile $file, string $folder): string
    {
        $path = $file->store($folder.'/'.now('Asia/Jakarta')->format('Y/m'), 'local');

        if (! $path) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                'photo' => 'Foto gagal disimpan. Silakan ulangi.',
            ]);
        }

        return $path;
    }

    public function haversine(float $lat1, float $lng1, float $lat2, float $lng2): float
    {
        $earth = 6371000;
        $latFrom = deg2rad($lat1);
        $latTo = deg2rad($lat2);
        $latDelta = deg2rad($lat2 - $lat1);
        $lngDelta = deg2rad($lng2 - $lng1);

        $a = sin($latDelta / 2) ** 2
            + cos($latFrom) * cos($latTo) * sin($lngDelta / 2) ** 2;

        return $earth * 2 * atan2(sqrt($a), sqrt(1 - $a));
    }

    /**
     * @return array<int, string>
     */
    public function recentDates(int $days = 7): array
    {
        $dates = [];

        for ($i = 0; $i < $days; $i++) {
            $dates[] = now('Asia/Jakarta')->subDays($i)->toDateString();
        }

        return $dates;
    }

    protected function applyCorrection(AttendanceCorrection $correction): void
    {
        $employee = $correction->employee;
        $resolved = $this->resolveSchedule($employee, $correction->work_date->toDateString());

        if (! $resolved['shift'] instanceof WorkShift) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                'correction' => 'Shift kerja pada tanggal tersebut tidak ditemukan.',
            ]);
        }

        $shift = $resolved['shift'];

        $attendance = Attendance::query()
            ->where('employee_id', $employee->id)
            ->whereDate('work_date', $correction->work_date)
            ->where('shift_id', $shift->id)
            ->lockForUpdate()
            ->first();

        if ($attendance?->is_locked) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                'correction' => 'Data absensi tanggal tersebut sudah dikunci payroll.',
            ]);
        }

        if (! $attendance) {
            $attendance = new Attendance([
                'employee_id' => $employee->id,
                'work_date' => $correction->work_date,
                'shift_id' => $shift->id,
                'schedule_assignment_id' => $resolved['assignment']?->id,
            ]);
        }

        $type = $correction->correction_type;

        if ($type === 'tidak_hadir') {
            $attendance->fill([
                'check_in_at' => null,
                'check_out_at' => null,
                'check_in_lat' => null,
                'check_in_lng' => null,
                'check_in_accuracy_m' => null,
                'check_in_distance_m' => null,
                'check_in_photo_path' => null,
                'check_out_lat' => null,
                'check_out_lng' => null,
                'check_out_accuracy_m' => null,
                'check_out_distance_m' => null,
                'check_out_photo_path' => null,
                'late_minutes' => 0,
                'early_leave_minutes' => 0,
                'work_minutes' => 0,
                'status' => 'tidak_hadir',
            ]);
        } else {
            if (in_array($type, ['masuk', 'keduanya'], true)) {
                if (! $correction->requested_check_in_at) {
                    throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                        'correction' => 'Jam masuk yang diminta belum diisi.',
                    ]);
                }

                $attendance->check_in_at = $correction->requested_check_in_at;
            }

            if (in_array($type, ['pulang', 'keduanya'], true)) {
                if (! $correction->requested_check_out_at) {
                    throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                        'correction' => 'Jam pulang yang diminta belum diisi.',
                    ]);
                }

                $attendance->check_out_at = $correction->requested_check_out_at;
            }

            if (! $attendance->check_in_at) {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                    'correction' => 'Koreksi pulang membutuhkan jam masuk yang tercatat.',
                ]);
            }

            $this->recalculate($attendance, $shift);
        }

        $attendance->fill([
            'source' => 'correction',
            'is_corrected' => true,
            'notes' => 'Koreksi #'.$correction->id.' disetujui',
        ]);

        $attendance->save();
    }

    protected function recalculate(Attendance $attendance, WorkShift $shift, bool $keepStatus = false): void
    {
        if ($attendance->check_in_at) {
            $attendance->late_minutes = $this->lateMinutes($attendance, $shift);
        }

        if ($attendance->check_out_at) {
            $attendance->early_leave_minutes = $this->earlyLeaveMinutes($attendance, $shift);
        }

        if ($attendance->check_in_at && $attendance->check_out_at) {
            $attendance->work_minutes = max(
                0,
                (int) $attendance->check_in_at->diffInMinutes($attendance->check_out_at, false) - $shift->break_minutes
            );
        }

        if ($keepStatus) {
            return;
        }

        $attendance->status = match (true) {
            $attendance->late_minutes > 0 => 'terlambat',
            $attendance->early_leave_minutes > 0 => 'pulang_awal',
            default => 'hadir',
        };
    }

    protected function lateMinutes(Attendance $attendance, WorkShift $shift): int
    {
        if (! $attendance->check_in_at) {
            return 0;
        }

        $start = Carbon::parse($attendance->work_date->toDateString().' '.$shift->start_time, 'Asia/Jakarta');
        $actual = $attendance->check_in_at->copy()->timezone('Asia/Jakarta');

        return max(0, (int) $start->diffInMinutes($actual, false) - $shift->late_tolerance_minutes);
    }

    protected function earlyLeaveMinutes(Attendance $attendance, WorkShift $shift): int
    {
        if (! $attendance->check_out_at) {
            return 0;
        }

        $end = Carbon::parse($attendance->work_date->toDateString().' '.$shift->end_time, 'Asia/Jakarta');

        if ($shift->is_cross_midnight) {
            $end->addDay();
        }

        $actual = $attendance->check_out_at->copy()->timezone('Asia/Jakarta');

        return max(0, (int) $actual->diffInMinutes($end, false) - $shift->early_leave_tolerance_minutes);
    }

    /**
     * @return array<int, string>
     */
    protected function idempotencyKey(?string $key): array|string
    {
        $key = trim((string) $key);

        return $key !== '' ? $key : Str::uuid()->toString();
    }

    protected function localToUtc(string $date, string $time): Carbon
    {
        $time = substr($time, 0, 5);

        return Carbon::parse($date.' '.$time, 'Asia/Jakarta')->utc();
    }

    protected function assertLocation(Employee $employee): void
    {
        if (! $employee->workLocation) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                'attendance' => 'Lokasi kerja pegawai belum diatur. Hubungi HRD.',
            ]);
        }
    }

    protected function notifyCorrectionHrd(AttendanceCorrection $correction): void
    {
        $this->notifications->sendToPermission(
            'attendance.correction.approve.hrd',
            'attendance_correction',
            'Koreksi absensi menunggu verifikasi HRD',
            $correction->employee->full_name.' — koreksi absensi tanggal '
                .$correction->work_date->toDateString().'.',
            [
                'correction_id' => $correction->id,
                'dedupe_key' => 'correction-'.$correction->id.'-hrd',
            ]
        );
    }

    protected function notifyEmployee(Employee $employee, string $title, string $message): void
    {
        $user = $employee->user;

        if ($user) {
            $this->notifications->send($user, 'attendance', $title, $message, [
                'employee_id' => $employee->id,
            ]);
        }
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Services;

use App\Models\Attendance;
use App\Models\Employee;
use App\Models\LeaveBalance;
use App\Models\LeaveRequest;
use App\Models\LeaveRequestDay;
use App\Models\LeaveType;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Support\Carbon;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;

class LeaveService
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly AttendanceService $attendance,
        private readonly NotificationService $notifications
    ) {
    }

    /**
     * Hari kerja efektif dalam rentang tanggal (mengikuti jadwal dan hari libur).
     *
     * @return array<int, string>
     */
    public function workingDays(Employee $employee, string $start, string $end): array
    {
        $days = [];
        $cursor = Carbon::parse($start, 'Asia/Jakarta');
        $last = Carbon::parse($end, 'Asia/Jakarta');

        while ($cursor->lte($last)) {
            $date = $cursor->toDateString();
            $resolved = $this->attendance->resolveSchedule($employee, $date);

            if ($resolved['is_workday']) {
                $days[] = $date;
            }

            $cursor->addDay();
        }

        return $days;
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $data
     */
    public function create(Employee $employee, array $data, User $actor): LeaveRequest
    {
        $type = LeaveType::query()->whereKey($data['leave_type_id'])->where('is_active', true)->firstOrFail();
        $start = (string) $data['start_date'];
        $end = (string) $data['end_date'];

        if ($end < $start) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                'end_date' => 'Tanggal selesai tidak boleh sebelum tanggal mulai.',
            ]);
        }

        $overlap = LeaveRequest::query()
            ->where('employee_id', $employee->id)
            ->whereIn('status', ['menunggu_atasan', 'menunggu_hrd', 'disetujui'])
            ->whereDate('start_date', '<=', $end)
            ->whereDate('end_date', '>=', $start)
            ->exists();

        if ($overlap) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                'start_date' => 'Terdapat pengajuan izin/cuti lain pada rentang tanggal tersebut.',
            ]);
        }

        $days = $this->workingDays($employee, $start, $end);

        if ($days === []) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                'start_date' => 'Tidak ada hari kerja efektif pada rentang tanggal tersebut.',
            ]);
        }

        $this->assertDocumentRequirement($type, count($days), $data['document_path'] ?? null);
        $this->assertBalance($employee, $type, $days);

        $supervisorUser = $employee->direct_supervisor_id
            ? User::query()->where('employee_id', $employee->direct_supervisor_id)->where('is_active', true)->first()
            : null;

        return DB::transaction(function () use ($employee, $type, $start, $end, $days, $data, $supervisorUser): LeaveRequest {
            $request = LeaveRequest::create([
                'employee_id' => $employee->id,
                'leave_type_id' => $type->id,
                'start_date' => $start,
                'end_date' => $end,
                'total_days' => count($days),
                'reason' => $data['reason'],
                'document_path' => $data['document_path'] ?? null,
                'status' => $supervisorUser ? 'menunggu_atasan' : 'menunggu_hrd',
                'current_step' => $supervisorUser ? 1 : 2,
                'submitted_at' => now(),
            ]);

            foreach ($days as $date) {
                $request->days()->create(['date' => $date]);
            }

            if ($supervisorUser) {
                $this->notifications->send(
                    $supervisorUser,
                    'leave',
                    'Pengajuan izin/cuti menunggu',
                    $employee->full_name.' mengajukan '.$type->name.' tanggal '.$start.' s.d. '.$end.'.',
                    ['leave_request_id' => $request->id, 'dedupe_key' => 'leave-'.$request->id.'-supervisor']
                );
            } else {
                $this->notifyHrd($request);
            }

            return $request;
        });
    }

    public function approveBySupervisor(LeaveRequest $request, User $actor, ?string $note = null): void
    {
        DB::transaction(function () use ($request, $actor): void {
            $request = LeaveRequest::query()->lockForUpdate()->findOrFail($request->id);

            if ($request->status !== 'menunggu_atasan') {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                    'leave' => 'Pengajuan tidak berada pada tahap persetujuan atasan.',
                ]);
            }

            if ($actor->employee_id !== $request->employee->direct_supervisor_id) {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                    'leave' => 'Hanya atasan langsung pegawai yang dapat menyetujui tahap ini.',
                ]);
            }

            $request->update([
                'status' => 'menunggu_hrd',
                'current_step' => 2,
            ]);

            $this->notifyHrd($request->fresh('employee', 'leaveType'));
        });
    }

    public function approveByHrd(LeaveRequest $request, User $actor, ?string $note = null): void
    {
        DB::transaction(function () use ($request, $actor): void {
            $request = LeaveRequest::query()->lockForUpdate()->findOrFail($request->id);

            if ($request->status !== 'menunggu_hrd') {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                    'leave' => 'Pengajuan tidak berada pada tahap verifikasi HRD.',
                ]);
            }

            $days = $request->days->pluck('date')->map->toDateString()->all();
            $this->assertBalance($request->employee, $request->leaveType, $days, $request->id);
            $this->applyLeaveAttendance($request);

            $request->update([
                'status' => 'disetujui',
                'decided_at' => now(),
            ]);

            $this->applyBalance($request);

            $this->notifyEmployee(
                $request->employee,
                'Pengajuan izin/cuti disetujui',
                $request->leaveType->name.' tanggal '.$request->start_date->toDateString()
                    .' s.d. '.$request->end_date->toDateString().' telah disetujui.'
            );
        });
    }

    public function reject(LeaveRequest $request, User $actor, string $reason): void
    {
        if (trim($reason) === '') {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['reason' => 'Alasan penolakan wajib diisi.']);
        }

        DB::transaction(function () use ($request, $actor, $reason): void {
            $request = LeaveRequest::query()->lockForUpdate()->findOrFail($request->id);

            if (! $request->isPending()) {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages(['leave' => 'Pengajuan sudah selesai diproses.']);
            }

            if ($request->status === 'menunggu_atasan') {
                if ($actor->employee_id !== $request->employee->direct_supervisor_id) {
                    throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                        'leave' => 'Hanya atasan langsung yang dapat menolak pada tahap ini.',
                    ]);
                }
            } elseif (! $actor->hasPermission('leave.approve.hrd')) {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                    'leave' => 'Anda tidak berwenang menolak pada tahap HRD.',
                ]);
            }

            $request->update([
                'status' => 'ditolak',
                'rejection_reason' => $reason,
                'decided_at' => now(),
            ]);

            $this->notifyEmployee(
                $request->employee,
                'Pengajuan izin/cuti ditolak',
                $request->leaveType->name.' tanggal '.$request->start_date->toDateString()
                    .' s.d. '.$request->end_date->toDateString().' ditolak: '.$reason
            );
        });
    }

    public function cancel(LeaveRequest $request, User $actor): void
    {
        if (! $request->isPending()) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['leave' => 'Hanya pengajuan yang masih menunggu dapat dibatalkan.']);
        }

        if ($actor->employee_id !== $request->employee_id && ! $actor->hasRole('administrator')) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['leave' => 'Hanya pengaju yang dapat membatalkan pengajuan.']);
        }

        $request->update(['status' => 'dibatalkan']);
    }

    public function balanceFor(Employee $employee, LeaveType $type, int $year): LeaveBalance
    {
        return LeaveBalance::firstOrCreate(
            [
                'employee_id' => $employee->id,
                'leave_type_id' => $type->id,
                'year' => $year,
            ],
            [
                'entitlement_days' => $type->max_days_per_year ?? 0,
                'used_days' => 0,
                'adjustment_days' => 0,
                'updated_at' => now(),
            ]
        );
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<int, string>  $days
     */
    protected function assertBalance(Employee $employee, LeaveType $type, array $days, ?int $excludeRequestId = null): void
    {
        if (! $type->affects_balance) {
            return;
        }

        foreach ($this->daysByYear($days) as $year => $count) {
            $balance = $this->balanceFor($employee, $type, $year);
            $pending = $this->pendingDays($employee, $type, $year, $excludeRequestId);
            $remaining = $balance->remainingDays() - $pending;

            if ($remaining + 0.0001 < $count) {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                    'leave' => 'Saldo '.$type->name.' tahun '.$year.' tidak mencukupi. '
                        .'Sisa '.rtrim(rtrim(number_format($remaining, 1, ',', '.'), '0'), ',').' hari, '
                        .'diajukan '.$count.' hari.',
                ]);
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<int, string>  $days
     * @return array<int, int>
     */
    protected function daysByYear(array $days): array
    {
        $byYear = [];

        foreach ($days as $date) {
            $year = (int) substr((string) $date, 0, 4);
            $byYear[$year] = ($byYear[$year] ?? 0) + 1;
        }

        return $byYear;
    }

    protected function pendingDays(Employee $employee, LeaveType $type, int $year, ?int $excludeRequestId): int
    {
        return (int) LeaveRequestDay::query()
            ->whereYear('date', $year)
            ->whereHas('leaveRequest', function ($query) use ($employee, $type, $excludeRequestId): void {
                $query->where('employee_id', $employee->id)
                    ->where('leave_type_id', $type->id)
                    ->whereIn('status', ['menunggu_atasan', 'menunggu_hrd', 'disetujui'])
                    ->when($excludeRequestId, fn ($q) => $q->whereKeyNot($excludeRequestId));
            })
            ->count();
    }

    protected function applyBalance(LeaveRequest $request): void
    {
        if (! $request->leaveType->affects_balance) {
            return;
        }

        $days = $request->days->pluck('date')->map->toDateString()->all();

        foreach ($this->daysByYear($days) as $year => $count) {
            $balance = $this->balanceFor($request->employee, $request->leaveType, $year);
            $balance->update([
                'used_days' => (float) $balance->used_days + $count,
                'updated_at' => now(),
            ]);
        }
    }

    protected function applyLeaveAttendance(LeaveRequest $request): void
    {
        $status = match ($request->leaveType->code) {
            'sakit' => 'sakit',
            'dinas' => 'dispensasi',
            default => 'izin',
        };

        $prepared = [];

        foreach ($request->days as $day) {
            $date = $day->date->toDateString();
            $resolved = $this->attendance->resolveSchedule($request->employee, $date);

            if (! $resolved['shift']) {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                    'leave' => 'Shift kerja pada tanggal '.$date.' tidak ditemukan.',
                ]);
            }

            $row = Attendance::query()
                ->where('employee_id', $request->employee_id)
                ->whereDate('work_date', $date)
                ->where('shift_id', $resolved['shift']->id)
                ->lockForUpdate()
                ->first();

            if ($row?->is_locked) {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                    'leave' => 'Absensi tanggal '.$date.' sudah dikunci payroll; pengajuan tidak dapat diterapkan.',
                ]);
            }

            $prepared[] = [$date, $resolved, $row];
        }

        foreach ($prepared as [$date, $resolved, $row]) {
            if (! $row) {
                $row = new Attendance([
                    'employee_id' => $request->employee_id,
                    'work_date' => $date,
                    'shift_id' => $resolved['shift']->id,
                    'schedule_assignment_id' => $resolved['assignment']?->id,
                ]);
            }

            $row->fill([
                'check_in_at' => null,
                'check_out_at' => null,
                'check_in_photo_path' => null,
                'check_out_photo_path' => null,
                'late_minutes' => 0,
                'early_leave_minutes' => 0,
                'work_minutes' => 0,
                'status' => $status,
                'source' => 'system',
                'notes' => 'Izin/cuti #'.$request->id.' ('.$request->leaveType->code.')',
            ]);

            $row->save();
        }
    }

    protected function assertDocumentRequirement(LeaveType $type, int $totalDays, ?string $documentPath): void
    {
        if (! $type->requires_document) {
            return;
        }

        $threshold = $type->document_required_after_days;

        if ($threshold !== null && $totalDays <= $threshold) {
            return;
        }

        if (! $documentPath) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                'document' => 'Dokumen pendukung wajib diunggah untuk '.$type->name
                    .($threshold ? ' lebih dari '.$threshold.' hari' : '').'.',
            ]);
        }
    }

    protected function notifyHrd(LeaveRequest $request): void
    {
        $this->notifications->sendToPermission(
            'leave.approve.hrd',
            'leave',
            'Pengajuan izin/cuti menunggu verifikasi HRD',
            $request->employee->full_name.' — '.$request->leaveType->name.' '
                .$request->start_date->toDateString().' s.d. '.$request->end_date->toDateString().'.',
            [
                'leave_request_id' => $request->id,
                'dedupe_key' => 'leave-'.$request->id.'-hrd',
            ]
        );
    }

    protected function notifyEmployee(Employee $employee, string $title, string $message): void
    {
        if ($employee->user) {
            $this->notifications->send($employee->user, 'leave', $title, $message, [
                'employee_id' => $employee->id,
            ]);
        }
    }
}
