<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use App\Http\Controllers\Concerns\GuardsHrAccess;
use App\Models\Attendance;
use App\Models\Employee;
use App\Models\Setting;
use App\Services\AttendanceService;
use Illuminate\Http\RedirectResponse;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;
use Illuminate\View\View;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\StreamedResponse;

class AttendanceController extends Controller
{
    use GuardsHrAccess;

    public function __construct(private readonly AttendanceService $attendance)
    {
    }

    public function index(Request $request): View
    {
        $this->ensurePermission($request, 'attendance.self');

        $employee = $request->user()->employee;

        if (! $employee) {
            return view('attendance.self', [
                'employee' => null,
                'attendance' => null,
                'resolved' => null,
                'location' => null,
                'recent' => collect(),
                'checkInKey' => null,
                'checkOutKey' => null,
                'maxPhotoKb' => (int) Setting::get('attendance.max_photo_kb', 2048),
            ]);
        }

        $today = now('Asia/Jakarta')->toDateString();

        $attendance = Attendance::query()
            ->with('shift')
            ->where('employee_id', $employee->id)
            ->whereDate('work_date', $today)
            ->latest('id')
            ->first();

        $recent = Attendance::query()
            ->with('shift')
            ->where('employee_id', $employee->id)
            ->whereDate('work_date', '<', $today)
            ->orderByDesc('work_date')
            ->limit(7)
            ->get();

        return view('attendance.self', [
            'employee' => $employee->load('workLocation', 'orgUnit', 'position'),
            'attendance' => $attendance,
            'resolved' => $this->attendance->resolveSchedule($employee, $today),
            'location' => $employee->workLocation,
            'recent' => $recent,
            'checkInKey' => (string) Str::uuid(),
            'checkOutKey' => (string) Str::uuid(),
            'maxPhotoKb' => (int) Setting::get('attendance.max_photo_kb', 2048),
        ]);
    }

    public function checkIn(Request $request): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->ensurePermission($request, 'attendance.self');

        $employee = $this->requireEmployee($request);
        $data = $this->validatedPunch($request);
        $data['photo_path'] = $this->attendance->storePhoto($request->file('photo'), 'attendance/check-in');
        $data['ip'] = $request->ip();
        $data['user_agent'] = $request->userAgent();

        $attendance = $this->attendance->checkIn($employee, $data, $request->user());

        return redirect()->route('attendance.index')->with(
            'success',
            'Presensi masuk tercatat pukul '.$attendance->checkInLocal()?->format('H:i').'.'
        );
    }

    public function checkOut(Request $request): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->ensurePermission($request, 'attendance.self');

        $employee = $this->requireEmployee($request);
        $data = $this->validatedPunch($request);
        $data['photo_path'] = $this->attendance->storePhoto($request->file('photo'), 'attendance/check-out');
        $data['ip'] = $request->ip();
        $data['user_agent'] = $request->userAgent();

        $attendance = $this->attendance->checkOut($employee, $data, $request->user());

        return redirect()->route('attendance.index')->with(
            'success',
            'Presensi pulang tercatat pukul '.$attendance->checkOutLocal()?->format('H:i').'.'
        );
    }

    public function history(Request $request): View
    {
        $this->ensurePermission($request, 'attendance.view.self');
        $employee = $this->requireEmployee($request);

        $month = (string) $request->input('month', now('Asia/Jakarta')->format('Y-m'));
        $from = $month.'-01';
        $to = date('Y-m-t', strtotime($from));

        $rows = Attendance::query()
            ->with('shift')
            ->where('employee_id', $employee->id)
            ->whereDate('work_date', '>=', $from)
            ->whereDate('work_date', '<=', $to)
            ->orderByDesc('work_date')
            ->paginate(31)
            ->withQueryString();

        return view('attendance.history', [
            'employee' => $employee,
            'rows' => $rows,
            'month' => $month,
            'summary' => $this->summaryFor($employee->id, $from, $to),
        ]);
    }

    public function show(Request $request, Attendance $attendance): View
    {
        $this->ensurePermission($request, 'attendance.view.self');
        $this->ensureRecordVisible($request, $attendance->employee_id);

        $attendance->load(['employee.orgUnit', 'employee.position', 'shift', 'corrections.supervisor', 'corrections.hrd']);

        return view('attendance.show', ['attendance' => $attendance]);
    }

    public function photo(Request $request, Attendance $attendance, string $type): StreamedResponse
    {
        $this->ensurePermission($request, 'attendance.view.self');
        $this->ensureRecordVisible($request, $attendance->employee_id);

        abort_unless(in_array($type, ['in', 'out'], true), 404);

        $path = $type === 'in' ? $attendance->check_in_photo_path : $attendance->check_out_photo_path;

        abort_unless($path && Storage::disk('local')->exists($path), 404, 'Foto tidak ditemukan.');

        return Storage::disk('local')->response($path);
    }

    public function report(Request $request): View
    {
        $this->ensurePermission($request, 'attendance.report');

        $from = (string) $request->input('from', now('Asia/Jakarta')->startOfMonth()->toDateString());
        $to = (string) $request->input('to', now('Asia/Jakarta')->toDateString());

        $query = Attendance::query()
            ->with(['employee:id,nip,full_name,org_unit_id', 'employee.orgUnit:id,name', 'shift:id,name'])
            ->whereDate('work_date', '>=', $from)
            ->whereDate('work_date', '<=', $to);

        $this->scopeEmployeeRecords($query, $request->user());

        if ($request->filled('employee_id')) {
            $query->where('employee_id', (int) $request->input('employee_id'));
        }

        if ($status = $request->input('status')) {
            $query->where('status', $status);
        }

        $summary = (clone $query)
            ->reorder()
            ->selectRaw("COUNT(*) as total,
                SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'hadir' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as hadir,
                SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'terlambat' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as terlambat,
                SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'pulang_awal' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as pulang_awal,
                SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'tidak_hadir' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as tidak_hadir,
                SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'izin' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as izin,
                SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'sakit' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as sakit,
                SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'dispensasi' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as dispensasi,
                SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'libur' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as libur,
                COALESCE(SUM(late_minutes), 0) as total_late_minutes,
                COALESCE(SUM(early_leave_minutes), 0) as total_early_minutes,
                COALESCE(SUM(work_minutes), 0) as total_work_minutes")
            ->first();

        return view('attendance.report', [
            'rows' => $query->orderByDesc('work_date')->orderBy('employee_id')->paginate(31)->withQueryString(),
            'summary' => $summary,
            'from' => $from,
            'to' => $to,
            'employees' => Employee::query()->visibleTo($request->user())->orderBy('full_name')->pluck('full_name', 'id'),
            'statuses' => Attendance::statusLabels(),
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    protected function validatedPunch(Request $request): array
    {
        $maxKb = (int) Setting::get('attendance.max_photo_kb', 2048);

        return $request->validate([
            'lat' => ['required', 'numeric', 'between:-90,90'],
            'lng' => ['required', 'numeric', 'between:-180,180'],
            'accuracy_m' => ['required', 'numeric', 'min:0', 'max:100000'],
            'idempotency_key' => ['nullable', 'uuid'],
            'photo' => ['required', 'image', 'mimes:jpg,jpeg,png,webp', 'max:'.$maxKb],
        ], [
            'photo.required' => 'Foto selfie wajib diambil untuk presensi mandiri.',
            'photo.image' => 'Berkas foto tidak valid.',
        ]);
    }

    protected function requireEmployee(Request $request): Employee
    {
        $employee = $request->user()->employee;

        if (! $employee) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                'attendance' => 'Akun Anda belum terhubung dengan data pegawai.',
            ]);
        }

        return $employee;
    }

    /**
     * @return object
     */
    protected function summaryFor(int $employeeId, string $from, string $to): object
    {
        return Attendance::query()
            ->where('employee_id', $employeeId)
            ->whereDate('work_date', '>=', $from)
            ->whereDate('work_date', '<=', $to)
            ->selectRaw("COUNT(*) as total,
                SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'hadir' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as hadir,
                SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'terlambat' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as terlambat,
                SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'pulang_awal' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as pulang_awal,
                SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'izin' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as izin,
                SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'sakit' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as sakit,
                SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'tidak_hadir' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as tidak_hadir,
                SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'dispensasi' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as dispensasi,
                COALESCE(SUM(late_minutes), 0) as total_late_minutes,
                COALESCE(SUM(work_minutes), 0) as total_work_minutes")
            ->first();
    }
}

        $employee = $request->user()->employee;

        return $employee;

{

    public function __construct(
        private readonly LeaveService $leave,
        private readonly AttendanceService $files
    ) {
    }

    public function index(Request $request): View
    {
        $user = $request->user();

        abort_unless(
            $user->hasAnyPermission(['leave.view.self', 'leave.view.unit', 'leave.view.all']),
            403
        );

        $query = LeaveRequest::query()
            ->with(['employee:id,nip,full_name,org_unit_id', 'employee.orgUnit:id,name', 'leaveType:id,code,name']);

        if ($user->hasPermission('leave.view.all')) {
            // seluruh data
        } elseif ($user->hasPermission('leave.view.unit')) {
            $query->whereIn('employee_id', Employee::query()->visibleTo($user)->select('id'));
        } else {
            $query->where('employee_id', $user->employee_id ?? 0);
        }

        if ($status = $request->input('status')) {
            $query->where('status', $status);
        }

        if ($request->filled('leave_type_id')) {
            $query->where('leave_type_id', (int) $request->input('leave_type_id'));
        }

        if ($from = $request->input('from')) {

            'canRequest' => $user->hasPermission('leave.request') && $user->employee_id,
        ]);
    }

    public function create(Request $request): View
    {
        $this->ensurePermission($request, 'leave.request');
        $employee = $this->requireEmployee($request);

        return view('leave.form', [
            'employee' => $employee,
            'types' => LeaveType::query()->where('is_active', true)->orderBy('sort_order')->get(),
        ]);
    }

    public function store(Request $request): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->ensurePermission($request, 'leave.request');
        $employee = $this->requireEmployee($request);

        $data = $request->validate([
            'leave_type_id' => ['required', 'exists:leave_types,id'],
            'start_date' => ['required', 'date'],
            'end_date' => ['required', 'date', 'after_or_equal:start_date'],
            'reason' => ['required', 'string', 'min:10', 'max:2000'],
            'document' => ['nullable', 'file', 'mimes:jpg,jpeg,png,pdf', 'max:4096'],

            'reason.min' => 'Alasan pengajuan minimal 10 karakter.',
        ]);

        if ($request->hasFile('document')) {
            $data['document_path'] = $this->files->storePhoto($request->file('document'), 'leave/documents');
        }

        $leave = $this->leave->create($employee, $data, $request->user());

        return redirect()->route('leave.show', $leave)
            ->with('success', 'Pengajuan izin/cuti dikirim.');
    }

    public function show(Request $request, LeaveRequest $leave): View
    {
        $this->ensureVisible($request, $leave);

        $leave->load([
            'employee.orgUnit', 'employee.position', 'leaveType', 'days',
        ]);

        $canApproveSupervisor = $request->user()->hasPermission('leave.approve.supervisor')

            'canApproveSupervisor' => $canApproveSupervisor,

                && $leave->status === 'menunggu_hrd',
            'canCancel' => $request->user()->employee_id === $leave->employee_id && $leave->isPending(),
        ]);
    }

    public function approveSupervisor(Request $request, LeaveRequest $leave): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->ensurePermission($request, 'leave.approve.supervisor');
        $this->ensureVisible($request, $leave);

        $request->validate(['note' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:1000']]);
        $this->leave->approveBySupervisor($leave, $request->user(), $request->input('note'));

        return back()->with('success', 'Pengajuan disetujui dan diteruskan ke HRD.');
    }

    public function approveHrd(Request $request, LeaveRequest $leave): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->ensurePermission($request, 'leave.approve.hrd');
        $this->ensureVisible($request, $leave);

        $request->validate(['note' => ['nullable', 'string', 'max:1000']]);
        $this->leave->approveByHrd($leave, $request->user(), $request->input('note'));

        return back()->with('success', 'Pengajuan disetujui dan absensi diperbarui.');
    }

    public function reject(Request $request, LeaveRequest $leave): RedirectResponse
    {
        abort_unless(
            $leave->status === 'menunggu_atasan'
                ? $request->user()->hasPermission('leave.approve.supervisor')
                : $request->user()->hasPermission('leave.approve.hrd'),
            403
        );

        $this->ensureVisible($request, $leave);

        $request->validate(['reason' => ['required', 'string', 'min:5', 'max:1000']]);
        $this->leave->reject($leave, $request->user(), $request->input('reason'));

        return back()->with('success', 'Pengajuan ditolak.');
    }

    public function cancel(Request $request, LeaveRequest $leave): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->leave->cancel($leave, $request->user());

        return back()->with('success', 'Pengajuan dibatalkan.');
    }

    public function document(Request $request, LeaveRequest $leave): StreamedResponse
    {
        $this->ensureVisible($request, $leave);
        abort_unless(
            $leave->document_path && Storage::disk('local')->exists($leave->document_path),
            404,
            'Dokumen tidak ditemukan.'
        );

        return Storage::disk('local')->download($leave->document_path);
    }

    protected function ensureVisible(Request $request, LeaveRequest $leave): void
    {
        $user = $request->user();

        if ($user->employee_id === $leave->employee_id) {
            return;
        }

        if ($user->hasPermission('leave.view.all')) {
            return;
        }

        if ($user->hasPermission('leave.view.unit')
            && Employee::query()->visibleTo($user)->whereKey($leave->employee_id)->exists()) {
            return;
        }

        abort(403, 'Anda tidak memiliki akses ke pengajuan ini.');
    }

    protected function requireEmployee(Request $request): Employee
    {
        $employee = $request->user()->employee;

        if (! $employee) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                'leave' => 'Akun Anda belum terhubung dengan data pegawai.',
            ]);
        }

        return $employee;
    }

## Objective
- Build the "Aplikasi Kepegawaian PIS" (Pesantren Imam Syafi'i HRIS) in the 8 stages defined by `Prompt_Induk_Aplikasi_Kepegawaian_PIS.md`; Stage 3 is complete and Stage 4 (attendance GPS + selfie, leave, corrections) is now underway.

## Requirements
- Follow the Indonesian master prompt: 8 sequential stages, one project/one MySQL database, no fabricated policies/features, no claimed untested completion, no hardcoded salary/tax rates.
- UI language Indonesian; currency IDR; dates DD-MM-YYYY; timezone Asia/Jakarta; DEMO data labeled.
- User confirmed Stage 2 "semua berjalan lancar" and asked "lanjut tahap 4"; then "oke lanjutkan".
- Stage 4 scope from roadmap: attendance migrations/corrections/exceptions/leave/balances; mobile GPS + camera + compression + idempotency; late/early/work-minute calculation; duplicate prevention; attendance history + photo evidence; two-level correction (supervisor → HRD); GPS/camera dispensation; schedules/shifts/holidays; recap/report; leave requests/documents/balances/approval; payroll snapshot integration; GPS/camera/duplicate/cross-day/poor-network testing; docs/employee guide.
- Must keep GPS/leave policy pending clarifications honest (K-13 location/radius, K-14 accuracy, K-15 schedules, K-16 leave rules, K-24 correction deadline, K-27 checkout/overtime, K-30 field work).

## Decisions
- Stage 4 implemented as Blade/controller (no Livewire); custom RBAC permission codes already seeded (`attendance.*`, `leave.*`).
- Attendance self-service requires an employee account; GPS accuracy must be ≤ location threshold (fallback setting 100 m); distance must be ≤ location radius; selfie photo required on check-in and check-out; photos stored privately.
- Duplicate prevention via unique `(employee_id, work_date, shift_id)` plus UUID idempotency keys; retries with same key return the existing row.
- Schedule resolution: active `schedule_assignments` first, then active `work_schedules` matching employee org unit or global fallback; holiday dates are non-workdays.
- Status semantics: check-in → `terlambat` if late else `hadir`; check-out → `pulang_awal` if early and not late; corrections recalculate; approved dispensation keeps status `dispensasi`.
- Corrections: supervisor step enforced by `employee_id === supervisor_id`; second step requires `attendance.correction.approve.hrd`; no supervisor → skip directly to HRD; applying to payroll-locked rows rejected.
- Leave: two-level approval (direct supervisor → HRD); working days exclude non-workdays/holidays; overlap blocked; balance checked against used + pending; balance incremented on approval; leave days create attendance rows (`sakit`→`sakit`, `dinas`→`dispensasi`, others→`izin`); locked rows block approval.
- Leave policies seeded tentatively (K-16/A-05): `cuti_tahunan` 12 days/year, `sakit` requires document after 1 day; all types marked paid pending confirmation.
- Demo supervisor map: pegawai→kepala, kepala→pimpinan, hrd→pimpinan, keuangan→pimpinan; all demo employees assigned "Jadwal Kantor (DEMO)" effective 2026-01-01; cuti balance 12 for 2026.
- `attendance_period_summaries` deferred to Stage 5 because `payroll_periods` does not exist yet; `attendances.payroll_period_id` column added without FK, to be constrained in Stage 5.
- PDF/number formats K-18 and Yayasan approval K-26 still unresolved from Stage 3.

## Work State
### Completed
- Stage 1 blueprint (17 doc checks) and Stage 2 verified.
- Stage 3 fully implemented and verified: recruitment, contracts/reminders, SK, mutations, letters, generic approval engine, notifications; **38 tests passed, 213 assertions**.
- Stage 3 docs updated: `docs/TEST_REPORT.md` v1.2, `docs/DEVELOPMENT_PROGRESS.md` v1.2, `docs/CHANGELOG.md` 0.3.0, `README.md`; `python scripts/check_docs.py` all 17 checks pass.
- Stage 4 migrations created (not yet run):
  - `2026_11_18_002300_create_attendance_tables.php` (`attendances`, `attendance_corrections`, `attendance_exceptions`)
  - `2026_11_18_002400_create_leave_tables.php` (`leave_types`, `leave_requests`, `leave_request_days`, `leave_balances`)
- Stage 4 models created: `Attendance`, `AttendanceCorrection`, `AttendanceException`, `LeaveType`, `LeaveRequest`, `LeaveRequestDay`, `LeaveBalance`; Employee relations added.
- Stage 4 services created: `AttendanceService` (schedule resolution, haversine, check-in/out, corrections, exceptions, photo storage), `LeaveService` (working days, overlap/balance/document checks, 2-level approval, attendance sync).
- Stage 4 controllers created: `AttendanceController`, `CorrectionController`, `ExceptionController`, `LeaveController`, `LeaveBalanceController`.
- Routes added for presensi, koreksi, dispensasi, izin/cuti, saldo cuti; master `leave-types` added to `MasterData`.
- Seeders: `LeaveTypeSeeder` created and registered in `DatabaseSeeder`; `DemoDataSeeder` seeds supervisors, schedule assignments, cuti balances.
- Views written so far: `attendance/self`, `attendance/history`, `attendance/report`, `attendance/show`, `attendance/corrections/index`, `attendance/corrections/form`.
- Stage 4 views/UI/nav, tests, migration run, docs update are still pending.

### Active
- Complete remaining Stage 4 views: `attendance/corrections/show`, `attendance/exceptions/index`, `attendance/exceptions/form`, `leave/index`, `leave/form`, `leave/show`, `leave/balances`.
- Add navigation entries for Presensi, Riwayat, Rekap, Koreksi, Dispensasi, Izin & Cuti, Jenis Izin, Saldo Cuti; add mobile quick nav.
- Run `php artisan migrate --force`, `php artisan test`, `php artisan view:cache`, and fix failures.
- Write Stage 4 tests: GPS inside/outside radius, low accuracy, missing photo, duplicate/idempotency, late/early/work minutes, cross-midnight checkout, correction 2-level + locked guard, exception approval, leave day counting/overlap/balance/approval, authorization, smoke pages.
- Update docs: `TEST_REPORT.md`, `DEVELOPMENT_PROGRESS.md`, `CHANGELOG.md` (0.4.0), `README.md`; run `python scripts/check_docs.py`.

### Blocked
- K-13/K-14 unresolved: real coordinates/radius/accuracy thresholds; DEMO location used.
- K-15/K-16/K-24/K-27/K-30 unresolved: actual shifts, paid-leave rules, correction deadline, checkout/overtime policy, field-work location policy.
- K-18 unresolved: official NIP/contract/SK/letter numbering.
- K-26 unresolved: Yayasan approval authority; Yayasan step not seeded.
- K-08 unresolved: probation length.

1. Finish the remaining Stage 4 Blade views listed above.
2. Update `layouts/_nav.blade.php` and mobile navigation.
3. Run migrations and `php artisan view:cache`; fix compile/runtime errors (note: check `LeaveController@show` loads `employee` before supervisor comparison, and verify `AttendanceService` cross-midnight logic).
4. Write `tests/Feature/AttendanceTest.php` and `tests/Feature/LeaveTest.php` (or equivalent), extend `SmokePagesTest`.

<?php

namespace Tests\Feature;

use App\Models\Attendance;
use App\Models\AttendanceCorrection;
use App\Models\Employee;
use App\Models\LeaveType;
use App\Models\ScheduleAssignment;

use Database\Seeders\DatabaseSeeder;

use Illuminate\Support\Carbon;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;
use Tests\TestCase;

class AttendanceTest extends TestCase
{
    use RefreshDatabase;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();
        $this->seed(DatabaseSeeder::class);
        Storage::fake('local');
    }

    protected function tearDown(): void
    {
        Carbon::setTestNow();

        parent::tearDown();
    }

    public function test_presensi_masuk_dalam_radius_tersimpan_dengan_foto_dan_idempotensi(): void
    {
        $user = User::where('username', 'pegawai.demo')->firstOrFail();
        $employee = $user->employee;
        $location = $employee->workLocation;

        Carbon::setTestNow(Carbon::parse('2026-03-02 06:50:00', 'Asia/Jakarta'));

        $payload = [
            'lat' => (string) $location->latitude,
            'lng' => (string) $location->longitude,
            'accuracy_m' => '15',
            'idempotency_key' => '11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111',
            'photo' => UploadedFile::fake()->image('selfie.jpg', 640, 480),
        ];

        $this->actingAs($user)->post(route('attendance.check-in'), $payload)->assertRedirect()->assertSessionHasNoErrors();

        $attendance = Attendance::query()->where('employee_id', $employee->id)->firstOrFail();
        $this->assertSame('2026-03-02', $attendance->work_date->toDateString());
        $this->assertSame('hadir', $attendance->status);
        $this->assertSame(0, $attendance->late_minutes);
        $this->assertNotNull($attendance->check_in_photo_path);
        Storage::disk('local')->assertExists($attendance->check_in_photo_path);
        $this->assertLessThanOrEqual(1, (float) $attendance->check_in_distance_m);

        // Kiriman ulang dengan kunci idempotensi yang sama tidak membuat baris baru.
        $this->actingAs($user)->post(route('attendance.check-in'), $payload)->assertRedirect();
        $this->assertSame(1, Attendance::query()->where('employee_id', $employee->id)->count());
    }

    public function test_presensi_di_luar_radius_ditolak(): void
    {
        $user = User::where('username', 'pegawai.demo')->firstOrFail();
        $employee = $user->employee;
        $location = $employee->workLocation;

        Carbon::setTestNow(Carbon::parse('2026-03-02 06:50:00', 'Asia/Jakarta'));

        $this->actingAs($user)->post(route('attendance.check-in'), [
            'lat' => (string) ((float) $location->latitude + 0.01),
            'lng' => (string) $location->longitude,
            'accuracy_m' => '10',
            'photo' => UploadedFile::fake()->image('selfie.jpg', 640, 480),
        ])->assertSessionHasErrors('attendance');

        $this->assertDatabaseMissing('attendances', ['employee_id' => $employee->id]);
    }

    public function test_akurasi_gps_di_atas_ambang_ditolak(): void
    {
        $user = User::where('username', 'pegawai.demo')->firstOrFail();
        $employee = $user->employee;
        $location = $employee->workLocation;

        Carbon::setTestNow(Carbon::parse('2026-03-02 06:50:00', 'Asia/Jakarta'));

        $this->actingAs($user)->post(route('attendance.check-in'), [
            'lat' => (string) $location->latitude,
            'lng' => (string) $location->longitude,
            'accuracy_m' => '150',
            'photo' => UploadedFile::fake()->image('selfie.jpg', 640, 480),
        ])->assertSessionHasErrors('attendance');

        $this->assertDatabaseMissing('attendances', ['employee_id' => $employee->id]);
    }

    public function test_foto_selfie_wajib_ada_saat_presensi(): void
    {
        $user = User::where('username', 'pegawai.demo')->firstOrFail();
        $location = $user->employee->workLocation;

        Carbon::setTestNow(Carbon::parse('2026-03-02 06:50:00', 'Asia/Jakarta'));

        $this->actingAs($user)->post(route('attendance.check-in'), [
            'lat' => (string) $location->latitude,
            'lng' => (string) $location->longitude,
            'accuracy_m' => '10',
        ])->assertSessionHasErrors('photo');
    }

    public function test_presensi_ganda_dengan_kunci_berbeda_ditolak(): void
    {
        $user = User::where('username', 'pegawai.demo')->firstOrFail();
        $employee = $user->employee;
        $location = $employee->workLocation;

        Carbon::setTestNow(Carbon::parse('2026-03-02 06:50:00', 'Asia/Jakarta'));

        $base = [
            'lat' => (string) $location->latitude,
            'lng' => (string) $location->longitude,
            'accuracy_m' => '10',
            'photo' => UploadedFile::fake()->image('selfie.jpg', 640, 480),
        ];

        $this->actingAs($user)->post(route('attendance.check-in'), $base + [
            'idempotency_key' => '22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222',
        ])->assertSessionHasNoErrors();

        $this->actingAs($user)->post(route('attendance.check-in'), $base + [
            'idempotency_key' => '33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333',
        ])->assertSessionHasErrors('attendance');

        $this->assertSame(1, Attendance::query()->where('employee_id', $employee->id)->count());
    }

    public function test_terlambat_pulang_awal_dan_menit_kerja_dihitung(): void
    {
        $user = User::where('username', 'pegawai.demo')->firstOrFail();
        $employee = $user->employee;
        $location = $employee->workLocation;

        Carbon::setTestNow(Carbon::parse('2026-03-02 07:20:00', 'Asia/Jakarta'));
        $this->actingAs($user)->post(route('attendance.check-in'), [
            'lat' => (string) $location->latitude,
            'lng' => (string) $location->longitude,
            'accuracy_m' => '10',
            'photo' => UploadedFile::fake()->image('masuk.jpg', 640, 480),
        ])->assertSessionHasNoErrors();

        $attendance = Attendance::query()->where('employee_id', $employee->id)->firstOrFail();
        $this->assertSame(10, $attendance->late_minutes);
        $this->assertSame('terlambat', $attendance->status);

        Carbon::setTestNow(Carbon::parse('2026-03-02 14:30:00', 'Asia/Jakarta'));
        $this->actingAs($user)->post(route('attendance.check-out'), [
            'lat' => (string) $location->latitude,
            'lng' => (string) $location->longitude,
            'accuracy_m' => '10',
            'photo' => UploadedFile::fake()->image('pulang.jpg', 640, 480),
        ])->assertSessionHasNoErrors();

        $attendance->refresh();
        $this->assertSame(20, $attendance->early_leave_minutes);
        $this->assertSame(370, $attendance->work_minutes);
        $this->assertSame('terlambat', $attendance->status);
    }

    public function test_presensi_pulang_shift_lintas_tengah_malam_memakai_baris_hari_sebelumnya(): void
    {
        $employee = $this->makeEmployee([
            'work_location_id' => WorkLocation::where('code', 'PUSAT')->value('id'),
        ]);

        $user = $this->userWithPermissions(
            ['attendance.self', 'attendance.view.self'],
            ['employee_id' => $employee->id]
        );

        $shift = WorkShift::create([
            'code' => 'MALAM-UJI',
            'name' => 'Shift Malam Uji',
            'start_time' => '22:00',
            'end_time' => '06:00',
            'is_cross_midnight' => true,
            'break_minutes' => 60,
            'late_tolerance_minutes' => 0,
            'early_leave_tolerance_minutes' => 0,
            'is_active' => true,
        ]);

        $schedule = WorkSchedule::create([
            'name' => 'Jadwal Malam Uji',
            'effective_from' => '2026-01-01',
            'is_active' => true,
        ]);

        foreach (range(1, 7) as $day) {
            $schedule->days()->create([
                'day_of_week' => $day,
                'shift_id' => $shift->id,
                'is_workday' => true,
            ]);
        }

        ScheduleAssignment::create([
            'employee_id' => $employee->id,
            'work_schedule_id' => $schedule->id,
            'effective_from' => '2026-01-01',
        ]);

        $location = $employee->workLocation;

        Carbon::setTestNow(Carbon::parse('2026-03-02 22:05:00', 'Asia/Jakarta'));
        $this->actingAs($user)->post(route('attendance.check-in'), [
            'lat' => (string) $location->latitude,
            'lng' => (string) $location->longitude,
            'accuracy_m' => '10',
            'photo' => UploadedFile::fake()->image('masuk.jpg', 640, 480),
        ])->assertSessionHasNoErrors();

        Carbon::setTestNow(Carbon::parse('2026-03-03 06:05:00', 'Asia/Jakarta'));
        $this->actingAs($user)->post(route('attendance.check-out'), [
            'lat' => (string) $location->latitude,
            'lng' => (string) $location->longitude,
            'accuracy_m' => '10',
            'photo' => UploadedFile::fake()->image('pulang.jpg', 640, 480),
        ])->assertSessionHasNoErrors();

        $attendance = Attendance::query()->where('employee_id', $employee->id)->firstOrFail();
        $this->assertSame('2026-03-02', $attendance->work_date->toDateString());
        $this->assertNotNull($attendance->check_out_at);
        $this->assertSame(420, $attendance->work_minutes);
        $this->assertSame(0, $attendance->early_leave_minutes);
    }

    public function test_koreksi_absensi_diproses_atasan_lalu_hrd_dan_mengubah_absensi(): void
    {
        $employee = User::where('username', 'pegawai.demo')->firstOrFail()->employee;
        $supervisor = User::where('username', 'kepala.demo')->firstOrFail();
        $hrd = User::where('username', 'hrd.demo')->firstOrFail();

        $service = app(\App\Services\AttendanceService::class);

        $correction = $service->submitCorrection($employee, [
            'work_date' => '2026-02-27',
            'correction_type' => 'keduanya',
            'requested_check_in_at' => '07:00',
            'requested_check_out_at' => '15:00',

        $service->approveCorrectionBySupervisor($correction, $supervisor, 'Sesuai.');
        $this->assertSame('menunggu_hrd', $correction->fresh()->status);

        $service->approveCorrectionByHrd($correction->fresh(), $hrd, 'Diverifikasi.');

        $this->assertSame('07:00', $attendance->checkInLocal()->format('H:i'));

        $this->assertTrue($attendance->is_corrected);
        $this->assertSame('hadir', $attendance->status);
    }

    public function test_koreksi_pada_absensi_terkunci_payroll_ditolak(): void

130: ## 5. Keputusan penting tahap ini
131: 
132: 1. Stack aktual: **Laravel 13.43 + PHP 8.3.36 + MySQL 8.4.9**, Blade + Tailwind 4 (Livewire belum dipakai).
133: 2. RBAC ditulis khusus (`roles`, `permissions`, `permission_role`, `role_user.org_unit_id`) agar cocok dengan desain database.
134: 3. Kolom sensitif (`nik`, `account_number`, `npwp`, `bpjs_*`) memakai cast `encrypted`; NIK punya `nik_hash` SHA-256 untuk keunikan.
135: 4. Berkas privat disimpan di `storage/app/private`, bukan `public`.
136: 5. Audit menyamarkan nilai sensitif menjadi `[disembunyikan]` dan tidak memiliki rute hapus.
137: 6. Administrator **tidak** otomatis mendapat akses payroll/data pribadi; sesuai matriks dipakai akun HRD/Keuangan.
138: 7. Tarif gaji/pajak tetap tidak diisi sampai klarifikasi K-01..K-04 dan K-09.
139: 8. Persetujuan memakai mesin generik 4 tabel (`approval_flows`, `approval_flow_steps`, `approval_instances`, `approval_actions`) dengan aturan pengaju tidak boleh menyetujui pengajuannya sendiri.
140: 9. Status kontrak mengikuti desain database: pengajuan yang menunggu tetap `draf`; penolakan menjadi `dibatalkan`; kontrak lama baru `diperpanjang` setelah kontrak baru disetujui.
141: 10. Mutasi yang diterapkan menutup penempatan aktif dengan `effective_to = effective_date - 1` lalu membuat baris `employee_assignments` baru.
142: 11. Konversi pelamar hanya dari status `diterima`, sekali per pelamar, dan identitas pelamar dipakai ulang tanpa input ulang.

**Finalizing implementation**

Okay, I’m wrapping up Stage 4 of the implementation. I’m just making sure everything is in place and working as expected. I’ll double-check the details to ensure there are no loose ends. Once I confirm everything’s good, I’ll be ready to move on to the next stage. It’s always a bit nerve-wracking at this point, but I think I’ve got it covered. Let’s make sure everything’s smooth before moving forward!

## Yang dikerjakan
- Tahap 4 diimplementasi: presensi GPS radius + selfie, koreksi 2 tingkat (atasan→HRD), dispensasi, izin/cuti, saldo cuti, rekap absensi, nav mobile.
- Tambah migration/model/service/controller/view/route/seeder Tahap 4:
  - `database/migrations/2026_11_18_002300_create_attendance_tables.php`, `2026_11_18_002400_create_leave_tables.php`
  - `app/Models/{Attendance,AttendanceCorrection,AttendanceException,LeaveType,LeaveRequest,LeaveRequestDay,LeaveBalance}.php`
  - `app/Services/AttendanceService.php`, `app/Services/LeaveService.php`
  - `app/Http/Controllers/{AttendanceController,CorrectionController,ExceptionController,LeaveController,LeaveBalanceController}.php`
  - view `resources/views/attendance/**`, `resources/views/leave/**`
  - routes presensi/koreksi/dispensasi/izin-cuti/saldo-cuti di `routes/web.php`
  - `LeaveTypeSeeder`, update `DatabaseSeeder`, `DemoDataSeeder` (supervisor, assignment jadwal, saldo cuti 2026)
- Fix kecil: `LeaveController@show` load relasi sebelum cek visibilitas/approval; `LeaveTest` penolakan HRD disesuaikan alur nyata (atasan dulu, lalu HRD).

## Verifikasi
- `php artisan migrate --force` OK (2 migration Tahap 4).
- `php artisan db:seed --force` OK.
- `php artisan view:cache` OK.
- `php artisan route:list` OK (route attendance/corrections/exceptions/leave/balances/master leave-types terdaftar).
- `php artisan test --filter=AttendanceTest` **PASS** 12 tests, 56 assertions.
- `php artisan test --filter=LeaveTest` **PASS** 10 tests, 23 assertions.

- `php artisan test` full **PASS** **61 tests, 311 assertions**.
- `python scripts/check_docs.py` **17/17 LULUS**.

## Dokumen diperbarui
- `docs/TEST_REPORT.md` → v1.3, tambah §18–22 Tahap 4, total 61/311.
- `docs/DEVELOPMENT_PROGRESS.md` → v1.3, status Tahap 4 selesai, deliverable 4A, risiko/next Tahap 5.
- `docs/CHANGELOG.md` → tambah `0.4.0` Tahap 4.
- `README.md` → status Tahap 4, modul absensi/cuti, 61 lulus.

- `attendance_period_summaries` sengaja belum dibuat (dependency `payroll_periods` Tahap 5); `attendances.payroll_period_id` belum FK.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build "Aplikasi Kepegawaian PIS" (HRIS) following an 8-stage roadmap; Stage 4 (Attendance & Leave) is complete.

## Requirements
- Indonesian UI, IDR currency, DD-MM-YYYY dates, Asia/Jakarta timezone.
- 8 sequential stages, MySQL DB, no fabricated policies, private storage for sensitive data.
- Attendance: GPS radius + selfie photo required, idempotency keys for duplicate prevention.
- Leave/Correction: 2-level approval (Direct Supervisor -> HRD).

## Decisions
- Stage 4 implemented using Blade/Controllers (no Livewire).
- `attendance_period_summaries` deferred to Stage 5 due to `payroll_periods` dependency.

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Concerns;

use App\Models\Employee;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;

trait GuardsHrAccess
{
    protected function ensurePermission(Request $request, string $permission): void
    {
        abort_unless(
            $request->user()->hasPermission($permission),
            403,
            'Anda tidak memiliki hak akses untuk tindakan ini.'
        );
    }

    /**
     * Batasi data berdasarkan cakupan pegawai pengguna.
     */
    protected function scopeEmployeeRecords(Builder $query, User $user, string $column = 'employee_id'): Builder
    {
        if ($user->hasPermission('employee.view.all')) {
            return $query;
        }

        if ($user->hasPermission('employee.view.unit')) {
            return $query->whereIn($column, Employee::query()->visibleTo($user)->select('id'));
        }

        return $query->where($column, $user->employee_id ?? 0);
    }

    protected function ensureRecordVisible(Request $request, int $employeeId): void
    {
        $visible = Employee::query()
            ->visibleTo($request->user())
            ->whereKey($employeeId)
            ->exists();

        abort_unless($visible, 403, 'Anda tidak memiliki akses ke data pegawai ini.');
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Services;

use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Auth;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

class AuditLogger
{
    /**
     * Nilai yang tidak boleh tersimpan mentah di audit log.
     *
     * @var array<int, string>
     */
    protected array $sensitiveKeys = [
        'password',
        'remember_token',
        'nik',
        'nik_hash',
        'account_number',
        'npwp',
        'bpjs_kesehatan_no',
        'bpjs_tk_no',
    ];

    public function record(string $event, Model $model, ?array $old = null, ?array $new = null): void
    {
        $this->write(
            $event,
            $model->getMorphClass(),
            $model->getKey(),
            $old,
            $new
        );
    }

    public function recordRaw(
        string $event,
        string $auditableType,
        ?int $auditableId = null,
        ?array $old = null,
        ?array $new = null
    ): void {
        $this->write($event, $auditableType, $auditableId, $old, $new);
    }

    protected function write(string $event, string $type, ?int $id, ?array $old, ?array $new): void
    {
        $request = request();

        DB::table('audit_logs')->insert([
            'user_id' => Auth::id(),
            'event' => $event,
            'auditable_type' => $type,
            'auditable_id' => $id,
            'old_values' => $old === null ? null : json_encode($this->sanitize($old), JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE),
            'new_values' => $new === null ? null : json_encode($this->sanitize($new), JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE),
            'ip_address' => $request?->ip(),
            'user_agent' => $request ? substr((string) $request->userAgent(), 0, 255) : null,
            'created_at' => now(),
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    protected function sanitize(array $values): array
    {
        $clean = [];

        foreach ($values as $key => $value) {
            if (in_array($key, $this->sensitiveKeys, true)) {
                $clean[$key] = $value === null ? null : '[disembunyikan]';
                continue;
            }

            if (is_array($value)) {
                $clean[$key] = $this->sanitize($value);
                continue;
            }

            $clean[$key] = $value;
        }

        return $clean;
    }
}

use App\Models\Employee;
use App\Models\PayrollPeriod;
use App\Models\PayrollRun;
use App\Models\PayrollRunEmployee;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;

class PayrollService
{
    public function __construct(private readonly AuditLogger $audit) {}

    public function snapshot(PayrollPeriod $period, User $user): int
    {
        if ($period->isLocked()) throw ValidationException::withMessages(['period' => 'Periode payroll sudah dikunci.']);

        return DB::transaction(function () use ($period, $user) {
            $employees = Employee::query()->where('is_active', true)->get(['id']);
            foreach ($employees as $employee) {
                $rows = Attendance::query()->where('employee_id', $employee->id)->whereBetween('work_date', [$period->start_date, $period->end_date])->get();
                $counts = $rows->countBy('status');
                AttendancePeriodSummary::query()->updateOrCreate(
                    ['payroll_period_id' => $period->id, 'employee_id' => $employee->id],
                    [
                        'work_days' => $rows->count(), 'present_days' => ($counts['hadir'] ?? 0) + ($counts['terlambat'] ?? 0) + ($counts['pulang_awal'] ?? 0),
                        'late_days' => $rows->where('late_minutes', '>', 0)->count(), 'total_late_minutes' => $rows->sum('late_minutes'),
                        'early_leave_days' => $rows->where('early_leave_minutes', '>', 0)->count(), 'total_early_minutes' => $rows->sum('early_leave_minutes'),
                        'absent_days' => $counts['tidak_hadir'] ?? 0, 'paid_leave_days' => ($counts['izin'] ?? 0) + ($counts['sakit'] ?? 0),
                        'unpaid_leave_days' => 0, 'holiday_days' => $counts['libur'] ?? 0, 'special_days' => $counts['dispensasi'] ?? 0,
                        'is_locked' => false, 'generated_at' => now(), 'generated_by' => $user->id,
                    ]
                );
            }
            $period->update(['status' => 'dihitung']);
            $this->audit->recordRaw('payroll.snapshot.generated', PayrollPeriod::class, $period->id, null, ['employee_count' => $employees->count()]);
            return $employees->count();
        });
    }

    public function calculateSkeleton(PayrollPeriod $period, User $user): PayrollRun
    {
        if ($period->isLocked()) throw ValidationException::withMessages(['period' => 'Periode payroll sudah dikunci.']);
        if (! AttendancePeriodSummary::query()->where('payroll_period_id', $period->id)->exists()) throw ValidationException::withMessages(['period' => 'Buat snapshot absensi sebelum menghitung payroll.']);

        return DB::transaction(function () use ($period, $user) {
            $version = ((int) PayrollRun::query()->where('payroll_period_id', $period->id)->max('version')) + 1;
            $run = PayrollRun::query()->create(['payroll_period_id' => $period->id, 'version' => $version, 'status' => 'draf', 'calculated_by' => $user->id, 'calculated_at' => now()]);
            $summaries = AttendancePeriodSummary::query()->where('payroll_period_id', $period->id)->get();
            foreach ($summaries as $summary) PayrollRunEmployee::query()->create(['payroll_run_id' => $run->id, 'employee_id' => $summary->employee_id, 'attendance_summary_id' => $summary->id, 'status' => 'dihitung']);
            $run->update(['employee_count' => $summaries->count()]);
            $period->update(['status' => 'dihitung']);
            $this->audit->recordRaw('payroll.run.calculated_skeleton', PayrollRun::class, $run->id, null, ['version' => $version, 'employee_count' => $summaries->count()]);
            return $run;
        });
    }

    public function lock(PayrollPeriod $period, User $user): void
    {
        if ($period->isLocked()) throw ValidationException::withMessages(['period' => 'Periode sudah dikunci.']);
        $period->summaries()->update(['is_locked' => true]);
        Attendance::query()->whereBetween('work_date', [$period->start_date, $period->end_date])->update(['is_locked' => true, 'payroll_period_id' => $period->id]);
        $period->update(['status' => 'dikunci', 'locked_at' => now(), 'locked_by' => $user->id]);
        $this->audit->recordRaw('payroll.period.locked', PayrollPeriod::class, $period->id);
    }
}

    public function calculate(Request $r, PayrollPeriod $period): RedirectResponse { $this->access($r, 'payroll.calculate'); $this->payroll->calculateSkeleton($period, $r->user()); return back()->with('success', 'Kerangka run payroll dibuat. Tarif belum dihitung karena kebijakan belum dikonfigurasi.'); }

    public function export(Request $r, PayrollPeriod $period): RedirectResponse { $this->access($r, 'payroll.report'); return back()->with('warning', 'Ekspor payroll belum aktif.'); }
}

class RolePermissionSeeder extends Seeder
{
    public function run(): void
    {
        $data = require database_path('seeders/data/permissions.php');

        $roles = [
            'administrator' => ['Administrator', 'Mengelola sistem, pengguna, dan peran; akses payroll dibatasi sesuai matriks.'],
            'pimpinan' => ['Pimpinan', 'Melihat seluruh data dan melakukan persetujuan akhir.'],
            'kepala_bagian' => ['Kepala Bidang/Bagian', 'Mengelola dan melihat data unit kerja beserta turunannya.'],
            'hrd' => ['HRD', 'Mengelola data pegawai, administrasi, dan verifikasi.'],
            'keuangan' => ['Keuangan', 'Mengelola payroll, BPJS, pajak, dan laporan keuangan.'],
            'pegawai' => ['Pegawai', 'Mengakses data dan dokumen milik sendiri.'],
        ];

        foreach ($roles as $code => [$name, $description]) {
            Role::updateOrCreate(
                ['code' => $code],
                ['name' => $name, 'description' => $description, 'is_system' => true]
            );
        }

        foreach ($data['permissions'] as $permission) {
            Permission::updateOrCreate(
                ['code' => $permission['code']],
                ['name' => $permission['name'], 'module' => $permission['module']]
            );
        }

        $permissionIds = Permission::query()->pluck('id', 'code');

        foreach ($data['roles'] as $roleCode => $codes) {
            $role = Role::where('code', $roleCode)->first();
            if (! $role) {
                continue;
            }

            $ids = collect($codes)
                ->map(fn (string $code) => $permissionIds[$code] ?? null)
                ->filter()
                ->values()
                ->all();

            $role->permissions()->sync($ids);
        }
    }
}

                    ['role' => 'kepala_bagian', 'scope' => 'unit'],
                    ['role' => 'pimpinan', 'scope' => 'all'],

            [
                'code' => 'letter',

                'subject_type' => 'App\\Models\\EmployeeLetter',

                    ['role' => 'pimpinan', 'scope' => 'all'],
                ],
            ],
        ];

        foreach ($flows as $definition) {
            $flow = ApprovalFlow::updateOrCreate(
                ['code' => $definition['code']],
                [
                    'name' => $definition['name'],
                    'subject_type' => $definition['subject_type'],
                    'is_active' => true,

            );

            $flow->steps()->delete();

            foreach ($definition['steps'] as $index => $step) {

                    'sequence' => $index + 1,
                    'role_id' => $roles[$step['role']],
                    'scope' => $step['scope'],
                    'is_optional' => false,
                ]);
            }
        }
    }
}

class PayrollPeriod extends Model implements Approvable
{
    use HasFactory;

    protected $fillable = ['code', 'start_date', 'end_date', 'payment_date', 'status', 'locked_at', 'locked_by', 'notes'];

    protected function casts(): array
    {
        return ['start_date' => 'date', 'end_date' => 'date', 'payment_date' => 'date', 'locked_at' => 'datetime'];
    }

    public function summaries(): HasMany { return $this->hasMany(AttendancePeriodSummary::class); }
    public function runs(): HasMany { return $this->hasMany(PayrollRun::class); }
    public function lockedBy(): BelongsTo { return $this->belongsTo(User::class, 'locked_by'); }
    public function isLocked(): bool { return $this->status === 'dikunci'; }

    public function approvalFlowCode(): string { return 'payroll'; }
    public function approvalLabel(): string { return 'Periode payroll '.$this->code; }
    public function approvalOrgUnitId(): ?int { return null; }
    public function markApprovalPending(): void { $this->update(['status' => 'verifikasi_hrd']); }
    public function markApprovalApproved(User $actor): void { $this->update(['status' => 'disetujui']); }

}

<?php

namespace Tests\Feature;

use App\Models\ApprovalInstance;
use App\Models\PayrollPeriod;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Tests\TestCase;

class PayrollApprovalTest extends TestCase
{
    use RefreshDatabase;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();
        $this->seed();
    }

    private function user(string $username): User { return User::where('username', $username)->firstOrFail(); }

    public function test_approval_flow_has_payroll_steps(): void
    {
        $flow = \App\Models\ApprovalFlow::where('code', 'payroll')->firstOrFail();
        $roles = $flow->steps->pluck('role.code')->all();
        $this->assertSame(['hrd', 'keuangan', 'pimpinan'], $roles);
    }

    public function test_hrd_submits_payroll_for_approval_and_flow_completes(): void
    {
        $period = PayrollPeriod::create([
            'code' => '2026-11',
            'start_date' => '2026-11-01',
            'end_date' => '2026-11-30',
            'status' => 'dihitung',
        ]);

        $hrd = $this->user('hrd.demo');
        $this->actingAs($hrd)->post(route('payroll.submit', $period))->assertRedirect();

        $instance = ApprovalInstance::query()->where('subject_type', $period->getMorphClass())->where('subject_id', $period->id)->firstOrFail();
        $this->assertSame('menunggu', $instance->status);
        $this->assertSame('verifikasi_hrd', $period->fresh()->status);

        $this->actingAs($this->user('keuangan.demo'))->post(route('approvals.approve', $instance))->assertRedirect();
        $this->assertSame(2, $instance->fresh()->current_step);

        $this->actingAs($this->user('pimpinan.demo'))->post(route('approvals.approve', $instance))->assertRedirect();
        $this->assertSame('disetujui', $instance->fresh()->status);
        $this->assertSame('disetujui', $period->fresh()->status);
    }

    public function test_payroll_lock_blocked_without_approval(): void
    {
        $period = PayrollPeriod::create([
            'code' => '2026-11',
            'start_date' => '2026-11-01',
            'end_date' => '2026-11-30',
            'status' => 'dihitung',
        ]);

        $response = $this->actingAs($this->user('keuangan.demo'))->post(route('payroll.lock', $period));
        $response->assertSessionHasErrors('period');
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Services;

use App\Models\DocumentTemplate;
use Barryvdh\DomPDF\Facade\Pdf;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;

class DocumentPdfService
{
    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $variables
     */
    public function render(string $templateCode, array $variables): string
    {
        $template = DocumentTemplate::query()
            ->where('code', $templateCode)
            ->where('is_active', true)
            ->first();

        if (! $template) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                'template' => "Template dokumen '{$templateCode}' belum tersedia atau tidak aktif.",
            ]);
        }

        $replacements = [];
        foreach ($variables as $key => $value) {
            $replacements['{'.$key.'}'] = nl2br(e((string) ($value ?? '�?"')));
        }

        $html = strtr($template->body, $replacements);

        return (string) preg_replace('/\{[a-z0-9_]+\}/i', '�?"', $html);
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $variables
     */
    public function generate(string $templateCode, array $variables, string $folder, string $filename): string
    {
        $html = $this->render($templateCode, $variables);
        $output = Pdf::loadHTML($html)->setPaper('a4')->output();

        $path = 'documents/'.trim($folder, '/').'/'.Str::slug($filename).'.pdf';
        Storage::disk('local')->put($path, $output);

        return $path;
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Services;

use App\Models\PayrollPeriod;
use App\Models\PayrollRun;
use App\Models\PayrollRunEmployee;
use Barryvdh\DomPDF\Facade\Pdf;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;

class PayrollPdfService
{
    public function generateBatch(PayrollPeriod $period, PayrollRun $run): string
    {
        $run->load(['employees.employee.orgUnit', 'employees.employee.position', 'employees.details.component', 'period']);
        $html = view('payroll.pdf.batch', ['period' => $period, 'run' => $run, 'rows' => $run->employees])->render();
        $output = Pdf::loadHTML($html)->setPaper('a4')->output();
        $path = 'payslips/'.$period->code.'/slip-gaji-'.$period->code.'-v'.$run->version.'.pdf';
        Storage::disk('local')->put($path, $output);
        return $path;
    }

    public function generateOne(PayrollRunEmployee $row): string
    {
        $row->loadMissing(['employee.orgUnit', 'employee.position', 'details.component', 'run.period']);
        $period = $row->run->period;
        $html = view('payroll.pdf.slip', ['period' => $period, 'run' => $row->run, 'row' => $row])->render();
        $output = Pdf::loadHTML($html)->setPaper('a4')->output();
        $name = Str::slug(($row->employee->nip ?? 'pegawai').'-'.$period->code);
        $path = 'payslips/'.$period->code.'/'.$name.'.pdf';
        Storage::disk('local')->put($path, $output);
        return $path;
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Services;

use App\Models\PayrollPeriod;
use App\Models\PayrollRun;
use App\Models\Payslip;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;

class PayslipGenerationService
{
    public function __construct(private readonly PayrollPdfService $pdf, private readonly AuditLogger $audit) {}

    public function generate(PayrollPeriod $period): int
    {
        if (! $period->isLocked()) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['period' => 'Slip resmi hanya dapat diterbitkan setelah periode payroll disetujui dan dikunci.']);
        }

        $run = $period->runs()->where('status', 'final')->latest('version')->firstOrFail();

        return DB::transaction(function () use ($period, $run) {
            $generated = 0;
            foreach ($run->employees()->with('employee:id,nip,full_name')->get() as $row) {
                if (empty($row->employee->nip)) continue;
                $path = $this->pdf->generateOne($row);
                Payslip::query()->updateOrCreate(
                    ['payroll_period_id' => $period->id, 'employee_id' => $row->employee_id],
                    [
                        'payroll_run_id' => $run->id,
                        'gross' => $row->gross,
                        'total_deduction' => $row->total_deduction,
                        'net' => $row->net,
                        'file_path' => $path,
                        'generated_at' => now(),
                    ]
                );
                $generated++;
            }
            $this->audit->recordRaw('payslip.generated', Payslip::class, null, null, ['period_id' => $period->id, 'count' => $generated]);
            return $generated;
        });
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use App\Http\Controllers\Concerns\GuardsHrAccess;
use App\Models\PayrollPeriod;
use App\Models\Payslip;
use App\Services\PayrollPdfService;
use App\Services\PayslipGenerationService;
use Illuminate\Http\RedirectResponse;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;
use Illuminate\View\View;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\StreamedResponse;

class PayslipController extends Controller
{
    use GuardsHrAccess;

    public function __construct(private readonly PayrollPdfService $pdf, private readonly PayslipGenerationService $generation) {}

    public function index(Request $request): View
    {
        $this->ensurePermission($request, 'payroll.view.self');
        return view('payslips.index', [
            'payslips' => Payslip::query()->with('period')->where('employee_id', $request->user()->employee_id ?? 0)->latest()->paginate(15),
        ]);
    }

    public function download(Request $request, Payslip $payslip): StreamedResponse
    {
        $this->ensurePermission($request, 'payslip.download.self');
        abort_unless($payslip->employee_id === $request->user()->employee_id, 403);
        abort_unless($payslip->file_path && Storage::disk('local')->exists($payslip->file_path), 404, 'Berkas slip tidak ditemukan.');
        return Storage::disk('local')->download($payslip->file_path, 'slip-gaji-'.$payslip->period->code.'.pdf');
    }

    public function batchPdf(Request $request, PayrollPeriod $period): StreamedResponse
    {
        $this->ensurePermission($request, 'payroll.report');
        $run = $period->runs()->where('status', 'final')->latest('version')->first();
        if (! $run) throw ValidationException::withMessages(['period' => 'Run payroll final belum tersedia.']);
        $path = $this->pdf->generateBatch($period, $run);
        return Storage::disk('local')->download($path, 'slip-gaji-'.$period->code.'.pdf');
    }

    public function generate(Request $request, PayrollPeriod $period): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->ensurePermission($request, 'payroll.lock');
        $count = $this->generation->generate($period);
        return back()->with('success', $count.' slip gaji PDF berhasil dibuat.');
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use App\Http\Controllers\Concerns\GuardsHrAccess;
use App\Models\Employee;
use App\Models\PayrollAdjustment;
use App\Models\PayrollPeriod;
use App\Models\PayrollComponent;
use Illuminate\Http\RedirectResponse;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\View\View;

class PayrollAdjustmentController extends Controller
{
    use GuardsHrAccess;

    public function index(Request $request): View
    {
        $this->ensurePermission($request, 'payroll.adjustment.manage');
        
        $query = PayrollAdjustment::query()
            ->with(['employee:id,nip,full_name', 'period', 'component'])
            ->latest();

        if ($periodId = $request->input('payroll_period_id')) {
            $query->where('payroll_period_id', $periodId);
        }

        return view('payroll.adjustments.index', [
            'adjustments' => $query->paginate(15),
            'periods' => PayrollPeriod::latest('start_date')->get(['id', 'code']),
        ]);
    }

    public function create(Request $request): View
    {
        $this->ensurePermission($request, 'payroll.adjustment.manage');
        
        return view('payroll.adjustments.form', [
            'adjustment' => new PayrollAdjustment(),
            'periods' => PayrollPeriod::where('status', '!=', 'dikunci')->latest('start_date')->get(),
            'employees' => Employee::active()->get(['id', 'nip', 'full_name']),
            'components' => PayrollComponent::where('is_active', true)->get(['id', 'name', 'type']),
        ]);
    }

    public function store(Request $request): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->ensurePermission($request, 'payroll.adjustment.manage');
        
        $data = $request->validate([
            'payroll_period_id' => 'required|exists:payroll_periods,id',
            'employee_id' => 'required|exists:employees,id',
            'component_id' => 'nullable|exists:payroll_components,id',
            'type' => 'required|in:penghasilan,potongan',
            'amount' => 'required|numeric|min:0.01',
            'reason' => 'required|string|max:500',
        ]);

        PayrollAdjustment::create($data + [
            'status' => 'menunggu',
            'requested_by' => $request->user()->id,
        ]);

        return redirect()->route('payroll.adjustments.index')->with('success', 'Penyesuaian payroll berhasil diajukan.');
    }

    public function approve(Request $request, PayrollAdjustment $adjustment): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->ensurePermission($request, 'payroll.lock'); // Only high level can approve adjustment
        
        $adjustment->update([
            'status' => 'disetujui',
            'approved_by' => $request->user()->id,
        ]);

        return back()->with('success', 'Penyesuaian disetujui.');
    }

    public function destroy(Request $request, PayrollAdjustment $adjustment): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->ensurePermission($request, 'payroll.adjustment.manage');
        abort_unless($adjustment->status === 'menunggu', 403, 'Hanya penyesuaian yang menunggu yang dapat dihapus.');
        
        $adjustment->delete();
        return back()->with('success', 'Penyesuaian dihapus.');
    }
}

<?php

namespace Tests\Feature;

use App\Models\AttendancePeriodSummary;
use App\Models\Employee;
use App\Models\PayrollAdjustment;
use App\Models\PayrollComponent;
use App\Models\PayrollPeriod;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Tests\TestCase;

class PayrollAdjustmentTest extends TestCase
{
    use RefreshDatabase;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();
        $this->seed();
    }

    public function test_approved_adjustment_becomes_auditable_payroll_detail_in_new_run(): void
    {
        $finance = User::where('username', 'keuangan.demo')->firstOrFail();
        $employee = Employee::query()->where('is_active', true)->firstOrFail();
        $period = PayrollPeriod::create(['code' => '2026-11', 'start_date' => '2026-11-01', 'end_date' => '2026-11-30', 'status' => 'draft']);
        AttendancePeriodSummary::create(['payroll_period_id' => $period->id, 'employee_id' => $employee->id, 'work_days' => 0, 'present_days' => 0, 'late_days' => 0, 'total_late_minutes' => 0, 'early_leave_days' => 0, 'total_early_minutes' => 0, 'absent_days' => 0, 'paid_leave_days' => 0, 'unpaid_leave_days' => 0, 'holiday_days' => 0, 'special_days' => 0, 'generated_at' => now()]);
        $component = PayrollComponent::where('code', 'tunjangan_jabatan')->firstOrFail();
        $adjustment = PayrollAdjustment::create(['payroll_period_id' => $period->id, 'employee_id' => $employee->id, 'component_id' => $component->id, 'type' => 'penghasilan', 'amount' => 125000, 'reason' => 'Penyesuaian jabatan disetujui', 'status' => 'disetujui', 'requested_by' => $finance->id, 'approved_by' => $finance->id]);

        $this->actingAs($finance)->post(route('payroll.calculate', $period))->assertRedirect();

        $this->assertDatabaseHas('payroll_details', ['component_id' => $component->id, 'source_type' => 'manual_adjustment', 'source_id' => $adjustment->id, 'amount' => 125000]);
        $this->assertDatabaseHas('payroll_run_employees', ['employee_id' => $employee->id, 'gross' => 125000, 'net' => 125000]);
        $this->assertDatabaseHas('payroll_adjustments', ['id' => $adjustment->id, 'applied_run_id' => 1]);
    }
}

# PROMPT: Aplikasi Penggajian Pegawai Pesantren

> Gunakan dokumen ini sebagai brief lengkap untuk membangun atau melanjutkan aplikasi penggajian (versi Excel yang sudah berjalan, atau versi web yang menyusul). Bahasa antarmuka, label, dan keluaran: **Bahasa Indonesia**.

---

## 1. Peran dan tujuan

Anda adalah pengembang aplikasi penggajian untuk **seksi HRD, Yayasan Lajnah Khairiyah Musytarakah**, mewakili **Pesantren Imam Syafi'i** (Aceh Besar). Aplikasi menghitung gaji bulanan pegawai dan guru, mencetak slip gaji, membuat daftar transfer, laporan BPJS dan pajak, serta merekap perkembangan setahun.

Tahap saat ini: **Excel (.xlsm) dengan makro VBA sudah berjalan** dan dipakai dengan data nyata. Aplikasi web menyusul setelah versi Excel stabil. Semua hasil harus dapat diperiksa pengguna non-teknis.

Prinsip kerja:
- Rumus hidup di sheet, bukan angka mati. Semua tarif ada di sheet Parameter/Tabel, bukan di dalam rumus.
- Semua hasil perhitungan **dibulatkan ke atas**.
- Slip hanya menampilkan komponen yang bernominal (baris kosong disembunyikan).
- Jangan menimpa data pengguna. Setiap perubahan struktur harus aman terhadap file kerja yang sudah berisi data.
- Jujur soal yang belum teruji: makro VBA belum pernah diuji di Excel oleh pembuatnya, hanya di LibreOffice dan simulasi.

---

## 2. Aturan bisnis (final)

### 2.1 Status dan gaji pokok
- Status pegawai: **tetap (GTY/STY)**, **harian**, **khidmah**, **khidmah khusus**, **masa percobaan**; ada juga **GTT** dan **guru ekskul** (slip dan periode terpisah).
- Gaji pokok pegawai **baru** menurut pendidikan: SMP 500.000, SMA 700.000, D3 900.000, S1 1.100.000 (S2 belum ada tarif; wajib punya gaji pokok terakhir).
- **Naik pendidikan** (mis. D3 ke S1): naik 15% dari gaji pokok terakhir.
- **Kenaikan berkala 5% per tahun** untuk pegawai tetap, dihitung dari gaji pokok terakhir (berkelanjutan), pertama kali setelah genap satu tahun. Hasil kenaikan 5% dibiarkan apa adanya (tidak dibulatkan).
- **Pegawai yang sudah berjalan**: gaji pokok memakai kolom **Gaji Pokok Terakhir** + **Tanggal Berlaku** di data pegawai. Kolom ini harus berupa **angka tetap** (bukan rumus tautan ke file lain); acuan pendidikan hanya untuk pegawai baru.
- **Harian**: Rp51.000 per hari kalender x 30, dipotong bila tidak hadir. Hanya dapat beras (bila menikah), transportasi, THR (nominal disesuaikan).
- **Khidmah**: tanpa gaji pokok; honorarium 700.000 (setara gaji pokok SMA). Khidmah khusus dihitung seperti pegawai tetap tetapi komponen tunjangan/honor dibuat bisa dipilih.
- **Masa percobaan**: gaji pokok menurut pendidikan; tunjangan keluarga dan beras bisa dipilih; kehadiran ya; transport, jabatan, istimewa tidak; honor bisa dipilih.

### 2.2 Tunjangan
- Suami/istri 200.000; anak 100.000 per anak (tanpa batas jumlah anak).
- **Beras** per anggota keluarga (pegawai sendiri ikut dihitung): nominal di Parameter (saat ini **70.000**). Lajang tidak dapat; istri tidak dapat bila suami-istri sama-sama bekerja di pesantren.
- **Transportasi** bila jarak lebih dari 1 km: 1�?"5 km Rp5.000, 5�?"10 km Rp10.000, dst. naik sampai maksimum Rp20.000 **per hari**; jumlah hari diinput manual.
- **Kehadiran**: 18.000 per hari x 30 hari = **540.000** (pegawai di **MSU/SD**: 270.000). 8 jam = 480 menit per hari. Potongan terlambat/alpha diinput **dalam menit**, dipotong per menit dengan pembagi 14.400 (menit sebulan). GTY maksimal 360 jam (1.500/jam, 1 jam = 40 menit x 12 jam/hari); STY maksimal 240 jam (2.250/jam, 1 jam = 60 menit x 8 jam/hari); potongan telat/alpha sama.
- **Jabatan utama** + **jabatan tambahan 1�?"3** + **tunjangan istimewa** (semua masuk dasar BPJS TK).
- Daftar jabatan dan tarifnya disimpan di sheet Jabatan.

### 2.3 Honorarium (fleksibel)
- Jenis honor di **Honor_Master** (nama, tarif, satuan). Jenis tanpa tarif = input nominal rupiah (mis. THR, bonus, meugang); jenis bertarif = input jumlah.
- Contoh: halaqah tahfidz, kelebihan JP, menggantikan jam mengajar, lembur (nominal per orang), insentif pengajian, THR, bonus prestasi, meugang.
- **Kelebihan JP dihitung per minggu penuh (Senin�?"Sabtu)**; periode kelebihan JP dihitung **otomatis** dari tanggal akhir periode (tanpa input manual tiap bulan).
- Input honor lewat **Honor_Matriks** (satu baris per pegawai, kolom per jenis honor, maksimal 12 kolom: C�?"N) dan **Input_Honor** (daftar honor khusus per kejadian). Keduanya digabung di sheet tersembunyi **Honor_Gabung**.

### 2.4 Snack
- Rp2.500 per hari, input hari manual. Tampil di slip dan ikut total penghasilan, tetapi **dilaporkan terpisah** (daftar transfer snack sendiri; tidak masuk total transfer gaji). Pilihan per pegawai: transfer atau tunai.

### 2.5 BPJS
- **BPJS Ketenagakerjaan**: tetap dan harian ikut 3 program (JKK 0,24%, JKM 0,30%, JHT 3,7% pesantren + 2% pegawai); khidmah hanya JKK + JKM; percobaan tidak ikut; JP tersedia sebagai kolom. Pegawai di bawah UMR untuk 2 program memakai **UMR Aceh Besar 3.932.552** sebagai dasar.
- Dasar BPJS TK 3 program = gaji pokok + tunj. suami/istri + anak + beras + jabatan + istimewa + kehadiran **penuh** (nominal penuh, bukan yang sudah dipotong). Harian: 51.000 x 30.
- **BPJS Kesehatan**: 4% pesantren + 1% pegawai, acuan tetap **4.200.000**; ikut atau tidak dipilih per pegawai; mencakup pegawai, pasangan, maksimal 3 anak; **anak ke-4 dan seterusnya** tambahan iuran 1% (42.000) per anak, ditanggung pegawai.
- GTT dan ekskul tidak ikut BPJS (tunjangan jabatan dan potongan tetap bisa ada).
- Laporan BPJS TK format: NIK, nomor KPJ, nama, tgl lahir, data upah, JKK, JKM, JHT (2% pekerja, 3,7% pemberi kerja), JP, total iuran.

### 2.6 PPh 21
- Memakai **tarif efektif rata-rata (TER)** menurut PTKP/kategori (A/B/C). Tabel TER ada di sheet Tabel_TER dan **harus dicocokkan dengan PMK 168/2023** (tabel diambil dari sumber web).
- Opsi per pegawai: **pajak ditanggung pesantren** atau dipotong dari pegawai. Ada laporan pajak terpisah, dan pilihan tampil atau tidak di slip (parameter TampilPajakSlip).

### 2.7 GTT dan ekskul
- Digaji **1 bulan penuh** (tanggal 1 sampai akhir bulan), slip khusus (Slip_GTT).
- GTT: kehadiran 20.000/hari, JP SMP 12.000, JP MA 14.000; dapat snack seperti pegawai tetap; input manual (Absen_GTT: total hadir, total JP SMP, total JP MA).
- Ekskul dibayar per pertemuan (menjahit 100.000, memanah 150.000, pramuka/fahmil/taekwondo/debat Arab 100.000), tanpa snack.
- GTT dan ekskul hanya dapat itu saja kecuali THR dan meugang setahun sekali.

### 2.8 Periode
- Pegawai: absensi tanggal **21 s.d. 20 bulan berikutnya** (mis. 21 Okt �?" 20 Nov 2026 = gaji bulan November).
- GTT/ekskul: tanggal 1 s.d. akhir bulan.
- Tanggal diatur lewat makro **Atur Periode** (ketik dd/mm/yyyy), bukan mengetik langsung di sel (menghindari masalah format tanggal lokal).

---

## 3. Struktur data dan sheet (versi Excel)

Sheet utama (urutan tab): Menu, Petunjuk, Parameter, Tabel, Jabatan, Honor_Master, Pegawai, Input_Bulanan, Honor_Matriks, Input_Honor, Absen_GTT, GTT_Ekskul, Hitung, Slip, Slip_GTT, Payroll, Laporan_Pilihan, Laporan_Payroll, Transfer_Gaji, Transfer_Snack, Rekap, Lap_BPJS_TK, Lap_BPJS_Kes, Lap_Pajak, Tabel_TER, Arsip, Verifikasi, Cek_Sumber, Laporan_Perubahan.
Sheet tersembunyi pendukung: Daftar_Kode, Laporan_Data, Honor_Gabung, Bantu, BantuGTT.

Konvensi: sel input berlatar **kuning (#FFF9DB)**; header hijau tua (#0B5D3B/#1F7A52); aksen emas (#C9A227). Nama terdefinisi: parameter berawalan `p_` (mis. p_TglAwal, p_TglAkhir, p_TglGTTAwal, p_TglGTTAkhir, p_KunciVerifikasi, p_NamaPimpinan, p_NamaBendahara, p_NamaHRD, p_TampilBendahara, p_TampilPajakSlip), tabel berawalan `t_` (t_Honor, t_TER_A/B/C).

Data pegawai (sheet Pegawai, baris 6�?"125, maksimal 120 pegawai): Nomor Unik Pegawai Lajnah, Nama, Status, Jenis (guru/staf), Unit, tahun mulai tugas, tanggal masuk, pendidikan awal dan saat ini, status nikah, jumlah anak, jarak/transport, jabatan utama + tambahan 1�?"3, tunjangan istimewa, program BPJS TK/Kes, **Bank, No. Rekening, Nama di Rekening**, NPWP, PTKP, pajak ditanggung pesantren, **Gaji Pokok Terakhir + Tanggal Berlaku (angka tetap)**.

Input bulanan (Input_Bulanan): menit tidak hadir, hari transport, hari snack, snack transfer/tunai, potongan lain (+ keterangan), catatan. Nilai ini boleh berupa rumus yang membaca file sumber bulanan (lihat 5).

Sheet Hitung: satu baris per pegawai, menghitung seluruh komponen (gaji pokok, tunjangan, kehadiran, transport, honor, snack, BPJS, PPh, potongan, total penghasilan, total potongan, gaji bersih, gaji tanpa snack) dan kolom **Cek** (pesan masalah data, mis. "Pendidikan awal kosong"). Rekap menampilkan jumlah baris bermasalah (harus 0).

---

## 4. Keluaran

1. **Slip gaji pegawai dan slip GTT** (dinamis, hanya komponen bernominal)
   - Kop: logo di kiri, "YAYASAN LAJNAH KHAIRIYAH MUSYTARAKAH / Pesantren Imam Syafi'i".
   - Alamat di bawah: Jl. Banda Aceh �?" Medan Km.16,5 Desa Reuhat Tuha, Kec. Sukamakmur, Kab. Aceh Besar, Provinsi Aceh.
   - Isi: nomor unik, tahun mulai tugas, masa kerja, rincian penghasilan/potongan, PPh (opsional), informasi pembayaran lewat **transfer** (bank, no. rekening, nama di rekening), terbilang.
   - Tanda tangan: **Pimpinan (kiri, "Menyetujui")**, **Bendahara (tengah, opsional)**, **HRD (kanan, "Dibuat oleh")**; nama pimpinan, bendahara, HRD dari Parameter; tanda tangan berupa gambar scan yang diposisikan lewat makro.
   - **Kode verifikasi** pada slip (format `Vyymm-NNNN-NNNN`, hash dengan kata kunci rahasia); sheet **Verifikasi** untuk memeriksa keaslian. Kata kunci default `LKM-ISY-2026` **harus diganti**; mengganti kata kunci membuat kode lama tidak cocok.
   - Tombol: awal/mundur/maju/akhir, simpan satu PDF, simpan semua PDF.
2. **Payroll** dan **Laporan_Pilihan** (pengguna memilih kolom yang dilaporkan: identitas, rincian tunjangan dan honor, potongan, rekening; profil Ya/Tidak) lalu ekspor ke **file Excel terpisah** (nilai saja) per penerima: pimpinan, bank/bendahara, arsip HRD.
3. **Transfer_Gaji** dan **Transfer_Snack**: no, nomor unik, nama, bank, no. rekening, nama di rekening, jumlah (snack tidak masuk total gaji).
4. **Rekap**: ringkasan total penghasilan, potongan, gaji bersih, snack, gaji tanpa snack, GTT, BPJS, PPh, **total kebutuhan dana**, dan jumlah baris bermasalah.
5. **Lap_BPJS_TK**, **Lap_BPJS_Kes**, **Lap_Pajak** (terutang, ditanggung, dipotong).
6. **Laporan_Perubahan** (makro): membandingkan file ini dengan file penggajian **bulan lalu** per pegawai. Kelompok: Pegawai baru, Tidak ada bulan ini, Gaji pokok (kenaikan A�5% diberi keterangan "kenaikan tahunan"), Tunjangan, Jabatan, Data pegawai (status, unit, pendidikan, nikah, anak), Rekening (perlu dicek manual sebelum transfer), BPJS, Variabel (kehadiran, transport, honor, snack, potongan, total; hanya bila selisih �%� ambang persen dan Rp50.000).
