## 5. Alur kerja bulanan (yang sudah dipakai pengguna)

1. Data sumber bulan ini disiapkan di **template `Data_Sumber_AAAA_BB.xlsx`** (satu file, sheet dan kolom **tetap**): `Kehadiran` (nama H, menit I), `TRANSPORTASI` (nama B, hari C), `SNACK` (nama B, hari E), `POTONGAN` (nama B, nominal J), `HALAQAH DAN JP` (nama B; C halaqah, D JP lebih, E jam pengganti), `LEMBUR` (nama B, nominal C), `PENGAJIAN` (nama B, jumlah C), `HONOR_LAIN` (nama B; jenis honor di C1:I1, maksimal 7). Kolom CEK NAMA menandai nama yang tidak cocok dengan daftar pegawai.
2. Di file penggajian: **Atur Periode** �+' **Ganti Sumber Data** (arahkan tautan ke template bulan ini) �+' **Cek Sumber Data** (daftar nama tidak cocok) �+' bila ada jenis honor baru di HONOR_LAIN, **Sambung Honor Lain** (membuat kolom Honor_Matriks lengkap dengan rumus ambil data).
3. Periksa Pegawai (masuk/keluar, status, gaji pokok), Absen_GTT, GTT_Ekskul, Input_Honor; lalu **Hitung** (kolom Cek semua OK) dan **Rekap** (baris bermasalah = 0); jalankan **Laporan Perubahan** (pilih file bulan lalu).
4. Cetak/PDF slip, transfer, laporan BPJS dan pajak, ekspor laporan terpisah.
5. Setelah final: **Bulan Baru** (simpan + cadangan ke folder `Cadangan`, majukan tanggal periode, kosongkan isian ketikan bulan lalu tanpa menghapus rumus tautan, simpan sebagai `GAJI PEGAWAI PIS_AAAA_BB.xlsm`), **Impor File Bulanan** ke Rekap Tahunan, lalu **Kunci Sheet**.

Penamaan: folder per bulan (`MM. NAMABULAN`), file `GAJI PEGAWAI PIS_2026_MM.xlsm`. Nama bulan/periode kunci rekap memakai format `tahun_bulan` (mis. `2026_11`; hindari `2026-11` karena dikira tanggal oleh COUNTIF/SUMIF).

---

## 6. Makro VBA (modul)

**Makro_Slip**: navigasi slip, simpan PDF satu/semua, `PasangTombol`, `PosisiTTD`/`PasangTTD`/`HapusTTD` (tinggi tanda tangan 56, geser atas 2, geser pimpinan/bendahara/HRD 5).
**Makro_Laporan**: `Ekspor(profil)`, `EksporLaporan`, `EksporSemuaProfil` ke folder `Laporan`, `PasangTombolLaporan`.
**Makro_Bulanan**: `BuatMenu`, `AturPeriode`, `BulanBaru`, `GantiSumberData` (memperingatkan bila Gaji Pokok Terakhir masih tautan), `BekukanGajiPokok`, `CekSumberData` (hasil di sheet Cek_Sumber), `SambungHonorLain`, `LaporanPerubahan`, `KunciSemua`/`BukaKunciSemua` (hanya sel kuning terbuka; kata sandi opsional), `CadanganSekarang`, `KeMenu` (Ctrl+Shift+M lewat `Auto_Open`).
**Makro_Rekap** (di file Rekap Tahunan): `ImporBulan` (boleh banyak file; periode dari `p_TglAkhir`; mengganti bila periode sudah ada), `HapusSatuPeriode`, `HitungUlang`, `PasangTombolRekap`.

Aturan VBA yang sudah dipelajari: hindari `IIf` yang mengakses indeks di luar rentang (kedua cabang selalu dievaluasi); jangan memakai `GoTo` masuk blok; tulis array ke `Range` dengan ukuran persis sama; pakai `Names("p_...").RefersToRange` bukan `Range("p_...")` agar tidak bergantung sheet aktif; tanggal ditulis sebagai angka (`Value2 = CDbl(tanggal)`).

---

## 7. Rekap Tahunan (file terpisah `Rekap_Tahunan_AAAA.xlsx/.xlsm`)

- **Data_Pegawai** (satu baris per pegawai per bulan, kolom A periode `tahun_bulan`, B�?"U sama dengan kolom Payroll B�?"U, V jabatan utama+tambahan) dan **Data_Bulanan** (BPJS TK/Kes, PPh, ringkasan GTT, sumber file, tanggal impor); kapasitas 2.000 baris pegawai dan 120 baris bulanan.
- **Ringkasan** (12 bulan: jumlah pegawai, penghasilan, potongan, gaji bersih, snack, GTT, BPJS, PPh, total kebutuhan dana, perubahan vs bulan lalu; dua grafik), **Per_Pegawai** (dropdown, komponen 12 bulan + grafik), **Banding_Bulan** (selisih gaji bersih per pegawai, ambang persen), **Perubahan_Data** (status, unit, jabatan, gaji pokok, tunjangan keluarga/beras/jabatan+istimewa bulan dipilih vs sebelumnya), **Per_Status_Unit** (pilih ukuran: gaji bersih/penghasilan/potongan/jumlah pegawai).
- Total kebutuhan dana = gaji bersih pegawai + GTT bersih + BPJS (pesantren + pegawai) + PPh disetor (terutang). Rumus harus cocok dengan sheet Rekap file bulanan.
- Daftar pegawai unik via kolom bantu (tanpa dynamic array). Rekening dan tanda terima sengaja tidak disalin.

---

## 8. Keamanan dan integritas data

- Proteksi sheet: sel kuning terbuka, lainnya terkunci; gambar/tombol tidak terkunci; filter diizinkan; kata sandi opsional.
- Cadangan otomatis sebelum Bulan Baru (folder `Cadangan`).
- Ganti kata kunci verifikasi di awal tahun atau sebelum slip dibagikan.
- Nilai tetap (gaji pokok terakhir) jangan berupa tautan eksternal; tautan eksternal hanya untuk data input bulanan.

---

## 9. Batasan teknis yang sudah diketahui

- openpyxl: memuat dan menyimpan ulang `.xlsm` pengguna **menghilangkan** validasi data x14, bentuk/tombol, dan VBA; perubahan pada file pengguna harus lewat **penyuntingan XML langsung** (hapus `calcChain.xml`, set `fullCalcOnLoad`) atau lewat makro `.bas` yang diimpor pengguna.
- Hindari fungsi array dinamis di rumus hasil generator (spill); LibreOffice tidak menghitung XLOOKUP tautan eksternal (#NAME?) sehingga verifikasi lewat LibreOffice terbatas.
- Teks yang menimpa sel rumus kosong (`""`) tidak meluap ke sel sebelah di Excel; slip dinamis menjaga teks �% lebar kolom.
- Membuat `vbaProject.bin` tidak mungkin di sini; makro disampaikan sebagai `.bas` (CRLF, cp1252).

---

## 10. Yang belum selesai / perlu keputusan

- Uji semua makro di Excel pengguna (Laporan Perubahan, Kunci Sheet, Bulan Baru, Bekukan Gaji Pokok, Makro_Rekap).

- Rekap tahunan untuk bulan sebelum November belum terisi (file Oktober dan sebelumnya berasal dari sistem lama).
- **Aplikasi web**: menyusul. Model data (bagian 3), aturan (bagian 2), keluaran (bagian 4), dan alur (bagian 5) adalah spesifikasinya; prioritaskan: master pegawai, input bulanan, mesin hitung, slip PDF dengan kode verifikasi, laporan, rekap tahunan, peran pengguna (HRD, bendahara, pimpinan), dan jejak audit perubahan data.

---

## 11. Cara bekerja dengan pengguna

- Jawab dan buat dokumen dalam Bahasa Indonesia, ringkas, tanpa jargon yang tidak perlu.
- Mulai kerja langsung bila permintaan jelas; tanya hanya bila taruhannya besar (struktur, hal sulit dibatalkan).

- Jangan pernah mengubah file kerja pengguna tanpa menjelaskan apa yang berubah; sertakan versi yang diperbaiki dan catat apa yang dipulihkan.

<?php

namespace App\Services;

use App\Models\Employee;
use App\Models\PayrollComponent;
use App\Models\PayrollPeriod;
use App\Models\PayrollRunEmployee;
use Illuminate\Support\Collection;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;

class PayrollCalculator
{
    private const DAYS_PER_MONTH = 30;
    private const MINUTES_PER_MONTH = 14400;

    public function calculate(PayrollPeriod $period, PayrollRunEmployee $row): array
    {
        $row->loadMissing(['employee.payrollProfile.education', 'attendanceSummary']);
        $employee = $row->employee;
        $profile = $employee->payrollProfile;
        if (! $profile) throw ValidationException::withMessages(['payroll' => "Profil payroll {$employee->full_name} belum tersedia."]);

        $components = PayrollComponent::query()->where('is_active', true)->get()->keyBy('code');
        $status = $this->employmentStatus($employee);
        $summary = $row->attendanceSummary;
        $details = collect();

        $baseSalary = $this->baseSalary($employee, $profile, $status);
        if ($baseSalary > 0) $details->push($this->line($components, 'gaji_pokok', 'penghasilan', $baseSalary, 1, $baseSalary, 'Dasar gaji sesuai profil payroll.'));

        if ($status === 'harian') {
            $absent = (int) ($summary?->absent_days ?? 0);
            $amount = max(0, 51000 * (self::DAYS_PER_MONTH - $absent));
            $details = collect([$this->line($components, 'gaji_harian', 'penghasilan', $amount, self::DAYS_PER_MONTH - $absent, 51000, 'Rp51.000 x (30 - hari alpa).')]);
        }

        if (in_array($status, ['tetap', 'percobaan', 'khidmah_khusus'], true)) {
            $this->familyAllowances($details, $components, $profile);
            $this->attendanceAllowance($details, $components, $employee, $summary);
        }

        if ($status === 'harian' && $profile->spouse_status) {
            $members = 2 + (int) $profile->child_count;
            $details->push($this->line($components, 'tunjangan_beras', 'penghasilan', 70000 * $members, $members, 70000, 'Beras keluarga pegawai harian.'));
        }

        if ($status === 'khidmah') $details->push($this->line($components, 'honorarium_khidmah', 'penghasilan', 700000, 1, 700000, 'Honorarium khidmah.'));

        return $details->filter()->values()->all();
    }

    private function familyAllowances(Collection $details, Collection $components, object $profile): void
    {
        if (! $profile->spouse_status) return;
        $details->push($this->line($components, 'tunjangan_pasangan', 'penghasilan', 200000, 1, 200000, 'Tunjangan pasangan.'));
        $children = (int) $profile->child_count;
        if ($children) $details->push($this->line($components, 'tunjangan_anak', 'penghasilan', $children * 100000, $children, 100000, 'Tunjangan anak.'));
        $members = 2 + $children;
        $details->push($this->line($components, 'tunjangan_beras', 'penghasilan', $members * 70000, $members, 70000, 'Beras anggota keluarga.'));
    }

    private function attendanceAllowance(Collection $details, Collection $components, Employee $employee, mixed $summary): void
    {
        $full = str_contains(strtolower((string) $employee->orgUnit?->name), 'msu') || str_contains(strtolower((string) $employee->orgUnit?->name), 'sd') ? 270000 : 540000;
        $minutes = (int) (($summary?->total_late_minutes ?? 0) + ($summary?->total_early_minutes ?? 0));
        $amount = max(0, ceil($full - ($full / self::MINUTES_PER_MONTH * $minutes)));
        $details->push($this->line($components, 'tunjangan_kehadiran', 'penghasilan', $amount, self::MINUTES_PER_MONTH - $minutes, $full / self::MINUTES_PER_MONTH, 'Kehadiran penuh dikurangi menit terlambat/pulang awal.'));
    }

    private function baseSalary(Employee $employee, object $profile, string $status): float
    {
        if ($status === 'khidmah') return 0;
        if ($profile->last_salary_amount !== null) return (float) $profile->last_salary_amount;
        if ($profile->salary_basis_override !== null) return (float) $profile->salary_basis_override;
        $education = strtoupper((string) ($profile->education?->code ?? $profile->education?->name));
        return match (true) {
            str_contains($education, 'SMP') => 500000,
            str_contains($education, 'SMA') => 700000,
            str_contains($education, 'D3') => 900000,
            str_contains($education, 'S1') => 1100000,
            default => throw ValidationException::withMessages(['payroll' => "Pendidikan/gaji pokok terakhir {$employee->full_name} belum dikonfigurasi."]),
        };
    }

    private function employmentStatus(Employee $employee): string
    {
        $value = strtolower((string) ($employee->employment_status ?? $employee->status ?? 'tetap'));
        return match (true) {
            str_contains($value, 'harian') => 'harian', str_contains($value, 'khidmah khusus') => 'khidmah_khusus',
            str_contains($value, 'khidmah') => 'khidmah', str_contains($value, 'percobaan') => 'percobaan', default => 'tetap',
        };
    }

    private function line(Collection $components, string $code, string $type, float $amount, float $quantity, float $rate, string $note): ?array
    {
        $component = $components->get($code);
        if (! $component || $amount <= 0) return null;
        return ['component_id' => $component->id, 'type' => $type, 'quantity' => $quantity, 'unit_rate' => $rate, 'basis_amount' => null, 'amount' => ceil($amount), 'formula_note' => $note, 'source_type' => 'payroll_calculator', 'source_id' => null, 'sort_order' => $component->sort_order];
    }
}

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build "Aplikasi Kepegawaian PIS" HRIS following 8-stage roadmap.
- Stage 4 complete; Stage 5 payroll framework is in progress.

## Requirements
- Indonesian UI, IDR currency, DD-MM-YYYY dates, Asia/Jakarta timezone.
- MySQL DB; no fabricated payroll policies/rates.
- Private storage for sensitive files and PDFs.
- Attendance: GPS radius + selfie + idempotency keys.
- Leave/Correction: 2-level approval (Direct Supervisor -> HRD).
- Payroll: period/status flow, snapshot, verified/locked, approval, individual + batch PDF slips.
- Production payroll calculation blocked until official K-01–K-12 and K-28/K-29 decisions exist.

## Decisions
- Stage 4 implemented with Blade/Controllers, no Livewire.
- Stage 5 approach: "Bangun kerangka kosong" — master, periods, snapshot, approval, adjustments, slip PDF; no production amounts/rates.
- `attendance_period_summaries` moved into Stage 5 because `payroll_periods` is required.
- `attendances.payroll_period_id` added in Stage 4 without FK; FK added in Stage 5 migration.
- Cross-midnight shifts handled in `AttendanceService`: checkout until shift end + 4h next day.
- DEMO supervisor mapping: Pegawai -> Kepala, others -> Pimpinan.
- Payroll approval flow: HRD submits; steps are Keuangan -> Pimpinan; HRD not a separate approver because HRD is requester and cannot approve own submission.
- Lock requires approved `ApprovalInstance` plus `payroll_runs.status = final`; current skeleton run is `draf`.
- Slip PDF marked `SIMULASI`; official slip only for locked period and final run.
- Payroll adjustments status starts `menunggu`; approval uses `payroll.lock`; only pending adjustments can be deleted.

## Work State
### Completed
- Stage 1 Blueprint, Stage 2 Foundation, Stage 3 Administration fully verified.
- Stage 4 Attendance: migrations, GPS/haversine, selfie storage, history, rekap.
- Stage 4 Leave: migrations, balances, overlap checks, working day calculation, attendance sync.
- Stage 4 Corrections/Exceptions: multi-level approval, evidence uploads.
- Stage 4 tests: 61 passed, 311 assertions; docs updated.
- Stage 5 migration `2026_11_22_003000_create_payroll_tables.php` applied successfully; fixed long MySQL index name via `pcr_component_rate_date_uq`.
- Stage 5 models created for payroll components, rates, education bases, transport bands, periods, summaries, runs, run employees, details, adjustments, tax brackets, tax PTKP, BPJS settings, payslips.
- `PayrollComponentSeeder` created and seeded; initial component codes only, no fabricated production amounts/formulas.
- `PayrollComponentController` CRUD with validation; formula whitelist and method checks.
- `PayrollService`: snapshot generation, skeleton run creation, period locking.
- `PayrollPeriod` implements `Approvable`; `ApprovalFlowSeeder` includes `payroll` flow.
- Payroll UI: index, form, detail, component master, nav links.
- Payroll approval submission route/UI added.
- Slip PDF: `PayrollPdfService`, `PayslipGenerationService`, `PayslipController`, Blade templates, private storage, audit event.
- Payroll adjustments: controller, routes, UI, create/filter/approve/delete.
- Payroll subset tests passed: 10 tests, 25 assertions; later adjustment regression subset: 7 tests, 14 assertions.
- PHP lint and Blade cache passed after major Stage 5 additions.

### Active
- Integrating approved `payroll_adjustments` into new payroll run details/totals.
- `app/Services/PayrollService.php` now imports `PayrollAdjustment` and `PayrollDetail`; implementation not yet completed.

### Blocked
- K-01/K-02/K-03/K-04/K-09 and K-01–K-12/K-28/K-29: official payroll formulas/rates/education basis/annual increase/BPJS/PPh 21/prorata rules pending.
- K-13/K-14: real GPS coordinates/radius/accuracy thresholds pending; DEMO values used.
- K-15/K-16/K-24/K-27/K-30: shifts, paid-leave rules, correction deadlines, field-work policies pending.
- K-18/K-26/K-08: numbering formats, Yayasan approval authority, probation length pending.
- Production payroll finalization blocked: no configured rates/formulas and no `final` run from normal workflow.
- Full test suite not rerun after final Stage 5 adjustment changes; only targeted payroll subsets were run.

## Next Move
1. Finish adjustment integration in `app/Services/PayrollService.php`: fetch approved `PayrollAdjustment` rows for period, create `PayrollDetail` rows, update `payroll_run_employees` and run totals, avoid double application.
2. Add tests proving approved adjustments are applied once and pending/rejected adjustments are ignored.
3. Decide and implement controlled run finalization path once policy/rate prerequisites are defined.
4. Implement real `PayrollController::export()` report/export (currently placeholder warning).
5. Run full `php artisan test` suite and update `docs/TEST_REPORT.md`, `docs/DEVELOPMENT_PROGRESS.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`, `README.md`.

## Relevant Files
- `docs/DEVELOPMENT_ROADMAP.md`: Stage 5 scope source of truth.
- `docs/CLARIFICATIONS.md`: unresolved payroll policy blockers K-01–K-12, K-28, K-29.
- `database/migrations/2026_11_22_003000_create_payroll_tables.php`: all Stage 5 tables and `attendances.payroll_period_id` FK.
- `app/Services/PayrollService.php`: snapshot, skeleton run, lock; active adjustment integration.
- `app/Services/PayrollPdfService.php`: individual and batch PDF rendering.
- `app/Services/PayslipGenerationService.php`: official payslip PDF generation guard logic.
- `app/Services/ApprovalService.php`: generic approval engine used by `payroll` flow.
- `app/Models/PayrollPeriod.php`: implements `Approvable`; status transitions.
- `app/Models/PayrollRunEmployee.php`: per-employee run totals and details relation.
- `app/Models/PayrollDetail.php`: audit detail rows for adjustments integration.
- `app/Http/Controllers/PayrollController.php`: period workflow endpoints.
- `app/Http/Controllers/PayslipController.php`: payslip index/download/batch/generate.
- `app/Http/Controllers/PayrollAdjustmentController.php`: adjustment CRUD/approval.
- `routes/web.php`: Stage 5 routes.
- `tests/Feature`: `PayrollSmokeTest.php`, `PayrollApprovalTest.php`, `PayslipPdfTest.php`.

## Important Context
- Directory is NOT a Git repo; all changes remain uncommitted.
- MySQL dev DB: `pis_kepegawaian`; test DB: `pis_kepegawaian_test`.
- App timezone is UTC; business logic uses Asia/Jakarta via Carbon/string normalization.
- Administrator role lacks payroll/personal-data access; use `hrd.demo`, `keuangan.demo`, `pimpinan.demo` for payroll tests.
- Demo account passwords from docs: `Admin#2026`, `Demo#2026`.
- `PayrollService::lock()` checks approval and final run; PDF generation checks locked period + final run.
- `AuditLogger` event column length is 30; use short event codes such as `payroll.run.created`.
- Private files stored under `storage/app`; payslips stored via `Storage::disk('local')`.
- `PayrollComponentSeeder` seeds only component definitions; no production nominal values invented.
- Slip PDF watermark `SIMULASI` is intentional until official payroll policies exist.

# PROMPT: Aplikasi Penggajian Pegawai Pesantren

> Gunakan dokumen ini sebagai brief lengkap untuk membangun atau melanjutkan aplikasi penggajian (versi Excel yang sudah berjalan, atau versi web yang menyusul). Bahasa antarmuka, label, dan keluaran: **Bahasa Indonesia**.

---

## 1. Peran dan tujuan

Anda adalah pengembang aplikasi penggajian untuk **seksi HRD, Yayasan Lajnah Khairiyah Musytarakah**, mewakili **Pesantren Imam Syafi'i** (Aceh Besar). Aplikasi menghitung gaji bulanan pegawai dan guru, mencetak slip gaji, membuat daftar transfer, laporan BPJS dan pajak, serta merekap perkembangan setahun.

Tahap saat ini: **Excel (.xlsm) dengan makro VBA sudah berjalan** dan dipakai dengan data nyata. Aplikasi web menyusul setelah versi Excel stabil. Semua hasil harus dapat diperiksa pengguna non-teknis.

Prinsip kerja:
- Rumus hidup di sheet, bukan angka mati. Semua tarif ada di sheet Parameter/Tabel, bukan di dalam rumus.
- Semua hasil perhitungan **dibulatkan ke atas**.
- Slip hanya menampilkan komponen yang bernominal (baris kosong disembunyikan).
- Jangan menimpa data pengguna. Setiap perubahan struktur harus aman terhadap file kerja yang sudah berisi data.
- Jujur soal yang belum teruji: makro VBA belum pernah diuji di Excel oleh pembuatnya, hanya di LibreOffice dan simulasi.

---

## 2. Aturan bisnis (final)

### 2.1 Status dan gaji pokok
- Status pegawai: **tetap (GTY/STY)**, **harian**, **khidmah**, **khidmah khusus**, **masa percobaan**; ada juga **GTT** dan **guru ekskul** (slip dan periode terpisah).
- Gaji pokok pegawai **baru** menurut pendidikan: SMP 500.000, SMA 700.000, D3 900.000, S1 1.100.000 (S2 belum ada tarif; wajib punya gaji pokok terakhir).
- **Naik pendidikan** (mis. D3 ke S1): naik 15% dari gaji pokok terakhir.
- **Kenaikan berkala 5% per tahun** untuk pegawai tetap, dihitung dari gaji pokok terakhir (berkelanjutan), pertama kali setelah genap satu tahun. Hasil kenaikan 5% dibiarkan apa adanya (tidak dibulatkan).
- **Pegawai yang sudah berjalan**: gaji pokok memakai kolom **Gaji Pokok Terakhir** + **Tanggal Berlaku** di data pegawai. Kolom ini harus berupa **angka tetap** (bukan rumus tautan ke file lain); acuan pendidikan hanya untuk pegawai baru.
- **Harian**: Rp51.000 per hari kalender x 30, dipotong bila tidak hadir. Hanya dapat beras (bila menikah), transportasi, THR (nominal disesuaikan).
- **Khidmah**: tanpa gaji pokok; honorarium 700.000 (setara gaji pokok SMA). Khidmah khusus dihitung seperti pegawai tetap tetapi komponen tunjangan/honor dibuat bisa dipilih.
- **Masa percobaan**: gaji pokok menurut pendidikan; tunjangan keluarga dan beras bisa dipilih; kehadiran ya; transport, jabatan, istimewa tidak; honor bisa dipilih.

### 2.2 Tunjangan
- Suami/istri 200.000; anak 100.000 per anak (tanpa batas jumlah anak).
- **Beras** per anggota keluarga (pegawai sendiri ikut dihitung): nominal di Parameter (saat ini **70.000**). Lajang tidak dapat; istri tidak dapat bila suami-istri sama-sama bekerja di pesantren.
- **Transportasi** bila jarak lebih dari 1 km: 1�?"5 km Rp5.000, 5�?"10 km Rp10.000, dst. naik sampai maksimum Rp20.000 **per hari**; jumlah hari diinput manual.
- **Kehadiran**: 18.000 per hari x 30 hari = **540.000** (pegawai di **MSU/SD**: 270.000). 8 jam = 480 menit per hari. Potongan terlambat/alpha diinput **dalam menit**, dipotong per menit dengan pembagi 14.400 (menit sebulan). GTY maksimal 360 jam (1.500/jam, 1 jam = 40 menit x 12 jam/hari); STY maksimal 240 jam (2.250/jam, 1 jam = 60 menit x 8 jam/hari); potongan telat/alpha sama.
- **Jabatan utama** + **jabatan tambahan 1�?"3** + **tunjangan istimewa** (semua masuk dasar BPJS TK).
- Daftar jabatan dan tarifnya disimpan di sheet Jabatan.

### 2.3 Honorarium (fleksibel)
- Jenis honor di **Honor_Master** (nama, tarif, satuan). Jenis tanpa tarif = input nominal rupiah (mis. THR, bonus, meugang); jenis bertarif = input jumlah.
- Contoh: halaqah tahfidz, kelebihan JP, menggantikan jam mengajar, lembur (nominal per orang), insentif pengajian, THR, bonus prestasi, meugang.
- **Kelebihan JP dihitung per minggu penuh (Senin�?"Sabtu)**; periode kelebihan JP dihitung **otomatis** dari tanggal akhir periode (tanpa input manual tiap bulan).
- Input honor lewat **Honor_Matriks** (satu baris per pegawai, kolom per jenis honor, maksimal 12 kolom: C�?"N) dan **Input_Honor** (daftar honor khusus per kejadian). Keduanya digabung di sheet tersembunyi **Honor_Gabung**.

### 2.4 Snack
- Rp2.500 per hari, input hari manual. Tampil di slip dan ikut total penghasilan, tetapi **dilaporkan terpisah** (daftar transfer snack sendiri; tidak masuk total transfer gaji). Pilihan per pegawai: transfer atau tunai.

### 2.5 BPJS
- **BPJS Ketenagakerjaan**: tetap dan harian ikut 3 program (JKK 0,24%, JKM 0,30%, JHT 3,7% pesantren + 2% pegawai); khidmah hanya JKK + JKM; percobaan tidak ikut; JP tersedia sebagai kolom. Pegawai di bawah UMR untuk 2 program memakai **UMR Aceh Besar 3.932.552** sebagai dasar.
- Dasar BPJS TK 3 program = gaji pokok + tunj. suami/istri + anak + beras + jabatan + istimewa + kehadiran **penuh** (nominal penuh, bukan yang sudah dipotong). Harian: 51.000 x 30.
- **BPJS Kesehatan**: 4% pesantren + 1% pegawai, acuan tetap **4.200.000**; ikut atau tidak dipilih per pegawai; mencakup pegawai, pasangan, maksimal 3 anak; **anak ke-4 dan seterusnya** tambahan iuran 1% (42.000) per anak, ditanggung pegawai.
- GTT dan ekskul tidak ikut BPJS (tunjangan jabatan dan potongan tetap bisa ada).
- Laporan BPJS TK format: NIK, nomor KPJ, nama, tgl lahir, data upah, JKK, JKM, JHT (2% pekerja, 3,7% pemberi kerja), JP, total iuran.

### 2.6 PPh 21
- Memakai **tarif efektif rata-rata (TER)** menurut PTKP/kategori (A/B/C). Tabel TER ada di sheet Tabel_TER dan **harus dicocokkan dengan PMK 168/2023** (tabel diambil dari sumber web).
- Opsi per pegawai: **pajak ditanggung pesantren** atau dipotong dari pegawai. Ada laporan pajak terpisah, dan pilihan tampil atau tidak di slip (parameter TampilPajakSlip).

### 2.7 GTT dan ekskul
- Digaji **1 bulan penuh** (tanggal 1 sampai akhir bulan), slip khusus (Slip_GTT).
- GTT: kehadiran 20.000/hari, JP SMP 12.000, JP MA 14.000; dapat snack seperti pegawai tetap; input manual (Absen_GTT: total hadir, total JP SMP, total JP MA).
- Ekskul dibayar per pertemuan (menjahit 100.000, memanah 150.000, pramuka/fahmil/taekwondo/debat Arab 100.000), tanpa snack.
- GTT dan ekskul hanya dapat itu saja kecuali THR dan meugang setahun sekali.

### 2.8 Periode
- Pegawai: absensi tanggal **21 s.d. 20 bulan berikutnya** (mis. 21 Okt �?" 20 Nov 2026 = gaji bulan November).
- GTT/ekskul: tanggal 1 s.d. akhir bulan.
- Tanggal diatur lewat makro **Atur Periode** (ketik dd/mm/yyyy), bukan mengetik langsung di sel (menghindari masalah format tanggal lokal).

---

## 3. Struktur data dan sheet (versi Excel)

Sheet utama (urutan tab): Menu, Petunjuk, Parameter, Tabel, Jabatan, Honor_Master, Pegawai, Input_Bulanan, Honor_Matriks, Input_Honor, Absen_GTT, GTT_Ekskul, Hitung, Slip, Slip_GTT, Payroll, Laporan_Pilihan, Laporan_Payroll, Transfer_Gaji, Transfer_Snack, Rekap, Lap_BPJS_TK, Lap_BPJS_Kes, Lap_Pajak, Tabel_TER, Arsip, Verifikasi, Cek_Sumber, Laporan_Perubahan.
Sheet tersembunyi pendukung: Daftar_Kode, Laporan_Data, Honor_Gabung, Bantu, BantuGTT.

Konvensi: sel input berlatar **kuning (#FFF9DB)**; header hijau tua (#0B5D3B/#1F7A52); aksen emas (#C9A227). Nama terdefinisi: parameter berawalan `p_` (mis. p_TglAwal, p_TglAkhir, p_TglGTTAwal, p_TglGTTAkhir, p_KunciVerifikasi, p_NamaPimpinan, p_NamaBendahara, p_NamaHRD, p_TampilBendahara, p_TampilPajakSlip), tabel berawalan `t_` (t_Honor, t_TER_A/B/C).

Data pegawai (sheet Pegawai, baris 6�?"125, maksimal 120 pegawai): Nomor Unik Pegawai Lajnah, Nama, Status, Jenis (guru/staf), Unit, tahun mulai tugas, tanggal masuk, pendidikan awal dan saat ini, status nikah, jumlah anak, jarak/transport, jabatan utama + tambahan 1�?"3, tunjangan istimewa, program BPJS TK/Kes, **Bank, No. Rekening, Nama di Rekening**, NPWP, PTKP, pajak ditanggung pesantren, **Gaji Pokok Terakhir + Tanggal Berlaku (angka tetap)**.

Input bulanan (Input_Bulanan): menit tidak hadir, hari transport, hari snack, snack transfer/tunai, potongan lain (+ keterangan), catatan. Nilai ini boleh berupa rumus yang membaca file sumber bulanan (lihat 5).

Sheet Hitung: satu baris per pegawai, menghitung seluruh komponen (gaji pokok, tunjangan, kehadiran, transport, honor, snack, BPJS, PPh, potongan, total penghasilan, total potongan, gaji bersih, gaji tanpa snack) dan kolom **Cek** (pesan masalah data, mis. "Pendidikan awal kosong"). Rekap menampilkan jumlah baris bermasalah (harus 0).

---

## 4. Keluaran

1. **Slip gaji pegawai dan slip GTT** (dinamis, hanya komponen bernominal)
   - Kop: logo di kiri, "YAYASAN LAJNAH KHAIRIYAH MUSYTARAKAH / Pesantren Imam Syafi'i".
   - Alamat di bawah: Jl. Banda Aceh �?" Medan Km.16,5 Desa Reuhat Tuha, Kec. Sukamakmur, Kab. Aceh Besar, Provinsi Aceh.
   - Isi: nomor unik, tahun mulai tugas, masa kerja, rincian penghasilan/potongan, PPh (opsional), informasi pembayaran lewat **transfer** (bank, no. rekening, nama di rekening), terbilang.
   - Tanda tangan: **Pimpinan (kiri, "Menyetujui")**, **Bendahara (tengah, opsional)**, **HRD (kanan, "Dibuat oleh")**; nama pimpinan, bendahara, HRD dari Parameter; tanda tangan berupa gambar scan yang diposisikan lewat makro.
   - **Kode verifikasi** pada slip (format `Vyymm-NNNN-NNNN`, hash dengan kata kunci rahasia); sheet **Verifikasi** untuk memeriksa keaslian. Kata kunci default `LKM-ISY-2026` **harus diganti**; mengganti kata kunci membuat kode lama tidak cocok.
   - Tombol: awal/mundur/maju/akhir, simpan satu PDF, simpan semua PDF.
2. **Payroll** dan **Laporan_Pilihan** (pengguna memilih kolom yang dilaporkan: identitas, rincian tunjangan dan honor, potongan, rekening; profil Ya/Tidak) lalu ekspor ke **file Excel terpisah** (nilai saja) per penerima: pimpinan, bank/bendahara, arsip HRD.
3. **Transfer_Gaji** dan **Transfer_Snack**: no, nomor unik, nama, bank, no. rekening, nama di rekening, jumlah (snack tidak masuk total gaji).
4. **Rekap**: ringkasan total penghasilan, potongan, gaji bersih, snack, gaji tanpa snack, GTT, BPJS, PPh, **total kebutuhan dana**, dan jumlah baris bermasalah.
5. **Lap_BPJS_TK**, **Lap_BPJS_Kes**, **Lap_Pajak** (terutang, ditanggung, dipotong).
6. **Laporan_Perubahan** (makro): membandingkan file ini dengan file penggajian **bulan lalu** per pegawai. Kelompok: Pegawai baru, Tidak ada bulan ini, Gaji pokok (kenaikan A�5% diberi keterangan "kenaikan tahunan"), Tunjangan, Jabatan, Data pegawai (status, unit, pendidikan, nikah, anak), Rekening (perlu dicek manual sebelum transfer), BPJS, Variabel (kehadiran, transport, honor, snack, potongan, total; hanya bila selisih �%� ambang persen dan Rp50.000).

---

## 5. Alur kerja bulanan (yang sudah dipakai pengguna)

1. Data sumber bulan ini disiapkan di **template `Data_Sumber_AAAA_BB.xlsx`** (satu file, sheet dan kolom **tetap**): `Kehadiran` (nama H, menit I), `TRANSPORTASI` (nama B, hari C), `SNACK` (nama B, hari E), `POTONGAN` (nama B, nominal J), `HALAQAH DAN JP` (nama B; C halaqah, D JP lebih, E jam pengganti), `LEMBUR` (nama B, nominal C), `PENGAJIAN` (nama B, jumlah C), `HONOR_LAIN` (nama B; jenis honor di C1:I1, maksimal 7). Kolom CEK NAMA menandai nama yang tidak cocok dengan daftar pegawai.
2. Di file penggajian: **Atur Periode** �+' **Ganti Sumber Data** (arahkan tautan ke template bulan ini) �+' **Cek Sumber Data** (daftar nama tidak cocok) �+' bila ada jenis honor baru di HONOR_LAIN, **Sambung Honor Lain** (membuat kolom Honor_Matriks lengkap dengan rumus ambil data).
3. Periksa Pegawai (masuk/keluar, status, gaji pokok), Absen_GTT, GTT_Ekskul, Input_Honor; lalu **Hitung** (kolom Cek semua OK) dan **Rekap** (baris bermasalah = 0); jalankan **Laporan Perubahan** (pilih file bulan lalu).
4. Cetak/PDF slip, transfer, laporan BPJS dan pajak, ekspor laporan terpisah.
5. Setelah final: **Bulan Baru** (simpan + cadangan ke folder `Cadangan`, majukan tanggal periode, kosongkan isian ketikan bulan lalu tanpa menghapus rumus tautan, simpan sebagai `GAJI PEGAWAI PIS_AAAA_BB.xlsm`), **Impor File Bulanan** ke Rekap Tahunan, lalu **Kunci Sheet**.

Penamaan: folder per bulan (`MM. NAMABULAN`), file `GAJI PEGAWAI PIS_2026_MM.xlsm`. Nama bulan/periode kunci rekap memakai format `tahun_bulan` (mis. `2026_11`; hindari `2026-11` karena dikira tanggal oleh COUNTIF/SUMIF).

---

## 6. Makro VBA (modul)

**Makro_Slip**: navigasi slip, simpan PDF satu/semua, `PasangTombol`, `PosisiTTD`/`PasangTTD`/`HapusTTD` (tinggi tanda tangan 56, geser atas 2, geser pimpinan/bendahara/HRD 5).
**Makro_Laporan**: `Ekspor(profil)`, `EksporLaporan`, `EksporSemuaProfil` ke folder `Laporan`, `PasangTombolLaporan`.
**Makro_Bulanan**: `BuatMenu`, `AturPeriode`, `BulanBaru`, `GantiSumberData` (memperingatkan bila Gaji Pokok Terakhir masih tautan), `BekukanGajiPokok`, `CekSumberData` (hasil di sheet Cek_Sumber), `SambungHonorLain`, `LaporanPerubahan`, `KunciSemua`/`BukaKunciSemua` (hanya sel kuning terbuka; kata sandi opsional), `CadanganSekarang`, `KeMenu` (Ctrl+Shift+M lewat `Auto_Open`).
**Makro_Rekap** (di file Rekap Tahunan): `ImporBulan` (boleh banyak file; periode dari `p_TglAkhir`; mengganti bila periode sudah ada), `HapusSatuPeriode`, `HitungUlang`, `PasangTombolRekap`.

Aturan VBA yang sudah dipelajari: hindari `IIf` yang mengakses indeks di luar rentang (kedua cabang selalu dievaluasi); jangan memakai `GoTo` masuk blok; tulis array ke `Range` dengan ukuran persis sama; pakai `Names("p_...").RefersToRange` bukan `Range("p_...")` agar tidak bergantung sheet aktif; tanggal ditulis sebagai angka (`Value2 = CDbl(tanggal)`).

---

## 7. Rekap Tahunan (file terpisah `Rekap_Tahunan_AAAA.xlsx/.xlsm`)

- **Data_Pegawai** (satu baris per pegawai per bulan, kolom A periode `tahun_bulan`, B�?"U sama dengan kolom Payroll B�?"U, V jabatan utama+tambahan) dan **Data_Bulanan** (BPJS TK/Kes, PPh, ringkasan GTT, sumber file, tanggal impor); kapasitas 2.000 baris pegawai dan 120 baris bulanan.
- **Ringkasan** (12 bulan: jumlah pegawai, penghasilan, potongan, gaji bersih, snack, GTT, BPJS, PPh, total kebutuhan dana, perubahan vs bulan lalu; dua grafik), **Per_Pegawai** (dropdown, komponen 12 bulan + grafik), **Banding_Bulan** (selisih gaji bersih per pegawai, ambang persen), **Perubahan_Data** (status, unit, jabatan, gaji pokok, tunjangan keluarga/beras/jabatan+istimewa bulan dipilih vs sebelumnya), **Per_Status_Unit** (pilih ukuran: gaji bersih/penghasilan/potongan/jumlah pegawai).
- Total kebutuhan dana = gaji bersih pegawai + GTT bersih + BPJS (pesantren + pegawai) + PPh disetor (terutang). Rumus harus cocok dengan sheet Rekap file bulanan.
- Daftar pegawai unik via kolom bantu (tanpa dynamic array). Rekening dan tanda terima sengaja tidak disalin.

---

## 8. Keamanan dan integritas data

- Proteksi sheet: sel kuning terbuka, lainnya terkunci; gambar/tombol tidak terkunci; filter diizinkan; kata sandi opsional.
- Cadangan otomatis sebelum Bulan Baru (folder `Cadangan`).
- Ganti kata kunci verifikasi di awal tahun atau sebelum slip dibagikan.
- Nilai tetap (gaji pokok terakhir) jangan berupa tautan eksternal; tautan eksternal hanya untuk data input bulanan.

---

## 9. Batasan teknis yang sudah diketahui

- openpyxl: memuat dan menyimpan ulang `.xlsm` pengguna **menghilangkan** validasi data x14, bentuk/tombol, dan VBA; perubahan pada file pengguna harus lewat **penyuntingan XML langsung** (hapus `calcChain.xml`, set `fullCalcOnLoad`) atau lewat makro `.bas` yang diimpor pengguna.
- Hindari fungsi array dinamis di rumus hasil generator (spill); LibreOffice tidak menghitung XLOOKUP tautan eksternal (#NAME?) sehingga verifikasi lewat LibreOffice terbatas.
- Teks yang menimpa sel rumus kosong (`""`) tidak meluap ke sel sebelah di Excel; slip dinamis menjaga teks �% lebar kolom.
- Membuat `vbaProject.bin` tidak mungkin di sini; makro disampaikan sebagai `.bas` (CRLF, cp1252).

---

## 10. Yang belum selesai / perlu keputusan

- Uji semua makro di Excel pengguna (Laporan Perubahan, Kunci Sheet, Bulan Baru, Bekukan Gaji Pokok, Makro_Rekap).
- Data **Kehadiran** bulan berjalan di template sumber harus diisi (jika kosong, semua pegawai dihitung hadir penuh).
- Cocokkan **Tabel TER** dengan PMK 168/2023; cek tunjangan beras (70.000 vs aturan awal 73.000), gaji pokok S2 belum ada tarif.
- Perbandingan dengan slip bulan lalu (3�?"5 pegawai) belum dilakukan.
- Rekap tahunan untuk bulan sebelum November belum terisi (file Oktober dan sebelumnya berasal dari sistem lama).
- **Aplikasi web**: menyusul. Model data (bagian 3), aturan (bagian 2), keluaran (bagian 4), dan alur (bagian 5) adalah spesifikasinya; prioritaskan: master pegawai, input bulanan, mesin hitung, slip PDF dengan kode verifikasi, laporan, rekap tahunan, peran pengguna (HRD, bendahara, pimpinan), dan jejak audit perubahan data.

---

## 11. Cara bekerja dengan pengguna

- Jawab dan buat dokumen dalam Bahasa Indonesia, ringkas, tanpa jargon yang tidak perlu.
- Mulai kerja langsung bila permintaan jelas; tanya hanya bila taruhannya besar (struktur, hal sulit dibatalkan).
- Selalu periksa hasil: bandingkan total dengan Rekap, jalankan hitung ulang, lihat tampilan slip.
- Tunjukkan kesalahan dengan jujur (mis. makro belum diuji, tabel pajak dari sumber web), dan berikan langkah perbaikan konkret.
- Jangan pernah mengubah file kerja pengguna tanpa menjelaskan apa yang berubah; sertakan versi yang diperbaiki dan catat apa yang dipulihkan.

<?php

namespace App\Services;

use App\Models\Employee;
use App\Models\PayrollComponent;
use App\Models\PayrollParameter;
use App\Models\PayrollPeriod;
use Illuminate\Support\Collection;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

class BpjsCalculator
{
    public function calculate(Employee $employee, object $profile, PayrollPeriod $period, Collection $parameters, Collection $components, float $baseIncome, float $fullAttendance): array
    {
        $status = strtolower((string) ($employee->employment_status ?? $employee->employee_category ?? ''));
        if (str_contains($status, 'percobaan') || in_array(strtolower((string) $profile->bpjs_tk_program), ['tidak', 'tidak ikut', 'none'], true)) {
            return [];
        }

        $details = [];
        $programType = strtolower((string) $profile->bpjs_tk_program);
        $isTwoProgram = str_contains($programType, '2') || str_contains($status, 'khidmah') && ! str_contains($status, 'khusus');
        $isDaily = str_contains($status, 'harian');
        $base = $isDaily ? (float) $parameters->get('daily_rate_harian')?->value * 30 : $baseIncome + $fullAttendance;
        $programs = $isTwoProgram ? ['bpjs_tk_jkk', 'bpjs_tk_jkm'] : ['bpjs_tk_jkk', 'bpjs_tk_jkm', 'bpjs_tk_jht'];
        $umr = (float) ($parameters->get('umr_aceh_besar')?->value ?? 3932552);
        if ($isTwoProgram && $base < $umr) $base = $umr;

        foreach ($programs as $programCode) {
            foreach (['employer' => 'iuran_pemberi', 'employee' => 'potongan'] as $participant => $type) {
                $setting = DB::table('bpjs_settings')->where('program', $programCode)->where('participant_type', $participant)->where('effective_from', '<=', $period->end_date)->orderByDesc('effective_from')->first();
                if (! $setting) continue;
                $amount = ceil($base * (float) $setting->rate / 100);
                if ($amount <= 0) continue;
                $componentCode = $this->componentCode($programCode, $participant);
                $component = $components->get($componentCode);
                if (! $component) continue;
                $details[] = $this->line($component, $type, $amount, $base, (float) $setting->rate, strtoupper($programCode).' '.number_format((float) $setting->rate, 2).'%');
            }
        }

        if ($profile->bpjs_health_participates) {
            $healthBase = (float) ($parameters->get('bpjs_kes_base')?->value ?? 4200000);
            foreach (['employer' => 'iuran_pemberi', 'employee' => 'potongan'] as $participant => $type) {
                $setting = DB::table('bpjs_settings')->where('program', 'bpjs_kes')->where('participant_type', $participant)->where('effective_from', '<=', $period->end_date)->orderByDesc('effective_from')->first();
                if (! $setting) continue;
                $amount = ceil($healthBase * (float) $setting->rate / 100);
                $componentCode = $participant === 'employer' ? 'bpjs_kesehatan_pemberi' : 'bpjs_kesehatan_pegawai';
                $component = $components->get($componentCode);
                if (! $component) continue;
                $details[] = $this->line($component, $type, $amount, $healthBase, (float) $setting->rate, 'BPJS Kes '.number_format((float) $setting->rate, 2).'%');
            }
            $extraChildren = max(0, (int) $profile->child_count - 3);
            if ($extraChildren > 0 && $components->has('bpjs_kesehatan_pegawai')) {
                $rate = (float) (DB::table('bpjs_settings')->where('program', 'bpjs_kes')->where('participant_type', 'employee')->value('rate') ?? 1);
                $amount = $extraChildren * ceil($healthBase * $rate / 100);
                $details[] = $this->line($components->get('bpjs_kesehatan_pegawai'), 'potongan', $amount, $healthBase, $rate, 'Iuran anak ke-4 dst ('.$extraChildren.' anak)');
            }
        }

        return $details;
    }

    private function componentCode(string $programCode, string $participant): string
    {
        $suffix = $participant === 'employer' ? 'pemberi' : 'pegawai';
        return match ($programCode) {
            'bpjs_tk_jkk' => 'bpjs_jkk_'.$suffix,
            'bpjs_tk_jkm' => 'bpjs_jkm_'.$suffix,
            'bpjs_tk_jht' => 'bpjs_jht_'.$suffix,
            'bpjs_tk_jp' => 'bpjs_jp_'.$suffix,
            default => 'bpjs_'.$programCode.'_'.$suffix,
        };
    }

    private function line(PayrollComponent $component, string $type, float $amount, float $basis, float $rate, string $note): array
    {
        return [
            'component_id' => $component->id,
            'type' => $type,
            'quantity' => 1,
            'unit_rate' => $rate,
            'basis_amount' => $basis,
            'amount' => $amount,
            'formula_note' => $note,
            'source_type' => 'bpjs_calculator',
            'source_id' => null,
            'sort_order' => $component->sort_order,
        ];
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Services;

use App\Models\Employee;
use App\Models\PayrollComponent;
use App\Models\TaxBracket;
use Illuminate\Support\Collection;

class Pph21Calculator
{
    public function calculate(Employee $employee, object $profile, float $grossIncome, Collection $components): ?array
    {
        $component = $components->get('pph21');
        if (! $component || $grossIncome <= 0) return null;

        $category = $this->terCategory($profile->tax_status ?? null, (int) ($profile->dependents_count ?? 0));
        $rate = $this->terRate($category, $grossIncome);
        if ($rate <= 0) return null;

        $amount = ceil($grossIncome * $rate);
        return [
            'component_id' => $component->id,
            'type' => $profile->tax_borne_by_employer ? 'iuran_pemberi' : 'potongan',
            'quantity' => 1,
            'unit_rate' => $rate * 100,
            'basis_amount' => $grossIncome,
            'amount' => $amount,
            'formula_note' => 'PPh 21 TER Kategori '.$category.' ('.number_format($rate * 100, 2, ',', '.').'%)',
            'source_type' => 'pph21_calculator',
            'source_id' => null,
            'sort_order' => $component->sort_order,
        ];
    }

    public function terCategory(?string $taxStatus, int $dependents): string
    {
        $status = strtoupper(trim((string) $taxStatus));
        if ($status === '') {
            $status = $dependents <= 0 ? 'TK/0' : ($dependents === 1 ? 'TK/1' : 'K/'.$dependents);
        }
        return match ($status) {
            'TK/0', 'TK/1', 'K/0' => 'A',
            'TK/2', 'TK/3', 'K/1', 'K/2' => 'B',
            'K/3' => 'C',
            default => 'A',
        };
    }

    private function terRate(string $category, float $grossIncome): float
    {
        $bracket = TaxBracket::query()
            ->where('category', $category)
            ->where('min_amount', '<=', $grossIncome)
            ->orderByDesc('min_amount')
            ->first();
        return $bracket ? (float) $bracket->rate : 0.0;
    }
}

class PayrollReportExport implements FromCollection, WithHeadings, WithMapping, ShouldAutoSize
{
    public function __construct(private readonly PayrollPeriod $period) {}

    public function collection()
    {
        $run = $this->period->runs()->where('status', '!=', 'dibatalkan')->latest('version')->firstOrFail();
        return $run->employees()->with(['employee.payrollProfile', 'employee.bankAccounts', 'details.component'])->get();
    }

    public function headings(): array
    {
        return ['NIP', 'Nama Pegawai', 'Bruto', 'Potongan', 'Netto', 'Snack', 'Gaji Tanpa Snack', 'JHT Pegawai', 'BPJS Kes Pegawai', 'PPh 21', 'Iuran Pemberi', 'Bank', 'No. Rekening', 'Nama Rekening', 'Status'];
    }

    public function map($row): array
    {
        $byCode = $row->details->groupBy(fn ($detail) => $detail->component?->code);
        $amount = fn (string $code): float => (float) ($byCode->get($code)?->sum('amount') ?? 0);
        $snack = $amount('uang_snack');
        $bank = $row->employee->bankAccounts->firstWhere('is_primary', true) ?? $row->employee->bankAccounts->first();

        return [
            $row->employee->nip,
            $row->employee->full_name,
            $row->gross,
            $row->total_deduction,
            $row->net,
            $snack,
            (float) $row->net - $snack,
            abs($amount('bpjs_jht_pegawai')),
            abs($amount('bpjs_kesehatan_pegawai')),
            $amount('pph21'),
            $row->employer_contribution,
            $bank?->bank_name,
            $bank?->account_number,
            $bank?->account_holder,
            $row->status,
        ];
    }
}

    private function details($row): Collection { return $row->details->keyBy(fn ($detail) => $detail->component?->code.'-'.$detail->type); }
    private function amount($row, string $code): float { return (float) $row->details->filter(fn ($detail) => $detail->component?->code === $code)->sum('amount'); }
    private function sum($row, array $codes): float { return abs((float) $row->details->filter(fn ($detail) => in_array($detail->component?->code, $codes, true))->sum('amount')); }
    private function basis($row, string ...$codes): ?float { foreach ($codes as $code) { $detail = $row->details->first(fn ($d) => $d->component?->code === $code); if ($detail?->basis_amount !== null) return (float) $detail->basis_amount; } return null; }
    private function pph($row, string $type): float { return abs((float) $row->details->filter(fn ($detail) => $detail->component?->code === 'pph21' && $detail->type === $type)->sum('amount')); }
    private function sequence($row): int { return $row->id; }
    private function terCategory(?string $status, int $dependents): string { $status = strtoupper((string) $status); return match ($status ?: ($dependents ? 'K/'.$dependents : 'TK/0')) { 'TK/0', 'TK/1', 'K/0' => 'A', 'TK/2', 'TK/3', 'K/1', 'K/2' => 'B', 'K/3' => 'C', default => 'A' }; }

## Objective
- Build "Aplikasi Kepegawaian PIS" HRIS following 8-stage roadmap.
- Stage 4 complete; Stage 5 payroll implementation ongoing using official Excel payroll rules.

## Requirements
- Indonesian UI, IDR, DD-MM-YYYY dates, Asia/Jakarta business logic.
- MySQL DB; no fabricated payroll policy/rate.
- Private storage for sensitive files and PDFs.
- Attendance: GPS radius + selfie + idempotency keys.
- Leave/Correction: 2-level approval, Direct Supervisor -> HRD.
- Payroll: period/status flow, snapshot, verified/locked, approval, individual + batch PDF slips, reports/export.
- Excel rules: rates live in parameter tables, all results rounded up, slip hides zero/empty components.
- User provided `BAHAN/GAJI_PEGAWAI_PIS_2026_10.xlsm` and `BAHAN/Prompt_Aplikasi_Penggajian.md`; user approved importing Excel `Tabel_TER`.

## Decisions
- Stage 4 uses Blade/Controllers, no Livewire.
- Stage 5 started as empty framework, then user-provided Excel rules enabled real calculation.
- `attendance_period_summaries` in Stage 5; `attendances.payroll_period_id` FK added in Stage 5.
- Cross-midnight shifts: checkout until shift end + 4h next day.
- DEMO supervisor mapping: Pegawai -> Kepala, others -> Pimpinan.
- Payroll approval flow: HRD submits; Keuangan -> Pimpinan approve; HRD not separate approver.
- Lock requires approved `ApprovalInstance` plus `payroll_runs.status = final`.
- Slip PDF marked `SIMULASI` until locked final period; official slip only after lock.
- Adjustments start `menunggu`; approval uses `payroll.lock`; only pending adjustments can be deleted.
- Approved adjustment becomes `PayrollDetail` with `source_type = manual_adjustment`, `source_id`, `applied_run_id`; not applied twice.
- Main payroll rates moved to DB tables; code fallbacks remain in `PayrollCalculator`.
- TER source: Excel `Tabel_TER`, categories A/B/C, PMK 168/2023 basis; mapped A=`TK/0, TK/1, K/0`, B=`TK/2, TK/3, K/1, K/2`, C=`K/3`.
- PPh 21 with `tax_borne_by_employer = true` becomes `iuran_pemberi`; otherwise `potongan`.

## Work State
### Completed
- Stage 1 Blueprint, Stage 2 Foundation, Stage 3 Administration verified.
- Stage 4 Attendance, Leave, Corrections/Exceptions complete; earlier tests: 61 passed, 311 assertions.
- Stage 5 migrations applied through `2026_11_22_003400_add_category_to_tax_brackets.php`.
- Payroll models, period workflow, snapshot, skeleton run, approval, lock, adjustment, PDF slip framework complete.
- `PayrollComponentSeeder`, `PayrollParameterSeeder`, `TaxTerSeeder` applied.
- `PayrollCalculator` calculates base salary, harian, family allowances, rice, attendance, position/special allowance, transport, snack, khidmah honorarium, BPJS, PPh 21.
- `BpjsCalculator` calculates JKK/JKM/JHT/JP and BPJS Kesehatan from `bpjs_settings`.
- `Pph21Calculator` calculates TER monthly PPh 21 from `tax_brackets`.
- `PayrollService::calculateSkeleton()` now creates real details, refresh totals, cancels old `draf`/`final` runs, applies approved adjustments.
- Anomaly detection active: new hire, termination, zero income, late >480 minutes; sets `payroll_run_employees.status = anomali` and notes.
- Payroll detail UI now shows run totals and per-employee gross/net/status/notes.
- `PayrollController::export()` active for:
  - `payroll`
  - `transfer_gaji`
  - `transfer_snack`
  - `bpjs_tk`
  - `bpjs_kes`
  - `pajak`
- Export UI links added in `resources/views/payroll/show.blade.php`.
- Last verified test before final `sum()` edit: `php artisan test --filter=PayrollSmokeTest --no-ansi` => 7 passed, 29 assertions.
- Earlier verified: `PayrollAdjustmentTest` passed; `PayslipPdfTest` earlier 2 passed, 4 assertions.
- `php artisan db:seed --class=DatabaseSeeder --no-ansi` succeeded.
- `php artisan view:cache --no-ansi` succeeded.
- PHP lint passed on changed PHP files.

### Active
- Final edit in `app/Exports/PayrollOperationalExport.php` changed `sum()` to sum absolute per-detail amounts; verification after that edit pending.
- Full test suite not rerun after latest Stage 5 changes.
- Docs `docs/TEST_REPORT.md`, `docs/DEVELOPMENT_PROGRESS.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`, `README.md` not updated for latest Stage 5 work.

### Blocked
- Controlled run finalization missing: normal workflow creates `draf`, but `PayrollService::lock()` requires `final` run.
- Prorata not applied; only anomaly warning. Cutoff/prorata policy still unresolved.
- PPh 21 December annual reconciliation using Pasal 17 not implemented.
- Payroll period enforcement missing: Excel employee period 21–20; GTT/Ekskul period 1–end-month.
- GTT/Ekskul separate period/slip/calculation not implemented.
- Honor master/matriks, THR, bonus, meugang, overtime, monthly source-data import not implemented.
- Monthly input UI for minutes, transport days, snack days, snack method, potongan lain, honors not implemented.
- `BpjsCalculator` currently loops employer/employee for JKK/JKM/JHT; Excel states JKK/JKM employer only and JHT employer+employee. Needs correction.
- K-13/K-14 real GPS coordinates/radius/accuracy pending.
- K-15/K-16/K-24/K-27/K-30 shifts, paid-leave rules, correction deadlines, field-work policies pending.
- K-18/K-26/K-08 numbering, Yayasan approval authority, probation length pending.

## Next Move
1. Re-run `php artisan test --filter='PayrollSmokeTest|PayrollAdjustmentTest|PayslipPdfTest' --no-ansi` after final `sum()` edit.
2. Run full `php artisan test`.
3. Add tests asserting operational export values, especially BPJS totals after absolute-sum fix.
4. Fix BPJS participant set to match Excel: JKK/JKM employer only; JHT employer + employee.
5. Add controlled finalization path for `payroll_runs.status = final` before lock.
6. Implement prorata only after policy confirmed.
7. Implement monthly input UI and honor/master data.
8. Implement GTT/Ekskul, December tax reconciliation, rekap tahunan.
9. Update docs and changelog.

## Relevant Files
- `D:\APLIKASI KEPEGAWAIAN\BAHAN\GAJI_PEGAWAI_PIS_2026_10.xlsm`: authoritative payroll rules, parameters, TER table.
- `D:\APLIKASI KEPEGAWAIAN\BAHAN\Prompt_Aplikasi_Penggajian.md`: Excel payroll brief and unresolved notes.
- `D:\APLIKASI KEPEGAWAIAN\docs\DEVELOPMENT_ROADMAP.md`: Stage 5 scope source.
- `D:\APLIKASI KEPEGAWAIAN\docs\CLARIFICATIONS.md`: unresolved K-codes and temporary assumptions.
- `D:\APLIKASI KEPEGAWAIAN\app\Services\PayrollCalculator.php`: main payroll calculation and anomaly detection.
- `D:\APLIKASI KEPEGAWAIAN\app\Services\PayrollService.php`: snapshot, run calculation, totals, lock, adjustment integration.
- `D:\APLIKASI KEPEGAWAIAN\app\Services\BpjsCalculator.php`: BPJS calculation; needs participant-set review.
- `D:\APLIKASI KEPEGAWAIAN\app\Services\Pph21Calculator.php`: TER category/rate PPh 21.
- `D:\APLIKASI KEPEGAWAIAN\app\Exports\PayrollReportExport.php`: main payroll Excel report.
- `D:\APLIKASI KEPEGAWAIAN\app\Exports\PayrollOperationalExport.php`: transfer, BPJS, tax exports; last edited, unverified.
- `D:\APLIKASI KEPEGAWAIAN\app\Http\Controllers\PayrollController.php`: payroll workflow and export endpoints.
- `D:\APLIKASI KEPEGAWAIAN\resources\views\payroll\show.blade.php`: workflow, totals, detail rows, export links.
- `D:\APLIKASI KEPEGAWAIAN\database\migrations\`: Stage 5 schema and Excel payroll parameter migrations.
- `D:\APLIKASI KEPEGAWAIAN\database\seeders\PayrollParameterSeeder.php`: Excel parameter/band/BPJS seed data.
- `D:\APLIKASI KEPEGAWAIAN\database\seeders\TaxTerSeeder.php`: Excel TER A/B/C rates.

## Important Context
- Directory is NOT a Git repo; all changes remain uncommitted.
- MySQL dev DB: `pis_kepegawaian`; test DB: `pis_kepegawaian_test`.
- App timezone UTC; business logic uses Asia/Jakarta via Carbon/string normalization.
- Administrator role lacks payroll/personal-data access; use `hrd.demo`, `keuangan.demo`, `pimpinan.demo`.
- Demo passwords from docs: `Admin#2026`, `Demo#2026`.
- `AuditLogger` event column length 30; use short codes such as `payroll.run.created`.
- Payslips stored via `Storage::disk('local')`; private storage required.
- `SIMULASI` watermark on slip PDF is intentional until locked final run exists.
- Web search succeeded for PMK 168/2023: `https://jdih.kemenkeu.go.id/api/download/e60a82e0-b218-40f5-9d18-b924aa1e11ce/2023pmkeuangan168.pdf` and `https://pajak.go.id/sites/default/files/2024-02/PMK%20168%20Tahun%202023%20Tentang%20PPh%20Pasal%2021%20TER.pdf`; PDF fetch unsupported, so TER imported from user Excel.
- Unintended junk files `D:\APLIKASI KEPEGAWAIAN\a.txt` and `D:\APLIKASI KEPEGAWAIAN\b.txt` exist; safe to delete after confirming.

namespace Database\Seeders;

use App\Models\KpiIndicator;
use App\Models\KpiTemplate;
use Illuminate\Database\Seeder;

class KpiTemplateSeeder extends Seeder
{
    public function run(): void
    {
        $template = KpiTemplate::query()->updateOrCreate(
            ['name' => 'Template KPI Umum (DEMO)'],
            ['description' => 'Indikator dasar untuk evaluasi dan pembinaan; tidak berdampak pada payroll.', 'is_active' => true]
        );

        $indicators = [
            ['code' => 'K1', 'name' => 'Kehadiran & Ketepatan Waktu', 'weight' => 30, 'target_type' => 'min', 'unit' => '%'],
            ['code' => 'K2', 'name' => 'Kualitas Pelaksanaan Tugas', 'weight' => 30, 'target_type' => 'min', 'unit' => 'skor'],
            ['code' => 'K3', 'name' => 'Tanggung Jawab & Inisiatif', 'weight' => 20, 'target_type' => 'min', 'unit' => 'skor'],
            ['code' => 'K4', 'name' => 'Kerja Sama & Sikap', 'weight' => 20, 'target_type' => 'min', 'unit' => 'skor'],
        ];

        foreach ($indicators as $indicator) {
            KpiIndicator::query()->updateOrCreate(
                ['kpi_template_id' => $template->id, 'code' => $indicator['code']],
                $indicator + ['description' => 'Indikator DEMO — sesuaikan dengan kebijakan pesantren.']
            );
        }
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use App\Models\Employee;
use App\Models\EmploymentContract;
use App\Models\KpiAssessment;
use App\Models\LeaveRequest;
use App\Models\PayrollPeriod;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\View\View;

class ExecutiveReportController extends Controller
{
    public function index(Request $request): View
    {
        $this->ensurePermission($request, 'report.kpi');
        
        $periods = PayrollPeriod::query()->orderByDesc('start_date')->get();
        $selectedPeriod = $request->input('period_code') 
            ? PayrollPeriod::where('code', $request->input('period_code'))->first() 
            : $periods->first();

        $stats = [
            'total_employees' => Employee::query()->where('is_active', true)->count(),
            'active_contracts' => EmploymentContract::query()->where('status', 'aktif')->count(),
            'pending_leaves' => LeaveRequest::query()->where('status', 'menunggu_atasan')->count(),
            'latest_payroll_net' => $selectedPeriod ? (float) $selectedPeriod->runs()->where('status', '!=', 'dibatalkan')->latest('version')->value('total_net') : 0,
            'kpi_avg_score' => KpiAssessment::query()->where('status', 'approved')->avg('final_score') ?? 0,
        ];

        return view('reports.executive', compact('periods', 'selectedPeriod', 'stats'));
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use App\Http\Controllers\Concerns\GuardsHrAccess;
use App\Models\CoachingRecord;
use App\Models\Employee;
use App\Models\KpiAssessment;
use App\Models\KpiIndicator;
use App\Models\KpiPeriod;
use App\Models\KpiTemplate;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder;
use Illuminate\Http\RedirectResponse;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;
use Illuminate\View\View;

class KpiController extends Controller
{
    use GuardsHrAccess;

    public function index(Request $request): View
    {
        $this->ensurePermission($request, 'kpi.view.self');

        $periods = KpiPeriod::query()->orderByDesc('start_date')->get();
        $templates = KpiTemplate::query()->orderByDesc('is_active')->get();
        $assessments = $this->visibleAssessments($request)->with([
            'employee:id,full_name,nip', 'period:id,code', 'template:id,name', 'assessor:id,full_name',
        ])->orderByDesc('id')->paginate(20);

        return view('kpi.index', compact('periods', 'templates', 'assessments'));
    }

    public function storePeriod(Request $request): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->ensurePermission($request, 'kpi.period.manage');

        $data = $request->validate([
            'code' => 'required|string|max:10|unique:kpi_periods,code',
            'start_date' => 'required|date',
            'end_date' => 'required|date|after_or_equal:start_date',
            'notes' => 'nullable|string|max:1000',
        ]);
        $data['status'] = 'open';
        KpiPeriod::query()->create($data);

        return back()->with('success', 'Periode KPI dibuat.');
    }

    public function updatePeriodStatus(Request $request, KpiPeriod $period): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->ensurePermission($request, 'kpi.period.manage');
        $data = $request->validate(['status' => 'required|in:draft,open,closed']);
        $period->update($data);

        return back()->with('success', 'Status periode KPI diperbarui.');
    }

    public function storeTemplate(Request $request): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->ensurePermission($request, 'kpi.template.manage');

        $data = $request->validate([
            'name' => 'required|string|max:100|unique:kpi_templates,name',
            'description' => 'nullable|string|max:1000',
            'indicators' => 'required|array|min:1',
            'indicators.*.code' => 'required|string|max:20',
            'indicators.*.name' => 'required|string|max:150',
            'indicators.*.weight' => 'required|numeric|min:0.01|max:100',
            'indicators.*.target_type' => 'required|in:min,max',
            'indicators.*.unit' => 'nullable|string|max:50',
        ]);

        $total = collect($data['indicators'])->sum('weight');
        if (abs((float) $total - 100.0) > 0.001) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                'indicators' => 'Total bobot indikator harus tepat 100%. Saat ini: '.$total.'%.',
            ]);
        }

        DB::transaction(function () use ($data): void {
            $template = KpiTemplate::query()->create([
                'name' => $data['name'],
                'description' => $data['description'] ?? null,
                'is_active' => true,
            ]);
            foreach ($data['indicators'] as $indicator) {
                $template->indicators()->create($indicator);
            }
        });

        return back()->with('success', 'Template KPI dibuat dengan bobot 100%.');
    }

    public function createAssessment(Request $request): View
    {
        $this->ensurePermission($request, 'kpi.assess');

        $employees = Employee::query()
            ->visibleTo($request->user())
            ->where('is_active', true)
            ->where('id', '!=', $request->user()->employee_id ?? 0)
            ->get(['id', 'nip', 'full_name']);

        return view('kpi.assessments.create', [
            'employees' => $employees,
            'periods' => KpiPeriod::query()->where('status', 'open')->orderByDesc('start_date')->get(),
            'templates' => KpiTemplate::query()->where('is_active', true)->get(),
        ]);
    }

    public function storeAssessment(Request $request): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->ensurePermission($request, 'kpi.assess');

        $data = $request->validate([
            'employee_id' => 'required|exists:employees,id',
            'kpi_period_id' => 'required|exists:kpi_periods,id',
            'kpi_template_id' => 'required|exists:kpi_templates,id',
        ]);

        $this->ensureRecordVisible($request, (int) $data['employee_id']);

        $exists = KpiAssessment::query()->where([
            'employee_id' => $data['employee_id'],
            'kpi_period_id' => $data['kpi_period_id'],
            'kpi_template_id' => $data['kpi_template_id'],
        ])->exists();

        if ($exists) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['employee_id' => 'Penilaian untuk pegawai, periode, dan template ini sudah ada.']);
        }

        $assessment = DB::transaction(function () use ($data, $request): KpiAssessment {
            $assessment = KpiAssessment::query()->create($data + [
                'assessor_id' => $request->user()->employee_id,
                'status' => 'draft',
                'final_score' => 0,
            ]);

            foreach (KpiIndicator::query()->where('kpi_template_id', $data['kpi_template_id'])->orderBy('code')->get() as $indicator) {
                $assessment->items()->create([
                    'kpi_indicator_id' => $indicator->id,
                    'target' => null,
                    'actual' => null,
                    'score' => 0,
                    'weighted_score' => 0,
                ]);
            }

            return $assessment;
        });

        return redirect()->route('kpi.assessments.edit', $assessment)->with('success', 'Penilaian KPI dibuat. Isi realisasi dan skor berikutnya.');
    }

    public function editAssessment(Request $request, KpiAssessment $assessment): View
    {
        $this->ensureCanAssess($request, $assessment);
        abort_unless($assessment->status === 'draft', 403, 'Penilaian terkunci tidak dapat diubah.');
        $assessment->load(['employee:id,full_name,nip', 'period', 'template', 'items.indicator']);

        return view('kpi.assessments.edit', compact('assessment'));
    }

    public function updateAssessment(Request $request, KpiAssessment $assessment): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->ensureCanAssess($request, $assessment);
        abort_unless($assessment->status === 'draft', 403, 'Penilaian terkunci tidak dapat diubah.');

        $data = $request->validate([
            'items' => 'required|array|min:1',
            'items.*.id' => 'required|exists:kpi_assessment_items,id',
            'items.*.target' => 'nullable|numeric|min:0',
            'items.*.actual' => 'nullable|numeric|min:0',
            'items.*.notes' => 'nullable|string|max:500',
            'notes' => 'nullable|string|max:1000',
        ]);

        DB::transaction(function () use ($data, $assessment): void {
            foreach ($data['items'] as $itemData) {
                $item = $assessment->items()->whereKey($itemData['id'])->firstOrFail();
                $target = isset($itemData['target']) ? (float) $itemData['target'] : 0.0;
                $actual = isset($itemData['actual']) ? (float) $itemData['actual'] : 0.0;
                $score = $target > 0 ? min(100.0, round($actual / $target * 100, 2)) : 0.0;
                $weight = (float) $item->indicator->weight;
                $item->update([
                    'target' => $target,
                    'actual' => $actual,
                    'score' => $score,
                    'weighted_score' => round($score * $weight / 100, 2),
                    'notes' => $itemData['notes'] ?? null,
                ]);
            }

            $assessment->update([
                'final_score' => round((float) $assessment->items()->sum('weighted_score'), 2),
                'notes' => $data['notes'] ?? null,
            ]);
        });

        return back()->with('success', 'Penilaian KPI disimpan. Nilai akhir: '.$assessment->fresh()->final_score);
    }

    public function submitAssessment(Request $request, KpiAssessment $assessment): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->ensureCanAssess($request, $assessment);
        abort_unless($assessment->status === 'draft' && $assessment->final_score > 0, 422, 'Isi penilaian sebelum mengajukan.');
        $assessment->update(['status' => 'submitted']);

        return back()->with('success', 'Penilaian KPI diajukan untuk verifikasi HRD.');
    }

    public function verifyAssessment(Request $request, KpiAssessment $assessment): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->ensurePermission($request, 'kpi.verify');
        abort_unless($assessment->status === 'submitted', 422, 'Hanya penilaian yang diajukan yang dapat diverifikasi.');
        $assessment->update(['status' => 'verified']);

        return back()->with('success', 'Penilaian KPI diverifikasi.');
    }

    public function approveAssessment(Request $request, KpiAssessment $assessment): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->ensurePermission($request, 'kpi.approve');
        abort_unless($assessment->status === 'verified', 422, 'Penilaian harus diverifikasi HRD sebelum disetujui.');
        $assessment->update(['status' => 'approved']);

        return back()->with('success', 'Penilaian KPI disetujui dan dikunci.');
    }

    public function unlockAssessment(Request $request, KpiAssessment $assessment): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->ensurePermission($request, 'kpi.unlock');
        $data = $request->validate(['reason' => 'required|string|max:500']);
        $assessment->update([
            'status' => 'draft',
            'notes' => trim(($assessment->notes ? $assessment->notes."\n" : '').'Dibuka kembali: '.$data['reason']),
        ]);

        return back()->with('success', 'Penilaian KPI dibuka kembali.');
    }

    public function showAssessment(Request $request, KpiAssessment $assessment): View
    {
        abort_unless($this->visibleAssessments($request)->whereKey($assessment->id)->exists(), 403);
        $assessment->load(['employee:id,full_name,nip', 'period', 'template', 'assessor:id,full_name', 'items.indicator']);

        return view('kpi.assessments.show', compact('assessment'));
    }

    private function visibleAssessments(Request $request): Builder
    {
        $user = $request->user();

        if ($user->hasPermission('kpi.view.all')) {
            return KpiAssessment::query();
        }

        if ($user->hasPermission('kpi.view.unit')) {
            return KpiAssessment::query()->whereIn(
                'employee_id',
                Employee::query()->visibleTo($user)->select('id')
            );
        }

        return KpiAssessment::query()->where('employee_id', $user->employee_id ?? 0);
    }

    private function ensureCanAssess(Request $request, KpiAssessment $assessment): void
    {
        $this->ensurePermission($request, 'kpi.assess');
        $user = $request->user();

        if (! $user->hasPermission('kpi.view.all')) {
            abort_unless(
                Employee::query()->visibleTo($user)->whereKey($assessment->employee_id)->exists(),
                403,
                'Pegawai ini di luar cakupan unit Anda.'
            );
        }
    }

    public function coachingIndex(Request $request): View
    {
        $query = CoachingRecord::query()->with(['employee:id,full_name,nip', 'coach:id,full_name']);
        $user = $request->user();

        if (! $user->hasPermission('coaching.view.all')) {
            if ($user->hasPermission('coaching.view.unit')) {
                $query->whereIn('employee_id', Employee::query()->visibleTo($user)->select('id'));
            } else {
                $query->where('employee_id', $user->employee_id ?? 0);
            }
        }

        return view('kpi.coaching.index', ['records' => $query->orderByDesc('date')->paginate(20)]);
    }

    public function storeCoaching(Request $request): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->ensurePermission($request, 'coaching.manage');

        $data = $request->validate([
            'employee_id' => 'required|exists:employees,id',
            'date' => 'required|date',
            'type' => 'required|in:konseling,pembinaan_kedisiplinan,teguran,evaluasi,pelatihan,penghargaan',
            'reason' => 'required|string|max:2000',
            'result' => 'nullable|string|max:2000',
        ]);

        $this->ensureRecordVisible($request, (int) $data['employee_id']);

        CoachingRecord::query()->create($data + [
            'coach_id' => $request->user()->employee_id,
            'status' => 'draft',
        ]);

        return back()->with('success', 'Catatan pembinaan tersimpan.');
    }

    public function approveCoaching(Request $request, CoachingRecord $record): RedirectResponse
    {
        $this->ensurePermission($request, 'coaching.approve');
        abort_unless($record->status === 'draft', 422, 'Catatan ini sudah diproses.');
        $record->update(['status' => 'disetujui']);

        return back()->with('success', 'Catatan pembinaan disetujui.');
    }
}

No self-reference.## Objective
- Build "Aplikasi Kepegawaian PIS" HRIS following 8-stage roadmap.
- Complete payroll implementation (Stage 5) and begin KPI & Pembinaan (Stage 6).

## Requirements
- Indonesian UI, IDR, DD-MM-YYYY dates, Asia/Jakarta business logic.
- MySQL DB; no fabricated payroll policy/rate.
- Attendance: GPS radius + selfie + idempotency.
- Leave/Correction: 2-level approval.
- KPI: KPI & pembinaan pegawai, penilaian berjenjang.

## Decisions
- Payroll approval flow: HRD submits; Keuangan -> Pimpinan approve.
- Lock requires approved `ApprovalInstance` plus `payroll_runs.status = final`.
- Approved adjustment becomes `PayrollDetail` with `source_type = manual_adjustment`.
- KPI does not affect salary/status automatically.
- KPI workflow: HRD prepare -> Dept Head assess -> HRD verify -> Pimpinan approve.

## Work State
### Completed
- Stages 1–4 complete: Blueprint, Foundation, Admin, Attendance, Leave.
- Stage 5: Payroll models, period workflow, skeleton, approval, lock, adjustment, PDF framework complete.
- Payroll seeders (Components, Parameters, TER) applied.
- BPJS (JKK/JKM employer only, JHT employer + employee) and PPh 21 TER (Categories A/B/C) calculated.
- Operational Excel reports (transfer, BPJS, tax) functional.
- Payroll anomaly detection and total calculation verified.
- 76 tests (366 assertions) passed, including `PayrollSmokeTest`, `PayrollAdjustmentTest`, `PayslipPdfTest`, `Pph21CalculatorTest`.

### Active
- KPI & Pembinaan (Stage 6) implementation: database models, migration planning.
- Finalizing controlled payroll run finalization.

### Blocked
- KPI/Pembinaan data model and migration (Stage 6.1).
- K-18, K-26, K-08 (official numbering, Yayasan authority, probation length) pending.
- December tax reconciliation (Pasal 17).

## Next Move
1. Create `kpi_periods`, `kpi_templates`, `kpi_indicators`, `kpi_assessments`, `kpi_assessment_items`, `coaching_records` migrations.
2. Implement Stage 6.1 models.
3. Configure `php artisan serve` access and demo accounts for user.

## Relevant Files
- `D:\APLIKASI KEPEGAWAIAN\docs\DEVELOPMENT_ROADMAP.md`: Stage 6 requirements.
- `D:\APLIKASI KEPEGAWAIAN\docs\DATABASE_DESIGN.md`: KPI table specifications.
- `D:\APLIKASI KEPEGAWAIAN\app\Services\PayrollCalculator.php`: Completed payroll logic.
- `D:\APLIKASI KEPEGAWAIAN\database\migrations\2026_11_22_003000_create_payroll_tables.php`: Existing pattern for migrations.

## Important Context
- App running at http://127.0.0.1:8000; Admin: `admin`/`Admin#2026`, Demo roles: `Demo#2026`.
- KPI & Pembinaan must be developed without payroll side-effects.

<?php

namespace App\Exports;

use App\Models\Employee;
use Maatwebsite\Excel\Concerns\FromCollection;
use Maatwebsite\Excel\Concerns\ShouldAutoSize;
use Maatwebsite\Excel\Concerns\WithHeadings;
use Maatwebsite\Excel\Concerns\WithMapping;

class AttendanceReportExport implements FromCollection, ShouldAutoSize, WithHeadings, WithMapping
{
    public function __construct(private int $month, private int $year) {}

    public function collection()
    {
        return Employee::query()
            ->where('is_active', true)
            ->withCount([
                'attendances as hadir' => fn ($q) => $q->whereMonth('work_date', $this->month)->whereYear('work_date', $this->year)->whereIn('status', ['hadir', 'terlambat', 'pulang_awal']),
                'attendances as terlambat' => fn ($q) => $q->whereMonth('work_date', $this->month)->whereYear('work_date', $this->year)->where('status', 'terlambat'),
                'attendances as izin' => fn ($q) => $q->whereMonth('work_date', $this->month)->whereYear('work_date', $this->year)->whereIn('status', ['izin', 'sakit', 'dispensasi', 'libur']),
                'attendances as alpa' => fn ($q) => $q->whereMonth('work_date', $this->month)->whereYear('work_date', $this->year)->where('status', 'tidak_hadir'),
            ])
            ->orderBy('full_name')
            ->get();
    }

    public function headings(): array
    {
        return ['NIP', 'Nama Lengkap', 'Hadir', 'Terlambat', 'Izin/Sakit/Libur', 'Alpa'];
    }

    /** @param Employee $row */
    public function map($row): array
    {
        return [$row->nip, $row->full_name, $row->hadir, $row->terlambat, $row->izin, $row->alpa];
    }
}

namespace App\Exports;

use Maatwebsite\Excel\Concerns\ShouldAutoSize;

            (float) $row->total_deduction,
            (float) $row->employer_contribution,

            strtoupper($row->status),
        ];
    }
}

<?php

namespace Tests\Feature;

use App\Models\CoachingRecord;
use App\Models\Employee;
use App\Models\KpiAssessment;
use App\Models\KpiPeriod;
use App\Models\KpiTemplate;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Tests\TestCase;

class KpiWorkflowTest extends TestCase
{
    use RefreshDatabase;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();
        $this->seed();
    }

    private function user(string $username): User
    {
        return User::where('username', $username)->firstOrFail();
    }

    public function test_full_kpi_workflow_from_assessment_to_approval(): void
    {
        $hrd = $this->user('hrd.demo');
        $kepala = $this->user('kepala.demo');
        $pimpinan = $this->user('pimpinan.demo');
        $pegawai = $this->user('pegawai.demo')->employee;
        $template = KpiTemplate::query()->where('is_active', true)->firstOrFail();

        $this->actingAs($hrd)->post(route('kpi.periods.store'), [
            'code' => '2026-11',
            'start_date' => '2026-11-01',
            'end_date' => '2026-11-30',
            'notes' => 'Periode uji',
        ])->assertSessionHas('success');

        $period = KpiPeriod::query()->where('code', '2026-11')->firstOrFail();

        $this->actingAs($kepala)->post(route('kpi.assessments.store'), [
            'employee_id' => $pegawai->id,
            'kpi_period_id' => $period->id,
            'kpi_template_id' => $template->id,
        ])->assertRedirect();

        $assessment = KpiAssessment::query()->firstOrFail();
        $this->assertEquals('draft', $assessment->status);

        $items = $assessment->items()->get()->values()->map(fn ($item, $i) => [
            'id' => $item->id,
            'target' => 100,
            'actual' => 100,
            'notes' => 'Uji '.$i,
        ])->all();

        $this->actingAs($kepala)->put(route('kpi.assessments.update', $assessment), [
            'items' => $items,
            'notes' => 'Catatan penilai',
        ])->assertSessionHas('success');

        $this->assertEquals(100.0, (float) $assessment->fresh()->final_score);

        $this->actingAs($kepala)->post(route('kpi.assessments.submit', $assessment))->assertSessionHas('success');
        $this->assertEquals('submitted', $assessment->fresh()->status);

        $this->actingAs($hrd)->post(route('kpi.assessments.verify', $assessment))->assertSessionHas('success');
        $this->assertEquals('verified', $assessment->fresh()->status);

        $this->actingAs($pimpinan)->post(route('kpi.assessments.approve', $assessment))->assertSessionHas('success');
        $this->assertEquals('approved', $assessment->fresh()->status);
    }

    public function test_assessor_cannot_assess_self(): void
    {
        $hrd = $this->user('hrd.demo');
        $template = KpiTemplate::query()->where('is_active', true)->firstOrFail();

        $this->actingAs($hrd)->post(route('kpi.periods.store'), [
            'code' => '2026-11',
            'start_date' => '2026-11-01',
            'end_date' => '2026-11-30',
        ]);

        $period = KpiPeriod::query()->where('code', '2026-11')->firstOrFail();

        $response = $this->actingAs($hrd)->post(route('kpi.assessments.store'), [
            'employee_id' => $hrd->employee_id,
            'kpi_period_id' => $period->id,
            'kpi_template_id' => $template->id,
        ]);

        $response->assertSessionHasErrors('employee_id');
        $this->assertDatabaseCount('kpi_assessments', 0);
    }

    public function test_coaching_record_can_be_created_and_approved(): void
    {
        $kepala = $this->user('kepala.demo');
        $pimpinan = $this->user('pimpinan.demo');
        $pegawai = Employee::query()->whereKey($this->user('pegawai.demo')->employee_id)->firstOrFail();

        $this->actingAs($kepala)->post(route('coaching.store'), [
            'employee_id' => $pegawai->id,
            'date' => '2026-11-20',
            'type' => 'konseling',
            'reason' => 'Koordinasi rutin',
            'result' => 'Disepakati perbaikan jadwal',
        ])->assertSessionHas('success');

        $record = CoachingRecord::query()->firstOrFail();
